import LatticeProb.Site

/-!
Finite wired square boxes, with individual exit edge copies and forbidden-subset
recurrence. The counting law below is on the literal allowed-height subtype;
its identification with Markov recurrence is a separate literature result.
-/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

open LatticeProb MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

abbrev Active (N : ℕ) := Fin 2 → Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)

def site {N : ℕ} (x : Active N) : Site 2 := fun i => (x i).val

theorem site_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@site N) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun h i)

def inBox (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) : Prop := ∀ i, -(N : ℤ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ N

def activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) : Active N :=
  fun i => ⟨x i, h i⟩

theorem site_activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) :
    site (activeOfSite N x h) = x := rfl

theorem inBox_iff (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) :
    inBox N x ↔ x ∈ box 2 N := by
  simp only [inBox, box, Set.mem_setOf_eq, abs_le]

abbrev Direction := Fin 2 × Bool

def step (d : Direction) : Site 2 := if d.2 then unit d.1 else -unit d.1

theorem step_injective : Function.Injective step := by
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals norm_num [step, unit, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two] at h
  all_goals rfl

abbrev InteriorEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Active N // ∃ i : Fin 2, site p.2 = site p.1 + unit i}

abbrev ExitEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Direction // ¬inBox N (site p.1 + step p.2)}

/-- Each internal edge occurs in its positive-coordinate orientation once.
An exit copy remembers both its active endpoint and its outward direction. -/
abbrev Edge (N : ℕ) := InteriorEdge N ⊕ ExitEdge N

abbrev Vertex (N : ℕ) := Option (Active N)

def endpoints {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) : Vertex N × Vertex N :=
  match e with
  | .inl e => (some e.val.1, some e.val.2)
  | .inr e => (some e.val.1, none)

def conductance {N : ℕ} (_e : Edge N) : ℝ := 1

theorem endpoints_ne {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) :
    (endpoints e).1 ≠ (endpoints e).2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl e =>
    intro h
    have he : e.val.1 = e.val.2 := Option.some.inj h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    have hh := congrFun hi i
    rw [he] at hh
    simp [unit, site] at hh
  | inr e => simp [endpoints]

abbrev Heights (N : ℕ) := Active N → Fin 4

def internalDegree {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) : ℕ :=
  (nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site).card

theorem mem_neighbors_iff (x y : Site 2) :
    y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ (lattice 2).Adj x y := by
  change y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩

theorem internalDegree_eq_adj_card {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) :
    internalDegree s x = (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).card := by
  classical
  have he : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site =
      (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).image site := by
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, mem_neighbors_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [internalDegree, he, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (site_injective N)]

def forbidden {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) (s : Finset (Active N)) : Prop :=
  s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, (η x).val < internalDegree s x

def recurrent {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) : Prop := ∀ s, ¬forbidden η s

def allThree (N : ℕ) : Heights N := fun _ => 3

private theorem card_neighbors (x : Site 2) : (nbrFinset x).card = 4 := by
  classical
  rw [nbrFinset, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 2, ({x + unit i, x - unit i} : Finset (Site 2)).card = 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_singleton]
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
      intro h
      have hi := congrFun h i
      simp only [unit, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] at hi
      omega
    simp [hc]
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro a (rfl | rfl) (h | h) <;>
      have h1 := congrFun h i <;>
      have h2 := congrFun h j <;>
      simp [unit, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_of_ne, hij] at h1 h2

theorem exists_boundary_vertex {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, internalDegree s x ≤ 3 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun x => site x 0) hs
  have hout : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∉ s.image site := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hle := hmax y hy
    have he0 := congrFun he 0
    simp [unit] at he0
    omega
  have hsub : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site ⊂ nbrFinset (site x) := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨Finset.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
    intro he
    have hm : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∈ nbrFinset (site x) := by
      simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    rw [← he] at hm
    exact hout (Finset.mem_inter.mp hm).2
  have hc := Finset.card_lt_card hsub
  rw [card_neighbors] at hc
  exact ⟨x, hx, by dsimp [internalDegree]; omega⟩

theorem allThree_recurrent (N : ℕ) : recurrent (allThree N) := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdeg⟩ := exists_boundary_vertex s hs.1
  have hlt := hs.2 x hx
  change 3 < internalDegree s x at hlt
  omega

abbrev Recurrent (N : ℕ) := {η : Heights N // recurrent η}

instance recurrentNonempty (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (Recurrent N) :=
  ⟨⟨allThree N, allThree_recurrent N⟩⟩

instance recurrentFintype (N : ℕ) : Fintype (Recurrent N) := Fintype.ofFinite _

instance recurrentMeasurableSpace (N : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Recurrent N) := ⊤

instance recurrentMeasurableSingletonClass (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (Recurrent N) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Normalized counting measure on all stable fields with no forbidden subset. -/
def law (N : ℕ) : Measure (Recurrent N) :=
  (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

theorem law_singleton (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) :
    law N {η} = (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  simp [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

instance lawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (law N) := by
  constructor
  simp only [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]
  simp [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem law_apply (N : ℕ) (s : Set (Recurrent N)) :
    law N s = s.encard / Fintype.card (Recurrent N) := by
  rw [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_apply s.toFinite.measurableSet]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

/-- Auxiliary zero extension of a finite input field, not an infinite-volume law. -/
def zeroExtend (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) : Site 2 → Fin 4 :=
  fun x => if h : inBox N x then η.val (activeOfSite N x h) else 0

theorem zeroExtend_site (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Active N) :
    zeroExtend N η (site x) = η.val x := by
  have h : inBox N (site x) := fun i => (x i).property
  rw [zeroExtend, dif_pos h]
  congr 1

theorem zeroExtend_outside (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Site 2)
    (h : ¬inBox N x) : zeroExtend N η x = 0 := by
  simp only [zeroExtend, dif_neg h]

theorem zeroExtend_measurable (N : ℕ) : Measurable (zeroExtend N) :=
  measurable_of_countable _

/-- Push-forward of the finite recurrent counting law by the specified zero extension. -/
def finiteFieldLaw (N : ℕ) : Measure (Site 2 → Fin 4) :=
  Measure.map (zeroExtend N) (law N)

instance finiteFieldLawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteFieldLaw N) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (zeroExtend_measurable N).aemeasurable




end

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

import LatticeProb.Sandpile.LeastAction

/-!
# Finite legal toppling lists

The definitions use the literal lattice toppling rule. Least action gives
uniqueness of the counts in a finite legal stabilization and finite determination
under agreement on the affected vertices and their neighbors.

These are deterministic ingredients for `th:main` and `dy:finite-determination`
in the manuscript, rather than statements of those probability theorems.
-/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile

abbrev Site2 := Site 2
abbrev StableField := Site2 → Fin 4
abbrev Counts := Site2 →₀ ℕ

def initial (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  (η x).val + (ξ x : ℤ)

noncomputable def listCounts (w : List Site2) : Counts :=
  (w : Multiset Site2).toFinsupp

theorem listCounts_apply (w : List Site2) (x : Site2) :
    listCounts w x = w.count x := by
  simp [listCounts]

theorem listCounts_support (w : List Site2) :
    (listCounts w).support = w.toFinset := rfl

theorem listCounts_total (w : List Site2) :
    (listCounts w).sum (fun _ n => n) = w.length := by
  simp [listCounts, Finsupp.sum]

def prefixCounts (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  ((w.take k).count x : ℤ)

def LegalList (s : Site2 → ℤ) (w : List Site2) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < w.length), 4 ≤ s w[k] + lap (prefixCounts w k) w[k]

def Stabilizes (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (w : List Site2) : Prop :=
  LegalList (initial η ξ) w ∧
    ∀ x, 0 ≤ initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x ∧
      initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4

theorem prefix_zero (w : List Site2) : prefixCounts w 0 = 0 := by
  funext x
  simp [prefixCounts]

theorem prefix_succ (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < w.length) (x : Site2) :
    prefixCounts w (k + 1) x = prefixCounts w k x + if x = w[k] then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold prefixCounts
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hk, List.count_append]
  by_cases hx : x = w[k]
  · simp [hx]
  · simp [hx, Ne.symm hx]

theorem prefix_eq_terminal (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (hk : w.length ≤ k) :
    prefixCounts w k = fun x => (listCounts w x : ℤ) := by
  funext x
  simp [prefixCounts, List.take_of_length_le hk, listCounts_apply]

theorem prefix_succ_eq (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < w.length) :
    prefixCounts w (k + 1) = fun x => prefixCounts w k x + dirac w[k] x := by
  funext x
  simpa only [dirac] using prefix_succ w k hk x

theorem lap_add (u v : Site2 → ℤ) (x : Site2) :
    lap (fun y => u y + v y) x = lap u x + lap v x := by
  simp only [lap, nbrSumZ, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

theorem height_succ (s : Site2 → ℤ) (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < w.length) (x : Site2) :
    s x + lap (prefixCounts w (k + 1)) x =
      s x + lap (prefixCounts w k) x + lap (dirac w[k]) x := by
  rw [prefix_succ_eq w k hk, lap_add]
  ring

theorem dirac_nonneg (z x : Site2) : 0 ≤ dirac z x := by
  simp only [dirac]
  split <;> norm_num

theorem lap_dirac_self (z : Site2) : lap (dirac z) z = -4 := by
  have hp (i : Fin 2) : dirac z (z + unit i) = 0 := by
    apply dirac_of_ne
    intro h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    simp [unit] at hi
  have hm (i : Fin 2) : dirac z (z - unit i) = 0 := by
    apply dirac_of_ne
    intro h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    simp [unit] at hi
  simp [lap, nbrSumZ, hp, hm]

theorem lap_dirac_nonneg {z x : Site2} (hx : x ≠ z) : 0 ≤ lap (dirac z) x := by
  rw [lap, dirac_of_ne hx]
  simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  exact add_nonneg (dirac_nonneg z _) (dirac_nonneg z _)

theorem LegalList.heights_nonneg {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (h : LegalList s w) (hs : ∀ x, 0 ≤ s x) :
    ∀ k x, 0 ≤ s x + lap (prefixCounts w k) x := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro x
    simpa [prefix_zero, lap, nbrSumZ] using hs x
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x
    by_cases hk : k < w.length
    · rw [height_succ s w k hk x]
      by_cases hx : x = w[k]
      · subst x
        rw [lap_dirac_self]
        have ht := h k hk
        omega
      · exact add_nonneg (ih x) (lap_dirac_nonneg hx)
    · have he : prefixCounts w (k + 1) = prefixCounts w k := by
        rw [prefix_eq_terminal w (k + 1) (by omega),
          prefix_eq_terminal w k (by omega)]
      rw [he]
      exact ih x

theorem LegalList.isLegalToppling {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (h : LegalList s w) : IsLegalToppling s (prefixCounts w) := by
  refine ⟨prefix_zero w, ?_⟩
  intro k x
  by_cases hk : k < w.length
  · rw [prefix_succ w k hk x]
    by_cases hx : x = w[k]
    · right
      subst x
      exact ⟨by simp, by simpa using h k hk⟩
    · left
      simp [hx]
  · left
    rw [prefix_eq_terminal w (k + 1) (by omega),
      prefix_eq_terminal w k (by omega)]

theorem initial_nonneg (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (x : Site2) :
    0 ≤ initial η ξ x := by
  dsimp [initial]
  positivity

theorem stabilizes_iff_legal_and_lt (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (w : List Site2) :
    Stabilizes η ξ w ↔ LegalList (initial η ξ) w ∧
      ∀ x, initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4 := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => ⟨h.1, fun x => (h.2 x).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hs⟩
    refine ⟨h, fun x => ⟨?_, hs x⟩⟩
    have hn := h.heights_nonneg (initial_nonneg η ξ) w.length x
    rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at hn
    exact hn

theorem stabilizes_nil_zero (η : StableField) : Stabilizes η 0 [] := by
  rw [stabilizes_iff_legal_and_lt]
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    simp at hk
  · intro x
    simp [initial, listCounts, lap, nbrSumZ]

theorem legalList_le {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2} (h : LegalList s w)
    (v : Counts) (hv : ∀ x, s x + lap (fun y => (v y : ℤ)) x < 4) :
    ∀ x, listCounts w x ≤ v x := by
  intro x
  have hb := le_of_isLegalToppling h.isLegalToppling
    (w := fun y => (v y : ℤ)) (fun y => by positivity)
    (by simpa using hv) w.length x
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at hb
  change (listCounts w x : ℤ) ≤ (v x : ℤ) at hb
  exact_mod_cast hb

theorem stabilizes_counts_unique {η : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w v : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w) (hv : Stabilizes η ξ v) : listCounts w = listCounts v := by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro x
  exact le_antisymm (legalList_le hw.1 (listCounts v) (fun y => (hv.2 y).2) x)
    (legalList_le hv.1 (listCounts w) (fun y => (hw.2 y).2) x)

theorem existsUnique_counts {η : StableField} {ξ : Counts}
    (h : ∃ w, Stabilizes η ξ w) :
    ∃! u : Counts, ∃ w, Stabilizes η ξ w ∧ listCounts w = u := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h
  refine ⟨listCounts w, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro u ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  exact stabilizes_counts_unique hv hw

def StabilizationDomain (ξ : Counts) := {η : StableField // ∃ w, Stabilizes η ξ w}

noncomputable def odometer (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) : Counts :=
  Classical.choose (existsUnique_counts η.property)

theorem odometer_spec (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) :
    ∃ w, Stabilizes η.val ξ w ∧ listCounts w = odometer ξ η :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (existsUnique_counts η.property)).1

theorem odometer_eq_counts (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ)
    {w : List Site2} (hw : Stabilizes η.val ξ w) : odometer ξ η = listCounts w := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := odometer_spec ξ η
  exact he.symm.trans (stabilizes_counts_unique hv hw)

theorem odometer_final_stable (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) (x : Site2) :
    0 ≤ initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x ∧
      initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x < 4 := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := odometer_spec ξ η
  rw [← he]
  exact hw.2 x

noncomputable def addition (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) : StableField :=
  fun x => ⟨(initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x).toNat,
    (Int.toNat_lt (odometer_final_stable ξ η x).1).mpr
      (odometer_final_stable ξ η x).2⟩

theorem addition_eq (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) (x : Site2) :
    ((addition ξ η x).val : ℤ) =
      initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x :=
  Int.toNat_of_nonneg (odometer_final_stable ξ η x).1

def affected (ξ u : Counts) : Finset Site2 :=
  ξ.support ∪ u.support ∪ u.support.biUnion nbrFinset

theorem mem_nbrFinset_iff_adj (x y : Site2) :
    y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ (lattice 2).Adj x y := by
  change y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩

theorem mem_affected_iff (ξ u : Counts) (x : Site2) :
    x ∈ affected ξ u ↔ ξ x ≠ 0 ∨ u x ≠ 0 ∨
      ∃ y, u y ≠ 0 ∧ (lattice 2).Adj y x := by
  simp only [affected, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finsupp.mem_support_iff,
    mem_nbrFinset_iff_adj, or_assoc]

theorem mem_affected_of_list {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2} {x : Site2}
    (hx : x ∈ w) : x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w) := by
  simp only [affected, listCounts_support, Finset.mem_union, List.mem_toFinset]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr hx)

theorem count_zero_outside_affected {ξ u : Counts} {x : Site2}
    (hx : x ∉ affected ξ u) : ξ x = 0 ∧ u x = 0 := by
  simp only [affected, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hx
  exact ⟨Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx.1.1,
    Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx.1.2⟩

theorem lap_zero_outside_affected {ξ u : Counts} {x : Site2}
    (hx : x ∉ affected ξ u) : lap (fun y => (u y : ℤ)) x = 0 := by
  have hux := (count_zero_outside_affected hx).2
  have hn : ∀ y ∈ nbrFinset x, u y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra h
    apply hx
    simp only [affected, Finset.mem_union]
    right
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨y, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h, ?_⟩
    simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := hy
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  have hp (i : Fin 2) : u (x + unit i) = 0 :=
    hn _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, by simp⟩)
  have hm (i : Fin 2) : u (x - unit i) = 0 :=
    hn _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, by simp⟩)
  simp [lap, nbrSumZ, hux, hp, hm]

theorem stabilizes_transfer {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x) :
    Stabilizes η' ξ w := by
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    have hx : w[k] ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w) :=
      mem_affected_of_list (List.getElem_mem hk)
    simpa [initial, heq _ hx] using hw.1 k hk
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w)
    · simpa [initial, heq x hx] using hw.2 x
    · have hz := count_zero_outside_affected hx
      rw [lap_zero_outside_affected hx]
      simp only [initial, hz.1, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
      exact ⟨by positivity, by exact_mod_cast (η' x).isLt⟩

theorem stabilizes_iff_of_agree {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x) :
    Stabilizes η' ξ w ↔ Stabilizes η ξ w :=
  ⟨fun h => stabilizes_transfer h (fun x hx => (heq x hx).symm),
    fun h => stabilizes_transfer h heq⟩

def WiredStabilizes (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (V : Finset Site2)
    (w : List Site2) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ V) ∧ LegalList (initial η ξ) w ∧
    ∀ x ∈ V, 0 ≤ initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x ∧
      initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4

theorem stabilizes_transfer_wired {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x)
    (V : Finset Site2) (hV : affected ξ (listCounts w) ⊆ V) :
    WiredStabilizes η' ξ V w := by
  have ht := stabilizes_transfer hw heq
  exact ⟨fun x hx => hV (mem_affected_of_list hx), ht.1, fun x _ => ht.2 x⟩

theorem prefix_zero_of_not_mem {w : List Site2} {x : Site2} (hx : x ∉ w) (k : ℕ) :
    prefixCounts w k x = 0 := by
  simp only [prefixCounts, Nat.cast_eq_zero]
  exact List.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem (fun h => hx (List.mem_of_mem_take h))

theorem wired_legalList_le {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2} (h : LegalList s w)
    (V : Finset Site2) (hwV : ∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ V)
    (v : Counts) (hv : ∀ x ∈ V, s x + lap (fun y => (v y : ℤ)) x < 4) :
    ∀ k x, prefixCounts w k x ≤ (v x : ℤ) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro x; rw [prefix_zero]; exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x
    rcases h.isLegalToppling.2 k x with he | ⟨he, htop⟩
    · rw [he]; exact ih x
    · rw [he]
      have hxw : x ∈ w := by
        by_contra hxw
        have h0 := prefix_zero_of_not_mem hxw k
        have h1 := prefix_zero_of_not_mem hxw (k + 1)
        omega
      by_contra hlt
      have hx : prefixCounts w k x = (v x : ℤ) := le_antisymm (ih x) (by omega)
      have hl := lap_le_lap_of_le ih hx
      have hs := hv x (hwV x hxw)
      norm_num at htop
      omega

theorem wiredStabilizes_counts_unique {η : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {V : Finset Site2}
    {w v : List Site2} (hw : WiredStabilizes η ξ V w)
    (hv : WiredStabilizes η ξ V v) : listCounts w = listCounts v := by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro x
  have h1 := wired_legalList_le hw.2.1 V hw.1 (listCounts v)
    (fun y hy => (hv.2.2 y hy).2) w.length x
  have h2 := wired_legalList_le hv.2.1 V hv.1 (listCounts w)
    (fun y hy => (hw.2.2 y hy).2) v.length x
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at h1
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal v v.length le_rfl] at h2
  change (listCounts w x : ℤ) ≤ (listCounts v x : ℤ) at h1
  change (listCounts v x : ℤ) ≤ (listCounts w x : ℤ) at h2
  exact_mod_cast le_antisymm h1 h2

theorem finite_determination_counts {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x) :
    (Stabilizes η' ξ w ∧
      ∀ v, Stabilizes η' ξ v → listCounts v = listCounts w) ∧
    ∀ V : Finset Site2, affected ξ (listCounts w) ⊆ V →
      WiredStabilizes η' ξ V w ∧
        ∀ v, WiredStabilizes η' ξ V v → listCounts v = listCounts w := by
  have ht := stabilizes_transfer hw heq
  refine ⟨⟨ht, fun _ hv => stabilizes_counts_unique hv ht⟩, ?_⟩
  intro V hV
  have htV := stabilizes_transfer_wired hw heq V hV
  exact ⟨htV, fun _ hv => wiredStabilizes_counts_unique hv htV⟩

theorem exists_domain_odometer_eq (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ)
    (η' : StableField)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (odometer ξ η), η' x = η.val x) :
    ∃ ζ : StabilizationDomain ξ, ζ.val = η' ∧ odometer ξ ζ = odometer ξ η := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := odometer_spec ξ η
  have ht : Stabilizes η' ξ w :=
    stabilizes_transfer hw (by simpa [he] using heq)
  refine ⟨⟨η', w, ht⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact (odometer_eq_counts ξ ⟨η', w, ht⟩ ht).trans he


end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

import FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTermination

/-! The wired Laplacian retains all four direction copies, including sink exits. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

/-- The actual edge copy traversed in a direction from an active vertex. -/
def directionEdge {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) : Direction → Edge R
  | (i, true) =>
      if h : inBox R (site x + unit i) then
        .inl ⟨(x, activeOfSite R (site x + unit i) h), ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
      else .inr ⟨(x, (i, true)), by simpa only [step, if_true] using h⟩
  | (i, false) =>
      if h : inBox R (site x - unit i) then
        .inl ⟨(activeOfSite R (site x - unit i) h, x), ⟨i, by
          change site x = site x - unit i + unit i
          abel⟩⟩
      else .inr ⟨(x, (i, false)), by simpa only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
        ← sub_eq_add_neg] using h⟩

theorem direction_edge_exit {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) (d : Direction)
    (hd : ¬inBox R (site x + step d)) : directionEdge x d = .inr ⟨(x, d), hd⟩ := by
  rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b <;> simp only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg] at hd ⊢ <;> simp [directionEdge, hd] <;> rfl

theorem direction_edge_exit_injective {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) {d e : Direction}
    (hd : ¬inBox R (site x + step d)) (he : ¬inBox R (site x + step e))
    (h : directionEdge x d = directionEdge x e) : d = e := by
  rw [direction_edge_exit x d hd, direction_edge_exit x e he] at h
  exact congrArg (fun z : ExitEdge R => z.val.2) (Sum.inr.inj h)

theorem conductance_direction_edge {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) (d : Direction) :
    conductance (directionEdge x d) = 1 := rfl

/-- Auxiliary zero extension of active toppling counts to the sink exterior. -/
def wiredCountExtension (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  if hx : inBox R x then u (activeOfSite R x hx) else 0

theorem wired_count_extension_site (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Active R) :
    wiredCountExtension R u (site x) = u x := by
  have hx : inBox R (site x) := fun i => (x i).property
  simp only [wiredCountExtension, dif_pos hx]
  congr 1

/-- Each direction contributes once; exterior directions are separate sink edge copies. -/
def wiredLap (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Active R) : ℤ :=
  ∑ d : Direction, (wiredCountExtension R u (site x + step d) - u x)

theorem wired_lap_eq_lap (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Active R) :
    wiredLap R u x = lap (wiredCountExtension R u) (site x) := by
  simp only [wiredLap, Direction, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool, step,
    Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, ← sub_eq_add_neg,
    lap, nbrSumZ, Fin.sum_univ_two, wired_count_extension_site]
  ring

theorem wired_count_extension_counts {R : ℕ} (u : Counts)
    (hu : u.support ⊆ boxSites R) :
    wiredCountExtension R (fun x => (u (site x) : ℤ)) = fun x => (u x : ℤ) := by
  funext x
  unfold wiredCountExtension
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i hx
    have hz : u x = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp
      (fun h => hx ((mem_box_sites R x).mp (hu h)))
    simp [hz]

theorem wired_lap_counts {R : ℕ} (u : Counts) (hu : u.support ⊆ boxSites R)
    (x : Active R) :
    wiredLap R (fun y => (u (site y) : ℤ)) x = lap (fun y => (u y : ℤ)) (site x) := by
  rw [wired_lap_eq_lap, wired_count_extension_counts u hu]


end
end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredTrees
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredLaplacian

/-! A literal spanning tree: every row follows its positive first-coordinate copies to the sink. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

noncomputable def rowEdge {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : FiniteWired.Edge N :=
  FiniteWired.directionEdge x (0, true)

noncomputable def rowEdges (N : ℕ) : Finset (FiniteWired.Edge N) :=
  Finset.univ.image rowEdge

theorem shifted_in_box_iff {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) ↔ (x 0).val < N := by
  obtain ⟨h0l, h0r⟩ := (x 0).property
  obtain ⟨h1l, h1r⟩ := (x 1).property
  simp only [FiniteWired.inBox, Fin.forall_fin_two, Pi.add_apply, FiniteWired.site,
    LatticeProb.unit, Pi.single_apply, ite_true]
  norm_num
  omega

theorem row_edge_endpoints {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x) =
      if h : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) then
        (some x, some (FiniteWired.activeOfSite N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) h))
      else (some x, none) := by
  by_cases h : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0)
  · simp [rowEdge, FiniteWired.directionEdge, h, FiniteWired.endpoints]
  · simp [rowEdge, FiniteWired.directionEdge, h, FiniteWired.endpoints]

theorem row_edge_left {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (graph N).left (rowEdge x) = some x := by
  change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).1 = some x
  rw [row_edge_endpoints]
  split <;> rfl

theorem row_edge_mem {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : rowEdge x ∈ rowEdges N :=
  Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

private theorem active_eq_of_coordinates {N : ℕ} {x y : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (h0 : (y 0).val = (x 0).val) (h1 : (y 1).val = (x 1).val) : y = x := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact Subtype.ext h0
  · exact Subtype.ext h1

/-- The vertices separated from the sink by deletion of the outgoing copy at x. -/
def prefixRow {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N) :=
  {v | match v with
    | none => False
    | some y => (y 1).val = (x 1).val ∧ (y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val}

theorem row_edge_right_not_mem {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (graph N).right (rowEdge x) ∉ prefixRow x := by
  change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).2 ∉ prefixRow x
  rw [row_edge_endpoints]
  split
  · simp only [prefixRow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, FiniteWired.activeOfSite, FiniteWired.site,
      Pi.add_apply, LatticeProb.unit, Pi.single_apply]
    norm_num
  · simp [prefixRow]

theorem other_row_edge_same_side {N : ℕ} (x y : FiniteWired.Active N) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    (graph N).left (rowEdge y) ∈ prefixRow x ↔
      (graph N).right (rowEdge y) ∈ prefixRow x := by
  have hn : ¬ ((y 1).val = (x 1).val ∧ (y 0).val = (x 0).val) :=
    fun h => hne (active_eq_of_coordinates h.2 h.1)
  change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge y)).1 ∈ prefixRow x ↔
    (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge y)).2 ∈ prefixRow x
  rw [row_edge_endpoints]
  split
  · simp only [prefixRow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, FiniteWired.activeOfSite, FiniteWired.site,
      Pi.add_apply, LatticeProb.unit, Pi.single_apply]
    norm_num
    intro hrow
    change (y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val ↔ (y 0).val < (x 0).val
    have hneq := fun h => hn ⟨hrow, h⟩
    omega
  · rename_i hy
    have hb : (y 0).val = N := by
      have h := (shifted_in_box_iff y).not.mp hy
      have hle := (y 0).property.2
      omega
    have hx := (x 0).property.2
    simp only [prefixRow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨hrow, hle⟩
    exact hn ⟨hrow, by omega⟩

theorem row_edges_is_forest (N : ℕ) : (graph N).is_forest (rowEdges N) := by
  intro e he hreach
  obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
  have hside : ∀ f ∈ (rowEdges N).erase (rowEdge x),
      (graph N).left f ∈ prefixRow x ↔ (graph N).right f ∈ prefixRow x := by
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hf)
    apply other_row_edge_same_side x y
    intro h
    apply (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1
    rw [h]
  have hsame := (graph N).reaches_mem_iff hside hreach
  have hl : (graph N).left (rowEdge x) ∈ prefixRow x := by
    rw [row_edge_left]
    exact ⟨rfl, le_rfl⟩
  exact row_edge_right_not_mem x (hsame.mp hl)

theorem row_reaches_sink {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (graph N).reaches (rowEdges N) (some x) none := by
  have hall (d : ℕ) : ∀ x : FiniteWired.Active N,
      ((N : ℤ) - (x 0).val).toNat = d →
        (graph N).reaches (rowEdges N) (some x) none := by
    induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h d ih =>
      intro x hd
      by_cases hx : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0)
      · let y := FiniteWired.activeOfSite N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) hx
        have hy : (y 0).val = (x 0).val + 1 := by simp [y, FiniteWired.activeOfSite, FiniteWired.site, LatticeProb.unit]
        have hlt : ((N : ℤ) - (y 0).val).toNat < d := by
          have h := (shifted_in_box_iff x).mp hx
          rw [hy]
          omega
        have hstep : (graph N).adjacent (rowEdges N) (some x) (some y) := by
          refine ⟨rowEdge x, row_edge_mem x, Or.inl ⟨row_edge_left x, ?_⟩⟩
          change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).2 = some y
          rw [row_edge_endpoints, dif_pos hx]
        exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hstep).trans (ih _ hlt y rfl)
      · apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        refine ⟨rowEdge x, row_edge_mem x, Or.inl ⟨row_edge_left x, ?_⟩⟩
        change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).2 = none
        rw [row_edge_endpoints, dif_neg hx]
  exact hall _ x rfl

theorem row_edges_is_tree (N : ℕ) : (graph N).is_tree Set.univ (rowEdges N) := by
  have hr (v : FiniteWired.Vertex N) : (graph N).reaches (rowEdges N) v none := by
    cases v with
    | none => exact .refl
    | some x => exact row_reaches_sink x
  exact ⟨⟨none, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (fun _ _ => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_univ _⟩),
    (fun x _ y _ => (hr x).trans ((graph N).reaches_symm (hr y))), row_edges_is_forest N⟩

/-- A genuine ordinary copied-edge spanning tree, also in the radius-zero box. -/
noncomputable def rowTree (N : ℕ) : (graph N).SpanningTree := ⟨rowEdges N, row_edges_is_tree N⟩

instance spanningTreeNonempty (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (graph N).SpanningTree := ⟨rowTree N⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.JoiningCounts
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.FiniteWired

/-! The exact joining count on the project's literal wired box and exit-copy carrier. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

/-- Original interior copies and directional exit copies, with the literal sink `none`. -/
noncomputable def graph (N : ℕ) : Multigraph (FiniteWired.Vertex N) (FiniteWired.Edge N) :=
  Multigraph.ofEndpoints FiniteWired.endpoints FiniteWired.endpoints_ne

/-- Exact ordinary-tree cardinal count on the canonical wired endpoint representation. -/
theorem card_ancestorPastTree (N : ℕ) (C S : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N))
    (hr : none ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hSC : S ⊆ C)
    (t : (graph N).ComponentTree C) :
    Fintype.card ((graph N).AncestorPastTree C S none hS t) =
      Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree Cᶜ) *
        ∑ v ∈ ((graph N).componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset,
          ((graph N).crossingAt C v).card := by
  rw [(graph N).card_ancestorPastTree none hr hS t hSC,
    (graph N).card_admissibleEdges C _ ((graph N).componentSpan_subset t S hSC)]

/-- Cancellation uses the common real mass without identifying any sandpile law. -/
theorem reciprocal_ancestorPastTree (N : ℕ) (C S : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N))
    (hr : none ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hSC : S ⊆ C)
    (t : (graph N).ComponentTree C) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ u : (graph N).AncestorPastTree C S none hS t,
      c / ((graph N).admissibleEdges C ((graph N).span u.val S)).card) =
      if ((graph N).admissibleEdges C ((graph N).componentSpan t S hSC)).Nonempty then
        c * Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree Cᶜ) else 0 :=
  (graph N).reciprocal_ancestorPastTree none hr hS t hSC c

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees

import FiniteAvalanches.Model.LegalLists

/-! Literal one-grain avalanche observables on the square lattice. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches

open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
open scoped Classical

/-- One natural-valued grain at the specified source. -/
noncomputable def oneGrain (o : Site2) : Counts := Finsupp.single o 1

theorem initial_oneGrain (η : StableField) (o x : Site2) :
    initial η (oneGrain o) x = ((η x).val : ℤ) + dirac o x := by
  by_cases h : x = o <;> simp [initial, oneGrain, dirac, h]

/-- Existence of a finite ordered legal list stabilizing the one-grain input. -/
def FiniteStabilizable (η : StableField) (o : Site2) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : List Site2, Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) w

theorem existsUnique_odometer {η : StableField} {o : Site2}
    (h : FiniteStabilizable η o) :
    ∃! u : Counts, ∃ w, Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) w ∧ listCounts w = u :=
  existsUnique_counts h

/-- The exact domain on which the one-grain odometer exists. -/
abbrev StabilizableField (o : Site2) := {η : StableField // FiniteStabilizable η o}

/-- The unique finite natural count, using the already proved list-count uniqueness. -/
noncomputable def avalancheOdometer (o : Site2) (η : StabilizableField o) : Counts :=
  odometer (oneGrain o) η

theorem avalancheOdometer_spec (o : Site2) (η : StabilizableField o) :
    ∃ w, Stabilizes η.val (oneGrain o) w ∧ listCounts w = avalancheOdometer o η :=
  odometer_spec (oneGrain o) η

theorem avalancheOdometer_eq_counts (o : Site2) (η : StabilizableField o)
    {w : List Site2} (hw : Stabilizes η.val (oneGrain o) w) :
    avalancheOdometer o η = listCounts w :=
  odometer_eq_counts (oneGrain o) η hw

/-- The integer lattice sup distance, represented in naturals without rounding. -/
def siteRadius (o x : Site2) : ℕ :=
  Finset.univ.sup (fun i : Fin 2 => (x i - o i).natAbs)

theorem siteRadius_le_iff (o x : Site2) (r : ℕ) :
    siteRadius o x ≤ r ↔ ∀ i : Fin 2, |x i - o i| ≤ (r : ℤ) := by
  simp only [siteRadius, Finset.sup_le_iff, Finset.mem_univ, forall_const]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro i
  rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs]
  exact (Nat.cast_le (α := ℤ)).symm

/-- Maximum radius of the positive count support; the empty maximum is zero. -/
noncomputable def countsRadius (o : Site2) (u : Counts) : ℕ :=
  u.support.sup (siteRadius o)

theorem countsRadius_le_iff (o : Site2) (u : Counts) (r : ℕ) :
    countsRadius o u ≤ r ↔ ∀ x, 0 < u x → siteRadius o x ≤ r := by
  simp only [countsRadius, Finset.sup_le_iff, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

theorem countsRadius_attained (o : Site2) (u : Counts) (hu : u.support.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x, 0 < u x ∧ countsRadius o u = siteRadius o x := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := Finset.sup_mem_of_nonempty (f := siteRadius o) hu
  exact ⟨x, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx), he.symm⟩

/-- Source radius, with infinity exactly when no finite legal stabilization exists. -/
noncomputable def radius (η : StableField) (o : Site2) : WithTop ℕ :=
  if h : FiniteStabilizable η o then
    (countsRadius o (avalancheOdometer o ⟨η, h⟩) : WithTop ℕ)
  else ⊤

/-- Source total topplings, with the same infinity convention. -/
noncomputable def totalTopplings (η : StableField) (o : Site2) : WithTop ℕ :=
  if h : FiniteStabilizable η o then
    (((avalancheOdometer o ⟨η, h⟩).sum (fun _ n => n) : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ)
  else ⊤

theorem radius_of_stabilizes {η : StableField} {o : Site2} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) w) :
    radius η o = (countsRadius o (listCounts w) : WithTop ℕ) := by
  have h : FiniteStabilizable η o := ⟨w, hw⟩
  simp only [radius, dif_pos h]
  rw [avalancheOdometer_eq_counts o ⟨η, h⟩ hw]

theorem totalTopplings_of_stabilizes {η : StableField} {o : Site2} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) w) :
    totalTopplings η o = (w.length : WithTop ℕ) := by
  have h : FiniteStabilizable η o := ⟨w, hw⟩
  simp only [totalTopplings, dif_pos h]
  rw [avalancheOdometer_eq_counts o ⟨η, h⟩ hw, listCounts_total]

theorem radius_eq_top_iff (η : StableField) (o : Site2) :
    radius η o = ⊤ ↔ ¬ FiniteStabilizable η o := by
  by_cases h : FiniteStabilizable η o <;> simp [radius, h]

theorem totalTopplings_eq_top_iff (η : StableField) (o : Site2) :
    totalTopplings η o = ⊤ ↔ ¬ FiniteStabilizable η o := by
  by_cases h : FiniteStabilizable η o
  · rw [totalTopplings, dif_pos h]
    exact iff_of_false WithTop.coe_ne_top (not_not.mpr h)
  · rw [totalTopplings, dif_neg h]
    exact iff_of_true rfl h

theorem radius_of_empty {η : StableField} {o : Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) []) : radius η o = 0 := by
  rw [radius_of_stabilizes hw]
  simp [countsRadius, listCounts_support]

theorem totalTopplings_of_empty {η : StableField} {o : Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) []) : totalTopplings η o = 0 := by
  simpa using totalTopplings_of_stabilizes hw

theorem list_observables_eq {η : StableField} {o : Site2} {w v : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) w) (hv : Stabilizes η (oneGrain o) v) :
    countsRadius o (listCounts w) = countsRadius o (listCounts v) ∧ w.length = v.length := by
  have hc := stabilizes_counts_unique hw hv
  refine ⟨congrArg (countsRadius o) hc, ?_⟩
  rw [← listCounts_total w, ← listCounts_total v, hc]

theorem measurableSet_height_test (x : Site2) (P : Fin 4 → Prop) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField | P (η x)} :=
  (Set.toFinite {a : Fin 4 | P a}).measurableSet.preimage (measurable_pi_apply x)

theorem stableField_borelSpace : BorelSpace StableField := inferInstance

theorem measurableSet_stabilizes (ξ : Counts) (w : List Site2) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField | Stabilizes η ξ w} := by
  have hl : MeasurableSet {η : StableField | LegalList (initial η ξ) w} := by
    simp only [LegalList, Set.setOf_forall]
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro k
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro hk
    exact measurableSet_height_test w[k]
      (fun a => 4 ≤ (a.val : ℤ) + (ξ w[k] : ℤ) + lap (prefixCounts w k) w[k])
  have hf : MeasurableSet {η : StableField | ∀ x,
      0 ≤ initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x ∧
        initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4} := by
    simp only [Set.setOf_forall]
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro x
    exact measurableSet_height_test x (fun a =>
      0 ≤ (a.val : ℤ) + (ξ x : ℤ) + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x ∧
        (a.val : ℤ) + (ξ x : ℤ) + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4)
  exact hl.inter hf

theorem measurableSet_finiteStabilizable (o : Site2) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField | FiniteStabilizable η o} := by
  simp only [FiniteStabilizable, Set.setOf_exists]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun w => measurableSet_stabilizes (oneGrain o) w)


end FiniteAvalanches

import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredTreeExistence
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.ReciprocalBounds
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Positivity

/-! The complete joining count and global reciprocal identity on literal wired tree probability. -/
open scoped Classical ENNReal
open MeasureTheory
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

/-- Actual uniform probability on unmarked copied-edge spanning trees of the wired box. -/
noncomputable def law (N : ℕ) : Measure (graph N).SpanningTree := (graph N).treeLaw

instance law_probability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (law N) :=
  (graph N).treeLaw_probability

/-- Tree count tau_N, with positivity supplied by the explicit row tree. -/
noncomputable def treeCount (N : ℕ) : ℕ := Fintype.card (graph N).SpanningTree

theorem treeCount_pos (N : ℕ) : 0 < treeCount N := Fintype.card_pos

/-- The positive-support range is exactly the positive normalized component-tree product. -/
theorem product_mass_pos_iff (N : ℕ) (C : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N)) :
    0 < (Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree C) : ℝ) *
      Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree Cᶜ) / treeCount N ↔
      0 < Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree C) ∧
        0 < Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree Cᶜ) :=
  (graph N).tree_product_mass_pos_iff C

noncomputable def reciprocal (N : ℕ) (S : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (graph N).SpanningTree → ℝ := (graph N).reciprocalWeight none S hS 1

/-- Exact event probability, with no assumed tree inhabitance and every sink copy retained. -/
theorem joining_probability (N : ℕ) (C S : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N))
    (hr : none ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (t : (graph N).ComponentTree C) :
    (law N).real {u | (graph N).descendants u none ((graph N).ancestorOf u none S hS) = C ∧
      (graph N).internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / treeCount N *
        (∑ v ∈ ((graph N).componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset,
          ((graph N).crossingAt C v).card) :=
  (graph N).treeLaw_real_ancestorPastTree none hr hS t hSC

/-- The past formulation is precisely the manuscript event on its nonroot carrier. -/
theorem joining_probability_past (N : ℕ) (C S : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N))
    (hr : none ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (t : (graph N).ComponentTree C) :
    (law N).real {u | ∃ hne : (graph N).ancestorOf u none S hS ≠ none,
      (graph N).past u none ((graph N).ancestorOf u none S hS) hne = C ∧
        (graph N).internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / treeCount N *
        (∑ v ∈ ((graph N).componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset,
          ((graph N).crossingAt C v).card) := by
  have he : {u : (graph N).SpanningTree |
      (graph N).descendants u none ((graph N).ancestorOf u none S hS) = C ∧
        (graph N).internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      {u | ∃ hne : (graph N).ancestorOf u none S hS ≠ none,
        (graph N).past u none ((graph N).ancestorOf u none S hS) hne = C ∧
          (graph N).internalEdges C u.val = t.val} := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, (graph N).event_iff_past hr hS u, exists_and_right]
  rw [← he]
  exact joining_probability N C S hr hS hSC t

/-- Every ordinary tree has the common mass tau_N^-1. -/
theorem law_singleton (N : ℕ) (u : (graph N).SpanningTree) :
    law N {u} = (treeCount N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  change ((Nat.card (graph N).SpanningTree : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ •
    (Measure.count : Measure (graph N).SpanningTree)) {u} = _
  rw [Measure.smul_apply]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_singleton, mul_one]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  rfl

/-- The global identity uses actual inside-tree probability and the common mass tau_N^-1.
Its product coefficient is a tree count; sandpile shape identification is a separate proof. -/
theorem reciprocal_identity (N : ℕ) (S : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (∫ u, reciprocal N S hS u ∂law N) =
      ∑ C : (graph N).PositiveSupport none S,
        ((Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree C.val) : ℝ) *
          Fintype.card ((graph N).ComponentTree C.valᶜ) / treeCount N) *
            ((graph N).componentLaw C).real ((graph N).insideContact C) :=
  (graph N).integral_reciprocalWeight none S hS

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees

import FiniteAvalanches.Model.LegalLists
import FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Observables
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.FiniteWired

/-! Legal single-site topplings in wired square boxes. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

/-- The active vertices of the literal wired box, as lattice sites. -/
def boxSites (R : ℕ) : Finset Site2 := Finset.univ.image (@FiniteWired.site R)

theorem mem_box_sites (R : ℕ) (x : Site2) :
    x ∈ boxSites R ↔ FiniteWired.inBox R x := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact fun i => (y i).property
  · intro hx
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨FiniteWired.activeOfSite R x hx,
      Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

/-- A quadratic barrier before restriction to the wired box. -/
def quadraticBarrier (R K : ℕ) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  K * (((R : ℤ) + 1)^2 - (x 0)^2)

theorem quadratic_barrier_nonneg {R K : ℕ} {x : Site2}
    (hx : -(R : ℤ) - 1 ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ (R : ℤ) + 1) :
    0 ≤ quadraticBarrier R K x := by
  have hs : 0 ≤ ((R : ℤ) + 1 - x 0) * ((R : ℤ) + 1 + x 0) :=
    mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
  unfold quadraticBarrier
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg K) (by nlinarith only [hs])

theorem lap_quadratic_barrier (R K : ℕ) (x : Site2) :
    lap (quadraticBarrier R K) x = -2 * K := by
  simp [lap, nbrSumZ, Fin.sum_univ_two, quadraticBarrier, unit, Pi.single_apply]
  ring

/-- The barrier vanishes outside the active box, as a natural count field. -/
def boxBarrier (R K : ℕ) : Counts :=
  Finsupp.onFinset (boxSites R)
    (fun x => if x ∈ boxSites R then (quadraticBarrier R K x).toNat else 0)
    (by intro x hx; by_contra hn; simp [hn] at hx)

theorem box_barrier_apply_inside {R K : ℕ} {x : Site2} (hx : x ∈ boxSites R) :
    (boxBarrier R K x : ℤ) = quadraticBarrier R K x := by
  have hb := (mem_box_sites R x).mp hx 0
  simp only [boxBarrier, Finsupp.onFinset_apply, if_pos hx]
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (quadratic_barrier_nonneg (by omega))

theorem box_barrier_apply_outside {R K : ℕ} {x : Site2} (hx : x ∉ boxSites R) :
    boxBarrier R K x = 0 := by simp [boxBarrier, hx]

theorem box_barrier_le_quadratic_barrier {R K : ℕ} {x : Site2}
    (hx : -(R : ℤ) - 1 ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ (R : ℤ) + 1) :
    (boxBarrier R K x : ℤ) ≤ quadraticBarrier R K x := by
  by_cases hi : x ∈ boxSites R
  · exact le_of_eq (box_barrier_apply_inside hi)
  · rw [box_barrier_apply_outside hi, Nat.cast_zero]
    exact quadratic_barrier_nonneg hx

theorem lap_box_barrier_le {R K : ℕ} {x : Site2} (hx : x ∈ boxSites R) :
    lap (fun y => (boxBarrier R K y : ℤ)) x ≤ -2 * K := by
  have hb := (mem_box_sites R x).mp hx 0
  have hp (i : Fin 2) :
      (boxBarrier R K (x + unit i) : ℤ) ≤ quadraticBarrier R K (x + unit i) := by
    apply box_barrier_le_quadratic_barrier
    fin_cases i <;> simp [unit] <;> omega
  have hm (i : Fin 2) :
      (boxBarrier R K (x - unit i) : ℤ) ≤ quadraticBarrier R K (x - unit i) := by
    apply box_barrier_le_quadratic_barrier
    fin_cases i <;> simp [unit] <;> omega
  calc
    lap (fun y => (boxBarrier R K y : ℤ)) x ≤ lap (quadraticBarrier R K) x := by
      simp only [lap, nbrSumZ, box_barrier_apply_inside hx]
      exact sub_le_sub_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => add_le_add (hp i) (hm i))) _
    _ = -2 * K := lap_quadratic_barrier R K x

theorem legal_list_counts_le_box_barrier {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : LegalList s w) (R K : ℕ) (hwR : ∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ boxSites R)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ boxSites R, s x < 4 + 2 * K) :
    ∀ x, listCounts w x ≤ boxBarrier R K x := by
  intro x
  have h := wired_legalList_le hw (boxSites R) hwR (boxBarrier R K)
    (fun y hy => by have hb := lap_box_barrier_le (K := K) hy; linarith [hs y hy])
    w.length x
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at h
  change (listCounts w x : ℤ) ≤ (boxBarrier R K x : ℤ) at h
  exact_mod_cast h

theorem list_length_le_box_barrier {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : LegalList s w) (R K : ℕ) (hwR : ∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ boxSites R)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ boxSites R, s x < 4 + 2 * K) :
    w.length ≤ (boxBarrier R K).sum (fun _ n => n) := by
  rw [← listCounts_total]
  exact Finsupp.sum_le_sum_index (legal_list_counts_le_box_barrier hw R K hwR hs)
    (fun _ _ => monotone_id) (fun _ _ => rfl)

theorem legal_list_append_singleton {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : LegalList s w) (x : Site2)
    (hx : 4 ≤ s x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x) :
    LegalList s (w ++ [x]) := by
  intro k hk
  by_cases hkw : k < w.length
  · have ht : prefixCounts (w ++ [x]) k = prefixCounts w k := by
      funext y
      simp only [prefixCounts, List.take_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_of_lt hkw)]
    simpa only [List.getElem_append_left hkw, ht] using hw k hkw
  · have he : k = w.length := by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hk; omega
    subst k
    have ht : prefixCounts (w ++ [x]) w.length = fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ) := by
      rw [show prefixCounts (w ++ [x]) w.length = prefixCounts w w.length from by
        funext y; simp [prefixCounts]]
      exact prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl
    simpa [ht] using hx

/-- Every bounded input admits a finite legal wired stabilization. -/
theorem exists_legal_list_stable_in_box (s : Site2 → ℤ) (R K : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ boxSites R, s x < 4 + 2 * K) :
    ∃ w : List Site2, (∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ boxSites R) ∧ LegalList s w ∧
      ∀ x ∈ boxSites R, s x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4 := by
  let P (n : ℕ) := ∃ w : List Site2, w.length = n ∧
    (∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ boxSites R) ∧ LegalList s w
  let B := (boxBarrier R K).sum (fun _ n => n)
  have h0 : P 0 := ⟨[], rfl, by simp, by intro k hk; simp at hk⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hwlen, hwR, hw⟩ := Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := P) (Nat.zero_le B) h0
  refine ⟨w, hwR, hw, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_contra hn
  have hw' := legal_list_append_singleton hw x (by omega)
  have hwR' : ∀ y ∈ w ++ [x], y ∈ boxSites R := by
    intro y hy
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hy with hy | hy
    · exact hwR y hy
    · simpa using (List.mem_singleton.mp hy) ▸ hx
  have hb : (w ++ [x]).length ≤ B := list_length_le_box_barrier hw' R K hwR' hs
  have hp : P (w ++ [x]).length := ⟨w ++ [x], rfl, hwR', hw'⟩
  have hm := Nat.le_findGreatest (P := P) hb hp
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hm
  omega

theorem exists_wired_stabilizes (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (R : ℕ) :
    ∃ w, WiredStabilizes η ξ (boxSites R) w := by
  let K := 4 + ξ.sum (fun _ n => n)
  have hξ (x : Site2) : ξ x ≤ ξ.sum (fun _ n => n) := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ ξ.support
    · exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => Nat.zero_le (ξ y)) hx
    · simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx]
  obtain ⟨w, hwR, hw, ht⟩ := exists_legal_list_stable_in_box (initial η ξ) R K
    (fun x _ => by
      have hη := (η x).isLt
      have hb := hξ x
      dsimp [initial, K]
      omega)
  refine ⟨w, hwR, hw, fun x hx => ⟨?_, ht x hx⟩⟩
  have hn := hw.heights_nonneg (initial_nonneg η ξ) w.length x
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at hn
  exact hn

theorem card_box_sites (R : ℕ) : (boxSites R).card = (2 * R + 1)^2 := by
  rw [boxSites, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (FiniteWired.site_injective R),
    Finset.card_univ]
  simp only [FiniteWired.Active, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_Icc,
    Int.card_Icc]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem box_barrier_le (R K : ℕ) (x : Site2) : boxBarrier R K x ≤ K * (R + 1)^2 := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ boxSites R
  · have he := box_barrier_apply_inside (K := K) hx
    have hn : (boxBarrier R K x : ℤ) ≤ (K : ℤ) * ((R : ℤ) + 1)^2 := by
      rw [he]
      unfold quadraticBarrier
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith only [sq_nonneg (x 0)])
        (Nat.cast_nonneg K)
    exact_mod_cast hn
  · rw [box_barrier_apply_outside hx]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem sum_box_barrier_le (R K : ℕ) :
    (boxBarrier R K).sum (fun _ n => n) ≤ K * (R + 1)^2 * (2 * R + 1)^2 := by
  rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset (boxBarrier R K)
    (show (boxBarrier R K).support ⊆ boxSites R from Finsupp.support_onFinset_subset)
    (fun _ n => n) (fun _ _ => rfl)]
  calc
    ∑ x ∈ boxSites R, boxBarrier R K x ≤ ∑ _x ∈ boxSites R, K * (R + 1)^2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => box_barrier_le R K x)
    _ = K * (R + 1)^2 * (2 * R + 1)^2 := by
      simp [card_box_sites, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem initial_one_grain_le_four (η : StableField) (o x : Site2) :
    initial η (FiniteAvalanches.oneGrain o) x ≤ 4 := by
  rw [FiniteAvalanches.initial_oneGrain]
  have hη := (η x).isLt
  simp only [dirac]
  split <;> omega

/-- Every legal list confined to a box has the manuscript's explicit count bound. -/
theorem one_grain_legal_list_box_bound (η : StableField) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ)
    {w : List Site2} (hw : LegalList (initial η (FiniteAvalanches.oneGrain o)) w)
    (hwR : ∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ boxSites R) :
    (∀ x, listCounts w x ≤ 2 * (R + 1)^2) ∧ w.length ≤ 8 * (R + 1)^4 := by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ boxSites R, initial η (FiniteAvalanches.oneGrain o) x < 4 + 2 * (2 : ℕ) :=
    fun x _ => by have h := initial_one_grain_le_four η o x; norm_num; omega
  have hu := legal_list_counts_le_box_barrier hw R 2 hwR hs
  refine ⟨fun x => (hu x).trans (box_barrier_le R 2 x), ?_⟩
  calc
    w.length ≤ (boxBarrier R 2).sum (fun _ n => n) := list_length_le_box_barrier hw R 2 hwR hs
    _ ≤ 2 * (R + 1)^2 * (2 * R + 1)^2 := sum_box_barrier_le R 2
    _ ≤ 8 * (R + 1)^4 := by
      have h : (2 * R + 1)^2 ≤ (2 * (R + 1))^2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) 2
      calc
        2 * (R + 1)^2 * (2 * R + 1)^2 ≤ 2 * (R + 1)^2 * (2 * (R + 1))^2 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h
        _ = 8 * (R + 1)^4 := by ring


end

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.CopiedEdges
public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths

@[expose] public section

/-! Rooted joining geometry on ordinary copied-edge spanning-tree subsets. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Ordinary spanning trees are actual subsets of the original edge-copy carrier. -/
abbrev SpanningTree := G.ComponentTree Set.univ

/-- Descendants, including the vertex itself, defined by the unique actual rooted path. -/
def descendants (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) : Set V :=
  {x | ancestor (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r a x}

/-- The actual lowest common ancestor of a nonempty marked set in an ordinary tree. -/
noncomputable def ancestorOf (t : G.SpanningTree) (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) : V :=
  commonAncestor (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r S hS

/-- The actual connecting subtree, independent of the root. -/
def span (t : G.SpanningTree) (S : Set V) : Set V :=
  connectingSubtree (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) S

theorem walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem {t : Finset E} {e : E} {a x y : V}
    (hae : G.left e = a ∨ G.right e = a) (p : (G.toSimple t).Walk x y)
    (ha : a ∉ p.support) : G.reaches (t.erase e) x y := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact .refl
  | @cons x z y hxz q ih =>
    have haq : a ∉ q.support := fun h => ha (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    have hax : a ≠ x := fun h => ha (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
    have haz : a ≠ z := fun h => haq (h ▸ q.start_mem_support)
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.head _ (ih haq)
    rcases hxz with ⟨f, hf, h | h⟩
    · refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, Or.inl h⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      rcases hae with hae | hae
      · exact hax (hae.symm.trans h.1)
      · exact haz (hae.symm.trans h.2)
    · refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, Or.inr h⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      rcases hae with hae | hae
      · exact haz (hae.symm.trans h.2)
      · exact hax (hae.symm.trans h.1)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem walk_mem_side {C : Set V} {t : Finset E}
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C)
    {x y : V} (p : (G.toSimple t).Walk x y) (hx : x ∈ C) :
    ∀ z ∈ p.support, z ∈ C := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro z hz; simpa using (List.mem_singleton.mp hz) ▸ hx
  | @cons x v y h q ih =>
    have hv : v ∈ C := (G.reaches_mem_iff ht (Relation.ReflTransGen.single h)).mp hx
    intro z hz
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
    · exact hx
    · exact ih hv z hz

/-- On a cut tree, the inside endpoint's descendants are exactly the cut component. -/
theorem descendants_eq_cut {C : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C) (r v : V)
    (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    G.descendants ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r v = C := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree p.property.1
  ext x
  change ancestor hT r v x ↔ x ∈ C
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hx
    have hd : G.reaches (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) r x := p.property.2.2.2.2.2 r hr x hx
    obtain ⟨q⟩ := (G.toSimple_reachable _ r x).mpr hd
    have hle : G.toSimple (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) ≤ G.toSimple p.val.1 := by
      intro a b hab
      rcases hab with ⟨e, he, h⟩
      exact ⟨e, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he, h⟩
    let q' : (G.toSimple p.val.1).Walk r x := q.mapLe hle
    have hqp : path hT r x = q'.toPath.val := path_eq hT _ q'.toPath.property
    unfold ancestor at h
    rw [hqp] at h
    have hqv : v ∈ q'.support := q'.support_toPath_subset_support h
    have hqv' : v ∈ q.support := by
      change v ∈ (q.mapLe hle).support at hqv
      rwa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support] at hqv
    have hside := G.walk_mem_side (C := Cᶜ) (fun e he => not_congr (p.property.2.2.2.1 e he)) q hr v hqv'
    exact hside hv
  · intro hx
    by_contra hnot
    have hreach := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem hve (path hT r x) hnot
    have hsame := G.reaches_mem_iff p.property.2.2.2.1 hreach
    exact hr (hsame.mpr hx)

/-- The common-ancestor descendant set equals the cut support exactly for joins at the
actual minimal connecting subtree. This is the missing joining geometry. -/
theorem ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff {C S : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C)
    (r v : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    G.descendants ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r
        (G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS) = C ↔
      v ∈ G.span ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ S := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree p.property.1
  have hvdesc := G.descendants_eq_cut p r v hr hv hve
  have hvcommon : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r v x := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ G.descendants t r v
    rw [hvdesc]
    exact hSC hx
  have hca := commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS
  have heq : G.descendants t r (G.ancestorOf t r S hS) = C ↔
      G.ancestorOf t r S hS = v := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hav : ancestor hT r (commonAncestor hT r S hS) v := by
        change v ∈ G.descendants t r (G.ancestorOf t r S hS)
        rw [h]
        exact hv
      exact ancestor_antisymm hT hav (hca.2 v hvcommon)
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      exact hvdesc
  exact heq.trans (commonAncestor_eq_iff_mem_connectingSubtree hT r S hS hvcommon)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Joining
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic

@[expose] public section

/-! Rooted geometry of literal copied-edge trees. -/
open scoped Classical

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Forget endpoints' orientation, while retaining the original copy in the domain. -/
def edge (e : E) : Sym2 V := s(G.left e, G.right e)

/-- The simple graph of an actual edge subset. Copy injectivity on forests is proved below. -/
def toSimple (t : Finset E) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj := G.adjacent t
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ h => G.adjacent_symm h⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun x h => by
    rcases h with ⟨e, _, h | h⟩
    · exact G.loopless e (h.1.trans h.2.symm)
    · exact G.loopless e (h.2.trans h.1.symm)⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem toSimple_reachable (t : Finset E) (x y : V) :
    (G.toSimple t).Reachable x y ↔ G.reaches t x y :=
  SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen _ _

theorem edge_injOn_of_is_forest {t : Finset E} (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    Set.InjOn G.edge (t : Set E) := by
  intro e he f hf hef
  by_contra hne
  apply ht e he
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
  refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, hf⟩, ?_⟩
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hef with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩

theorem toSimple_isAcyclic {t : Finset E} (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    (G.toSimple t).IsAcyclic := by
  rw [SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge]
  intro x y hxy
  rcases hxy with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
  all_goals
    rw [SimpleGraph.isBridge_iff]
    intro hr
    apply ht e he
    have hm : (G.toSimple t).deleteEdges {s(x,y)} ≤ G.toSimple (t.erase e) := by
      intro a b hab
      obtain ⟨⟨f, hf, hfab⟩, hne⟩ := hab
      refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, hfab⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      apply hne
      rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Sym2.eq_iff]
        aesop
      · rcases hfab with hfab | hfab
        · exact fun hab => G.loopless e (hfab.1.trans (hab.trans hfab.2.symm))
        · exact fun hab => G.loopless e (hfab.2.trans (hab.symm.trans hfab.1.symm))
    have hr' := (G.toSimple_reachable (t.erase e) x y).mp (hr.mono hm)
    first
    | simpa only [← h.1, ← h.2] using hr'
    | exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa only [← h.1, ← h.2] using hr')

theorem toSimple_isTree {t : Finset E} (ht : G.is_tree Set.univ t) :
    (G.toSimple t).IsTree := by
  have hne : Nonempty V := ⟨ht.1.choose⟩
  letI : Nonempty V := hne
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Connected.mk ?_, G.toSimple_isAcyclic ht.2.2.2⟩
  intro x y
  exact (G.toSimple_reachable t x y).mpr (ht.2.2.1 x (Set.mem_univ _) y (Set.mem_univ _))

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import Mathlib.Logic.Relation
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-!
Internal elementary infrastructure for copied-edge joining. Edges are elements of a finite
carrier, not endpoint pairs. A forest is an edge subset in which deleting any edge separates
its endpoints (the ordinary undirected forest criterion, including parallel-edge cycles).
No sandpile, burning, ancestor, or probability conclusion is assumed here.
-/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees

structure Multigraph (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V
  loopless : ∀ e, left e ≠ right e

/-- Adapter for a literal finite edge-copy carrier with ordered endpoint pairs. -/
def Multigraph.ofEndpoints {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (ends : E → V × V) (hne : ∀ e, (ends e).1 ≠ (ends e).2) : Multigraph V E :=
  ⟨fun e => (ends e).1, fun e => (ends e).2, hne⟩

open scoped Classical

namespace Multigraph

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Undirected adjacency with the individual witnessing edge copy retained. -/
def adjacent (s : Finset E) (x y : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ s, (G.left e = x ∧ G.right e = y) ∨ (G.right e = x ∧ G.left e = y)

/-- Actual finite-walk reachability, including the walk of length zero. -/
def reaches (s : Finset E) : V → V → Prop := Relation.ReflTransGen (G.adjacent s)

/-- All edges of the subset have both endpoints in the indicated support. -/
def supported (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C

/-- A forest has no edge whose endpoints remain connected after its deletion. -/
def is_forest (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ s, ¬G.reaches (s.erase e) (G.left e) (G.right e)

/-- A tree on exactly the nonempty vertex support C; isolated singleton trees are included. -/
def is_tree (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  C.Nonempty ∧ G.supported C s ∧
    (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches s x y) ∧ G.is_forest s

/-- The unique tree on a singleton support has no edges. -/
theorem is_tree_singleton_empty (a : V) : G.is_tree {a} ∅ := by
  refine ⟨⟨a, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [supported]
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
    subst x; subst y
    exact .refl
  · simp [is_forest]

theorem eq_empty_of_is_tree_singleton {a : V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : G.is_tree {a} s) : s = ∅ := by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro e he
  have h := hs.2.1 e he
  apply G.loopless e
  exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h.1).trans (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h.2).symm

/-- A crossing edge copy, in either orientation. -/
def crosses (C : Set V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  (G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.left e ∉ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem adjacent_symm {s : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.adjacent s x y) :
    G.adjacent s y x := by
  rcases h with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_symm {s : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.reaches s x y) :
    G.reaches s y x := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ h ih => exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (G.adjacent_symm h)).trans ih

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : G.reaches t x y := by
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ h => ?_) _ _ h
  rcases h with ⟨e, he, h⟩
  exact ⟨e, hst he, h⟩

theorem is_forest_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    G.is_forest s := by
  intro e he h
  apply ht e (hst he)
  exact G.reaches_mono (by intro f hf; simpa using
    (show f ≠ e ∧ f ∈ t from ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1, hst (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2⟩)) h

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_mem_iff {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : x ∈ C ↔ y ∈ C := by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ h ih =>
    rcases h with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
    · exact ih.trans (by simpa [← h.1, ← h.2] using hs e he)
    · exact ih.trans (by simpa [← h.1, ← h.2] using (hs e he).symm)

/-- The two internal edge subsets contain no crossing copies. -/
theorem supported_union_same_side {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) :
    ∀ e ∈ s ∪ t, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C := by
  intro e he
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp he with he | he
  · exact iff_of_true (hs e he).1 (hs e he).2
  · exact iff_of_false (ht e he).1 (ht e he).2

theorem crosses_not_mem {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) {e : E} (he : G.crosses C e) :
    e ∉ s ∪ t := by
  intro h
  have hside := G.supported_union_same_side hs ht e h
  rcases he with h | h
  · exact h.2 (hside.mp h.1)
  · exact h.1 (hside.mpr h.2)

/-- Collapse the opposite component to the endpoint of the joining edge. -/
noncomputable def retract (C : Set V) (a : V) (x : V) : V := if x ∈ C then x else a

theorem reaches_retract {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e f : E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ C) (hr : G.right e ∉ C) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches ((insert e (s ∪ t)).erase f) x y) :
    G.reaches (s.erase f) (retract C (G.left e) x) (retract C (G.left e) y) := by
  classical
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (retract C (G.left e)) (fun _ _ h => ?_) _ _ h
  rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hxy⟩
  have haf := (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).1
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).2 with rfl | ha
  · rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
    · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
      simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hl, if_neg hr]
      exact .refl
    · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
      simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hl, if_neg hr]
      exact .refl
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp ha with ha | ha
    · have hc := hs a ha
      rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hc.1, if_pos hc.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨haf, ha⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hc.1, if_pos hc.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨haf, ha⟩, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · have hc := ht a ha
      rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_neg hc.1, if_neg hc.2]
        exact .refl
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_neg hc.1, if_neg hc.2]
        exact .refl

/-- Joining two component trees with a crossing copy gives an ordinary spanning tree. -/
theorem is_tree_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ C) (hr : G.right e ∉ C) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (insert e (s ∪ t)) := by
  classical
  have he := G.crosses_not_mem hs.2.1 ht.2.1 (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩)
  have hcross : G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) (G.left e) (G.right e) :=
    Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have hleft (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) :
      G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) x (G.left e) :=
    G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (hs.2.2.1 x hx _ hl)
  have hright (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C) :
      G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) (G.right e) x :=
    G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (ht.2.2.1 _ hr x hx)
  refine ⟨⟨G.left e, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (by intro a ha; simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x _ y _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ C <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ C
    · exact G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (hs.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
    · exact ((hleft x hx).trans hcross).trans (hright y hy)
    · exact G.reaches_symm (((hleft y hy).trans hcross).trans (hright x hx))
    · exact G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (ht.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
  · intro f hf h
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with rfl | hf
    · have hm := G.reaches_mem_iff (G.supported_union_same_side hs.2.1 ht.2.1)
        (by simpa [Finset.erase_insert, he] using h)
      exact hr (hm.mp hl)
    · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hf with hf | hf
      · have h' := G.reaches_retract hs.2.1 ht.2.1 hl hr h
        have hc := hs.2.1 f hf
        apply hs.2.2.2 f hf
        simpa [retract, hc.1, hc.2] using h'
      · -- Reverse the chosen edge orientation and exchange the components.
        let G' : Multigraph V E := ⟨G.right, G.left, fun a => (G.loopless a).symm⟩
        have hadj (u : Finset E) : G'.adjacent u = G.adjacent u := by
          funext x y; apply propext; simp only [adjacent]; aesop
        have hreach (u : Finset E) : G'.reaches u = G.reaches u := by
          simp only [reaches, hadj]
        have hs' : G'.supported Cᶜ t := by intro a ha; exact ⟨(ht.2.1 a ha).2, (ht.2.1 a ha).1⟩
        have ht' : G'.supported (Cᶜ)ᶜ s := by
          intro a ha
          simpa [G'] using And.intro (hs.2.1 a ha).2 (hs.2.1 a ha).1
        have h' := G'.reaches_retract hs' ht' hr (by simpa using hl)
          (by simpa [hreach, Finset.union_comm] using G.reaches_symm h)
        have hc := ht.2.1 f hf
        apply ht.2.2.2 f hf
        have h'' : G.reaches (t.erase f) (G.right f) (G.left f) := by
          simpa [hreach, retract, hc.1, hc.2, G'] using h'
        exact G.reaches_symm h''

/-- Restrict an actual edge subset to the induced graph on C. -/
noncomputable def internalEdges (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Finset E :=
  s.filter (fun e => G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem supported_internalEdges (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) :
    G.supported C (G.internalEdges C s) := by
  intro e he
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_internalEdges {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ C)
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : G.reaches (G.internalEdges C s) x y := by
  have h' : y ∈ C ∧ G.reaches (G.internalEdges C s) x y := by
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨hx, .refl⟩
    | @tail z y _ h ih =>
      rcases h with ⟨e, he, hxy⟩
      have heC : G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C := by
        rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
        · have hl : G.left e ∈ C := hxy.1 ▸ ih.1
          exact ⟨hl, (hs e he).mp hl⟩
        · have hr : G.right e ∈ C := hxy.1 ▸ ih.1
          exact ⟨(hs e he).mpr hr, hr⟩
      have hy : y ∈ C := by rcases hxy with hxy | hxy; exact hxy.2 ▸ heC.2; exact hxy.2 ▸ heC.1
      exact ⟨hy, ih.2.tail ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, heC⟩, hxy⟩⟩
  exact h'.2

theorem is_tree_internalEdges {C : Set V} {s : Finset E} (hn : C.Nonempty)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches s x y) (hf : G.is_forest s) :
    G.is_tree C (G.internalEdges C s) := by
  refine ⟨hn, G.supported_internalEdges C s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact G.reaches_internalEdges hs hx (hc x hx y hy)
  · exact G.is_forest_mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hf

theorem internalEdges_union_compl {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) :
    G.internalEdges C s ∪ G.internalEdges Cᶜ s = s := by
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h) <;> exact h.1
  · intro he
    by_cases hl : G.left e ∈ C
    · exact Or.inl ⟨he, hl, (hs e he).mp hl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨he, hl, fun hr => hl ((hs e he).mpr hr)⟩

theorem internalEdges_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) :
    G.internalEdges C (s ∪ t) = s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf | hf, hl, _⟩
    · exact hf
    · exact ((ht f hf).1 hl).elim
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨Or.inl hf, hs f hf⟩

theorem internalEdges_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.internalEdges C (insert e (s ∪ t)) = s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hl, hr⟩
    rcases hf with rfl | hf | hf
    · rcases he with he | he
      · exact (he.2 hr).elim
      · exact (he.1 hl).elim
    · exact hf
    · exact ((ht f hf).1 hl).elim
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inl hf), hs f hf⟩

/-- Deleting the marked crossing copy leaves precisely the two indicated components.
The support separation and the two connectivity clauses are literal walk conditions. -/
def cut_components (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ s ∧ G.crosses C e ∧
    (∀ f ∈ s.erase e, G.left f ∈ C ↔ G.right f ∈ C) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches (s.erase e) x y) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Cᶜ, ∀ y ∈ Cᶜ, G.reaches (s.erase e) x y)

/-- Ordinary spanning trees with a marked cut whose components have supports C and Cᶜ. -/
abbrev CutTree (C : Set V) :=
  {p : Finset E × E // G.is_tree Set.univ p.1 ∧ G.cut_components C p.1 p.2}

/-- Component-tree subsets, together with an individual admissible crossing copy. -/
abbrev Joining (C : Set V) :=
  {p : Finset E × Finset E × E //
    G.is_tree C p.1 ∧ G.is_tree Cᶜ p.2.1 ∧ G.crosses C p.2.2}

theorem is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (insert e (s ∪ t)) := by
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact G.is_tree_insert_union hs ht he.1 he.2
  · rw [Finset.union_comm s t]
    exact G.is_tree_insert_union ht (by simpa using hs) he.1 (by simpa using he.2)

theorem cut_components_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.cut_components C (insert e (s ∪ t)) e := by
  have hnot := G.crosses_not_mem hs.2.1 ht.2.1 he
  have herase : (insert e (s ∪ t)).erase e = s ∪ t := by simp [hnot]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [herase] using G.supported_union_same_side hs.2.1 ht.2.1
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [herase]
    exact G.reaches_mono Finset.subset_union_left (hs.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [herase]
    exact G.reaches_mono Finset.subset_union_right (ht.2.2.1 x hx y hy)

/-- Literal insertion of the marked edge copy, with connectivity and acyclicity proved. -/
def join (C : Set V) (p : G.Joining C) : G.CutTree C :=
  ⟨(insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1), p.val.2.2),
    G.is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses p.property.1 p.property.2.1 p.property.2.2,
    G.cut_components_insert_union p.property.1 p.property.2.1 p.property.2.2⟩

/-- Delete the marked copy and recover the two induced component edge subsets. -/
noncomputable def split (C : Set V) (p : G.CutTree C) : G.Joining C := by
  let s := p.val.1.erase p.val.2
  have hs : G.is_forest s := G.is_forest_mono (Finset.erase_subset _ _) p.property.1.2.2.2
  have hside := p.property.2.2.2.1
  have hcross := p.property.2.2.1
  have hC : C.Nonempty := by
    rcases hcross with h | h
    · exact ⟨G.left p.val.2, h.1⟩
    · exact ⟨G.right p.val.2, h.2⟩
  have hD : Cᶜ.Nonempty := by
    rcases hcross with h | h
    · exact ⟨G.right p.val.2, h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨G.left p.val.2, h.1⟩
  exact ⟨(G.internalEdges C s, G.internalEdges Cᶜ s, p.val.2),
    G.is_tree_internalEdges hC hside p.property.2.2.2.2.1 hs,
    G.is_tree_internalEdges hD (fun e he => not_congr (hside e he))
      p.property.2.2.2.2.2 hs, hcross⟩

theorem split_join (C : Set V) (p : G.Joining C) : G.split C (G.join C p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := G.crosses_not_mem p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1 p.property.2.2
  change (G.internalEdges C ((insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2),
    G.internalEdges Cᶜ ((insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2), p.val.2.2) = p.val
  have herase : (insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2 =
      p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1 := by simp [he]
  have hC := G.internalEdges_union p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1
  have hD : G.internalEdges Cᶜ (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1) = p.val.2.1 := by
    rw [Finset.union_comm]
    exact G.internalEdges_union p.property.2.1.2.1 (by simpa using p.property.1.2.1)
  simp only [herase, hC, hD]

theorem join_split (C : Set V) (p : G.CutTree C) : G.join C (G.split C p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
