  change (insert p.val.2 (G.internalEdges C (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) ∪
    G.internalEdges Cᶜ (p.val.1.erase p.val.2)), p.val.2) = p.val
  rw [G.internalEdges_union_compl p.property.2.2.2.1,
    Finset.insert_erase p.property.2.1]

/-- A proved copied-edge joining equivalence, not a supplied tree-bijection hypothesis. -/
noncomputable def joiningEquiv (C : Set V) : G.Joining C ≃ G.CutTree C where
  toFun := G.join C
  invFun := G.split C
  left_inv := G.split_join C
  right_inv := G.join_split C

/-- Forgetting the mark is injective for a prescribed cut support C. -/
theorem cutTree_edges_injective (C : Set V) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : G.CutTree C => p.val.1) := by
  intro p q hpq
  change p.val.1 = q.val.1 at hpq
  have he : p.val.2 = q.val.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : q.val.2 ∈ p.val.1.erase p.val.2 :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, (by rw [hpq]; exact q.property.2.1)⟩
    have hside := p.property.2.2.2.1 _ hmem
    rcases q.property.2.2.1 with h | h
    · exact h.2 (hside.mp h.1)
    · exact h.1 (hside.mpr h.2)
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext hpq he

/-- A spanning-tree subset of the induced component graph, including singleton trees. -/
abbrev ComponentTree (C : Set V) := {s : Finset E // G.is_tree C s}

/-- The C endpoint of a crossing edge is in the specified joining set K. -/
def admissible (C K : Set V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  (G.left e ∈ C ∩ K ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e ∈ C ∩ K ∧ G.left e ∉ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem admissible_iff_of_subset {C K : Set V} (hK : K ⊆ C) (e : E) :
    G.admissible C K e ↔
      (G.left e ∈ K ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e ∈ K ∧ G.left e ∉ C) := by
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hK h.1, h.1⟩, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hK h.1, h.1⟩, h.2⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem admissible_implies_crosses {C K : Set V} {e : E}
    (he : G.admissible C K e) : G.crosses C e := by
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact Or.inl ⟨he.1.1, he.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he.2, he.1.1⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem crosses_of_admissible {C K : Set V} (hK : K ⊆ C) {e : E}
    (he : G.admissible C K e) : G.crosses C e := by
  rcases (G.admissible_iff_of_subset hK e).mp he with he | he
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hK he.1, he.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he.2, hK he.1⟩

abbrev FixedJoining (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {p : G.Joining C // p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2.2}

/-- Completed ordinary spanning trees with the prescribed inside restriction and a
cut-edge endpoint in K. The mark is unique by cutTree_edges_injective. -/
abbrev FixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {p : G.CutTree C // G.internalEdges C p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2}

noncomputable def fixedJoiningEquiv (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ × {e : E // G.admissible C K e}) ≃ G.FixedJoining C K t where
  toFun p := ⟨⟨(t.val, p.1.val, p.2.val), t.property, p.1.property,
    G.crosses_of_admissible hK p.2.property⟩, rfl, p.2.property⟩
  invFun p := (⟨p.val.val.2.1, p.val.property.2.1⟩, ⟨p.val.val.2.2, p.property.2⟩)
  left_inv p := by rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext p.property.1.symm rfl

noncomputable def fixedCutEquiv (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ × {e : E // G.admissible C K e}) ≃ G.FixedCutTree C K t :=
  (G.fixedJoiningEquiv C K t hK).trans
    ((G.joiningEquiv C).subtypeEquiv fun p => by
      have hi := G.internalEdges_insert_union p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1
        p.property.2.2
      change (p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2.2) ↔
        (G.internalEdges C (insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)) = t.val ∧
          G.admissible C K p.val.2.2)
      rw [hi])

section Finite

/-- All admissible copies, explicitly enumerated in the edge carrier. -/
noncomputable def admissibleEdges (C K : Set V) : Finset E :=
  Finset.univ.filter (G.admissible C K)

/-- All individual copies joining v to the opposite side of C. -/
noncomputable def crossingAt (C : Set V) (v : V) : Finset E :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun e =>
    v ∈ C ∧ ((G.left e = v ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e = v ∧ G.left e ∉ C))

theorem admissibleEdges_eq_biUnion (C K : Set V) :
    G.admissibleEdges C K = K.toFinset.biUnion (G.crossingAt C) := by
  ext e
  simp only [admissibleEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_biUnion, Set.mem_toFinset, crossingAt, admissible, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨G.left e, h.1.2, h.1.1, Or.inl ⟨rfl, h.2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨G.right e, h.1.2, h.1.1, Or.inr ⟨rfl, h.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvC, h | h⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨h.1 ▸ hvC, h.1 ▸ hv⟩, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h.1 ▸ hvC, h.1 ▸ hv⟩, h.2⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem admissible_empty (K : Set V) (e : E) :
    ¬G.admissible ∅ K e := by simp [admissible]

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem crossingAt_eq_empty_of_not_mem {C : Set V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ C) :
    G.crossingAt C v = ∅ := by simp [crossingAt, hv]

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem crossingAt_empty (v : V) : G.crossingAt ∅ v = ∅ := by
  simp [crossingAt]

/-- The literal edge-copy fiber size is the sum of opposite-side degrees over K. -/
theorem card_admissibleEdges (C K : Set V) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.admissibleEdges C K).card = ∑ v ∈ K.toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card := by
  classical
  rw [G.admissibleEdges_eq_biUnion]
  apply Finset.card_biUnion
  intro v hv w hw hvw
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro e hev hew
  have hvC := hK (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hv)
  have hwC := hK (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hw)
  have hve := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hev).2.2
  have hwe := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hew).2.2
  rcases hve with hve | hve <;> rcases hwe with hwe | hwe
  · exact hvw (hve.1.symm.trans hwe.1)
  · exact hwe.2 (hve.1 ▸ hvC)
  · exact hve.2 (hwe.1 ▸ hwC)
  · exact hvw (hve.1.symm.trans hwe.1)

/-- Exactly ell ordinary completions for each fixed pair of component trees. -/
theorem card_fixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    Fintype.card (G.FixedCutTree C K t) =
      Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) * (G.admissibleEdges C K).card := by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (G.fixedCutEquiv C K t hK), Fintype.card_prod]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.subtype_card _ (by intro e; simp)

/-- Reciprocal joining cancellation at fixed C and inside tree, retaining common mass c.
There are no completions when ell=0, so that branch contributes zero. -/
theorem reciprocal_fixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C)
    (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ _q : G.FixedCutTree C K t, c / (G.admissibleEdges C K).card) =
      if (G.admissibleEdges C K).Nonempty then c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, G.card_fixedCutTree C K t hK,
    Nat.cast_mul]
  by_cases h : (G.admissibleEdges C K).Nonempty
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hc : ((G.admissibleEdges C K).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr h
    field_simp
  · have hc : (G.admissibleEdges C K).card = 0 := Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
      (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h)
    simp [h, hc]

end Finite

end Multigraph

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Past

@[expose] public section

/-! Exact common-ancestor-past counting for ordinary copied-edge spanning trees. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem existsUnique_component_path {C : Set V} (t : G.ComponentTree C) (x y : C) :
    ∃! p : (G.toSimple t.val).Walk x.val y.val, p.IsPath := by
  have hr := (G.toSimple_reachable t.val x.val y.val).mpr
    (t.property.2.2.1 x.val x.property y.val y.property)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hr.exists_isPath
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  exact Subtype.mk.inj ((G.toSimple_isAcyclic t.property.2.2.2).path_unique ⟨q, hq⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩)

/-- The unique path in the actual induced component, retaining original vertices. -/
noncomputable def componentPath {C : Set V} (t : G.ComponentTree C) (x y : C) :
    (G.toSimple t.val).Walk x.val y.val := (G.existsUnique_component_path t x y).choose

theorem componentPath_isPath {C : Set V} (t : G.ComponentTree C) (x y : C) :
    (G.componentPath t x y).IsPath := (G.existsUnique_component_path t x y).choose_spec.1

/-- The actual minimal component subtree connecting S. The support premise is used to
construct both path endpoints, rather than silently discarding off-support marked vertices. -/
noncomputable def componentSpan {C : Set V} (t : G.ComponentTree C) (S : Set V)
    (hSC : S ⊆ C) : Set V :=
  {a | ∃ (x : V) (hx : x ∈ S) (y : V) (hy : y ∈ S),
    a ∈ (G.componentPath t ⟨x, hSC hx⟩ ⟨y, hSC hy⟩).support}

theorem componentSpan_subset {C : Set V} (t : G.ComponentTree C) (S : Set V)
    (hSC : S ⊆ C) : G.componentSpan t S hSC ⊆ C := by
  rintro a ⟨x, hx, y, hy, ha⟩
  exact G.walk_mem_side (fun e he => iff_of_true (t.property.2.1 e he).1
    (t.property.2.1 e he).2) (G.componentPath t ⟨x, hSC hx⟩ ⟨y, hSC hy⟩) (hSC hx) a ha

theorem span_eq_componentSpan {C : Set V} (t : G.ComponentTree C) (u : G.SpanningTree)
    (S : Set V) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (htu : t.val ⊆ u.val) :
    G.span u S = G.componentSpan t S hSC := by
  have hle : G.toSimple t.val ≤ G.toSimple u.val := by
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨e, he, h⟩ := h
    exact ⟨e, htu he, h⟩
  have heq (x y : C) :
      (path (G.toSimple_isTree u.property) x.val y.val).support =
        (G.componentPath t x y).support := by
    rw [path_eq _ ((G.componentPath t x y).mapLe hle)
      ((G.componentPath_isPath t x y).mapLe hle), SimpleGraph.Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support]
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, ha⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, (heq ⟨x, hSC hx⟩ ⟨y, hSC hy⟩) ▸ ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, ha⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, (heq ⟨x, hSC hx⟩ ⟨y, hSC hy⟩).symm ▸ ha⟩

/-- An event in the ordinary tree carrier, with no marked edge and no forest-pair input.
The descendant expression is proved equal to the source past on this event below. -/
abbrev AncestorPastTree (C S : Set V) (r : V) (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {u : G.SpanningTree // G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
    G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val}

theorem ancestor_ne_root_of_event {C S : Set V} {r : V} (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {t : G.ComponentTree C} (u : G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t) :
    G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS ≠ r := by
  intro h
  have hm : r ∈ G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS) := by
    rw [h]
    exact ancestor_root _ r r
  rw [u.property.1] at hm
  exact hr hm

theorem event_iff_past {C S : Set V} {r : V} (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.SpanningTree) :
    G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ↔
      ∃ hne : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r, G.past u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) hne = C := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hne : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r := by
      intro he
      have hm : r ∈ G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) := by
        rw [he]
        exact ancestor_root _ r r
      rw [h] at hm
      exact hr hm
    exact ⟨hne, (G.past_eq_descendants u r _ hne).trans h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, h⟩
    exact (G.past_eq_descendants u r _ hne).symm.trans h

/-- Recover the unique outgoing copy from the source event, rather than assuming a cut. -/
noncomputable def eventCut {C S : Set V} {r : V} (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {t : G.ComponentTree C} (u : G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t) : G.CutTree C := by
  let a := G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS
  have hne := G.ancestor_ne_root_of_event hr hS u
  let e := G.parentEdge u.val r a hne
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec u.val r a hne
  have hcut := G.cut_components_componentAfter u.val e he.1 a
    (path (G.toSimple_isTree u.val.property) a r).snd he.2
  have hC : G.componentAfter u.val.val e a = C :=
    (G.past_eq_descendants u.val r a hne).trans u.property.1
  rw [hC] at hcut
  exact ⟨(u.val.val, e), u.val.property, hcut⟩

noncomputable def sourceEventEquiv {C S : Set V} (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    G.FixedCutTree C (G.componentSpan t S hSC) t ≃ G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t where
  toFun p := by
    let u : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.val.1, p.val.property.1⟩
    have htu : t.val ⊆ u.val := by
      rw [← p.property.1]
      exact Finset.filter_subset _ _
    have hspan := G.span_eq_componentSpan t u S hSC htu
    have hdesc : G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C := by
      rcases (G.admissible_iff_of_subset (G.componentSpan_subset t S hSC) _).mp
        p.property.2 with hp | hp
      · have hvC := G.componentSpan_subset t S hSC hp.1
        have hgeom := G.ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff p.val r (G.left p.val.val.2)
          hr hvC hSC hS (Or.inl rfl)
        exact hgeom.mpr (hspan.symm ▸ hp.1)
      · have hvC := G.componentSpan_subset t S hSC hp.1
        have hgeom := G.ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff p.val r (G.right p.val.val.2)
          hr hvC hSC hS (Or.inr rfl)
        exact hgeom.mpr (hspan.symm ▸ hp.1)
    exact ⟨u, hdesc, p.property.1⟩
  invFun u := by
    let p := G.eventCut hr hS u
    have he := G.parentEdge_spec u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS)
      (G.ancestor_ne_root_of_event hr hS u)
    have hca : G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS ∈ G.span u.val S :=
      commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree _ r S hS
    have htu : t.val ⊆ u.val.val :=
      (Finset.subset_of_eq u.property.2.symm).trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    have hspan := G.span_eq_componentSpan t u.val S hSC htu
    have hcaK : G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS ∈ G.componentSpan t S hSC := hspan ▸ hca
    have hcaC : G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS ∈ C :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun A : Set V => G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS ∈ A) u.property.1)
        (ancestor_refl _ _ _)
    have hc := p.property.2.2.1
    have hadm : G.admissible C (G.componentSpan t S hSC) p.val.2 := by
      apply (G.admissible_iff_of_subset (G.componentSpan_subset t S hSC) _).mpr
      rcases he.2 with he | he
      · have hl : G.left p.val.2 = G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS := he.1
        rcases hc with hc | hc
        · exact Or.inl ⟨(by rw [hl]; exact hcaK), hc.2⟩
        · exact (hc.1 ((by rw [hl]; exact hcaC))).elim
      · have hr' : G.right p.val.2 = G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS := he.1
        rcases hc with hc | hc
        · exact (hc.2 ((by rw [hr']; exact hcaC))).elim
        · exact Or.inr ⟨(by rw [hr']; exact hcaK), hc.1⟩
    exact ⟨p, u.property.2, hadm⟩
  left_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply G.cutTree_edges_injective C
    rfl
  right_inv u := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

/-- The exact unmarked ordinary-tree cardinal law, with K the actual component span. -/
theorem card_ancestorPastTree {C S : Set V} (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    Fintype.card (G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t) =
      Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) *
        (G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).card := by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (G.sourceEventEquiv r hr hS t hSC)]
  exact G.card_fixedCutTree C _ t (G.componentSpan_subset t S hSC)

/-- Uniform counting probability is defined only for an inhabited actual finite tree carrier. -/
noncomputable def uniformTreeProbability [Nonempty G.SpanningTree]
    (A : Set G.SpanningTree) : ℝ := (Nat.card A : ℝ) / Nat.card G.SpanningTree

/-- Exact finite normalized counting law for the source event, retaining every edge copy. -/
theorem probability_ancestorPastTree [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] {C S : Set V}
    (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    G.uniformTreeProbability {u | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
      G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G.SpanningTree *
        (G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).card := by
  unfold uniformTreeProbability
  have hc : Nat.card {u : G.SpanningTree | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
      G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      Fintype.card (G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t) := by
    exact (Nat.card_congr (show
      {u : G.SpanningTree | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
        G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} ≃ G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t
      from Equiv.refl _)).trans Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
  rw [hc, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  rw [G.card_ancestorPastTree r hr hS t hSC, Nat.cast_mul]
  ring

/-- The literal boundary-degree formulation used in the manuscript. -/
theorem probability_ancestorPastTree_eq_sum [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] {C S : Set V}
    (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    G.uniformTreeProbability {u | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
      G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G.SpanningTree *
        (∑ v ∈ (G.componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card) := by
  rw [G.probability_ancestorPastTree r hr hS t hSC,
    G.card_admissibleEdges C _ (G.componentSpan_subset t S hSC)]

/-- Reciprocal cancellation on actual unmarked completions, with their own connecting span.
The common real mass remains explicit; an empty joining-copy fiber contributes zero. -/
theorem reciprocal_ancestorPastTree {C S : Set V} (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ u : G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t,
      c / (G.admissibleEdges C (G.span u.val S)).card) =
      if (G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).Nonempty then
        c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) else 0 := by
  have hs : (∑ u : G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t,
      c / (G.admissibleEdges C (G.span u.val S)).card) =
      ∑ _u : G.AncestorPastTree C S r hS t,
        c / (G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).card := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro u _
    have htu : t.val ⊆ u.val.val :=
      (Finset.subset_of_eq u.property.2.symm).trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    rw [G.span_eq_componentSpan t u.val S hSC htu]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
    G.card_ancestorPastTree r hr hS t hSC, Nat.cast_mul]
  by_cases h : (G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).Nonempty
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hc : ((G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr h
    field_simp
  · have hc : (G.admissibleEdges C (G.componentSpan t S hSC)).card = 0 :=
      Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h)
    simp [h, hc]

/-- The actual finite counting normalization has total mass one. -/
theorem uniformTreeProbability_univ [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] :
    G.uniformTreeProbability Set.univ = 1 := by
  have hc : (Fintype.card G.SpanningTree : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp [uniformTreeProbability, hc]

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import LatticeProb.Site
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Ends.Defs
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic

/-! The literal infinite lattice-edge space. A coordinate is one unordered
nearest-neighbor edge, and a field records precisely its presence. Graph and end
predicates use all original lattice vertices. No infinite probability law is chosen. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical

/-- Each actual unordered nearest-neighbor lattice edge occurs once. -/
abbrev LatticeEdge := (lattice 2).edgeSet

/-- The product of two-point edge indicators, with its standard product structures. -/
abbrev EdgeField := LatticeEdge → Bool

/-- The selected graph on the entire original lattice vertex carrier. -/
def toGraph (ω : EdgeField) : SimpleGraph (Site 2) where
  Adj x y := ∃ h : (lattice 2).Adj x y, ω ⟨s(x, y), h⟩ = true
  symm := ⟨by
    rintro x y ⟨h, hω⟩
    refine ⟨h.symm, ?_⟩
    have he : (⟨s(y, x), h.symm⟩ : LatticeEdge) = ⟨s(x, y), h⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap
    rw [he]
    exact hω⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun x ⟨h, _⟩ => (lattice 2).loopless.irrefl x h⟩

theorem toGraph_le_lattice (ω : EdgeField) : toGraph ω ≤ lattice 2 :=
  fun _ _ h => h.choose

theorem toGraph_adj_iff (ω : EdgeField) {x y : Site 2} (h : (lattice 2).Adj x y) :
    (toGraph ω).Adj x y ↔ ω ⟨s(x, y), h⟩ = true := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hω⟩
    exact hω
  · intro hω
    exact ⟨h, hω⟩

/-- A spanning tree uses every lattice vertex and has no cycle. -/
def IsTree (ω : EdgeField) : Prop := (toGraph ω).IsTree

/-- Exactly one graph end, using Mathlib's sections of the finite-complement
component inverse system. The nonempty clause excludes zero-ended graphs. -/
def OneEnded (ω : EdgeField) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (toGraph ω).end ∧ Subsingleton (toGraph ω).end

/-- Finite-coordinate cylinders in the actual unordered edge indicator space. -/
def cylinder (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) : Set EdgeField :=
  {ω | F.restrict ω = p}

theorem isClopen_cylinder (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    IsClopen (cylinder F p) := by
  have hf : Continuous (F.restrict : EdgeField → F → Bool) :=
    continuous_pi (fun e => continuous_apply e.val)
  exact (isClopen_discrete {p}).preimage hf

theorem measurableSet_cylinder (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (cylinder F p) := (isClopen_cylinder F p).isClosed.measurableSet

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.FiniteWired
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Ends.Properties

/-! Full-carrier characterizations of the literal selected graph and its ends.
Local finiteness is derived from its actual lattice-neighbor set. These facts
supply the graph adapter for standard UST inputs without proving those inputs. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem toGraph_edgeSet (ω : EdgeField) :
    (toGraph ω).edgeSet = {e | ∃ h : e ∈ (lattice 2).edgeSet, ω ⟨e, h⟩ = true} := by
  ext e
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e ?_
  intro x y
  rfl

theorem edge_mem_toGraph_iff (ω : EdgeField) (e : LatticeEdge) :
    e.val ∈ (toGraph ω).edgeSet ↔ ω e = true := by
  rw [toGraph_edgeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hω⟩
    exact hω
  · intro hω
    exact ⟨e.property, hω⟩

theorem toGraph_injective : Function.Injective toGraph := by
  intro ω ω' h
  funext e
  have he : (ω e = true) ↔ ω' e = true := by
    rw [← edge_mem_toGraph_iff, ← edge_mem_toGraph_iff, h]
  cases hω : ω e <;> cases hω' : ω' e <;> simp_all

theorem neighborSet_subset_lattice_neighbors (ω : EdgeField) (x : Site 2) :
    (toGraph ω).neighborSet x ⊆ (nbrFinset x : Set (Site 2)) :=
  fun y hy => (FiniteWired.mem_neighbors_iff x y).mpr (toGraph_le_lattice ω hy)

theorem neighborSet_finite (ω : EdgeField) (x : Site 2) :
    ((toGraph ω).neighborSet x).Finite :=
  (nbrFinset x).finite_toSet.subset (neighborSet_subset_lattice_neighbors ω x)

instance toGraph_locallyFinite (ω : EdgeField) : (toGraph ω).LocallyFinite :=
  fun x => (neighborSet_finite ω x).fintype

theorem isTree_iff_connected_acyclic (ω : EdgeField) :
    IsTree ω ↔ (toGraph ω).Connected ∧ (toGraph ω).IsAcyclic :=
  SimpleGraph.isTree_iff (toGraph ω)

theorem oneEnded_iff_existsUnique_end (ω : EdgeField) :
    OneEnded ω ↔ ∃! _e : (toGraph ω).end, True := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, hsub⟩
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨e, trivial, fun f _ => hsub.elim f e⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, _, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨e⟩, ⟨fun f g => (hu f trivial).trans (hu g trivial).symm⟩⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space
import FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.TreeLaw
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.ProbabilityMeasure

/-! Genuine finite wired trees mapped to their literal internal lattice-edge
indicators. Every original sink-exit copy is retained in the source law and has
no lattice-edge image. This is a finite law; no infinite UST law is selected. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

/-- An original internal wired copy is its actual unordered lattice edge. -/
def interiorEdge {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) : LatticeEdge :=
  ⟨s(FiniteWired.site e.val.1, FiniteWired.site e.val.2),
    by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property; exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩⟩

theorem interiorEdge_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@interiorEdge N) := by
  intro e f h
  have hs := Sym2.eq_iff.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (FiniteWired.site_injective N hs.1)
      (FiniteWired.site_injective N hs.2))
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := f.property
    rw [hs.1, hs.2] at hi
    have hhi := congrFun hi i
    have hhj := congrFun hj i
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [unit] at hhi hhj <;> omega

/-- The finite-copy map is partial precisely at the contracted sink exits. -/
def copyEdge {N : ℕ} : FiniteWired.Edge N → Option LatticeEdge
  | .inl e => some (interiorEdge e)
  | .inr _ => none

theorem copyEdge_internal {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) :
    copyEdge (.inl e) = some (interiorEdge e) := rfl

theorem copyEdge_exit {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.ExitEdge N) :
    copyEdge (.inr e) = none := rfl

/-- Presence means an actual internal original copy belongs to the wired tree.
Absent coordinates, including all edges without an internal representative, are false. -/
def wiredField {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) : EdgeField :=
  fun e => decide (∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N,
    Sum.inl i ∈ t.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e)

theorem wiredField_eq_true {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree)
    (e : LatticeEdge) : wiredField t e = true ↔
      ∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N, Sum.inl i ∈ t.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e := by
  simp only [wiredField, decide_eq_true_eq]

theorem wiredField_internal_iff {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree)
    (i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) :
    wiredField t (interiorEdge i) = true ↔ Sum.inl i ∈ t.val := by
  rw [wiredField_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, he⟩
    exact (interiorEdge_injective N he) ▸ hj
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

theorem wiredField_eq_false_of_no_internal {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree)
    (e : LatticeEdge) (he : ∀ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N, interiorEdge i ≠ e) :
    wiredField t e = false := by
  have hn : ¬ ∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N,
      Sum.inl i ∈ t.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e := by
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact he i hi
  simp [wiredField, hn]

theorem wiredField_measurable (N : ℕ) :
    Measurable (@wiredField N) := measurable_of_finite _

/-- Pushforward of the original complete uniform copied-edge wired tree law. -/
def finiteLaw (N : ℕ) : Measure EdgeField :=
  Measure.map (@wiredField N) (WiredTrees.law N)

instance finiteLaw_probability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteLaw N) :=
  (WiredTrees.law N).isProbabilityMeasure_map (wiredField_measurable N).aemeasurable

theorem finiteLaw_mass_one (N : ℕ) : finiteLaw N Set.univ = 1 := measure_univ

/-- The same actual finite law as a probability-measure element, for weak convergence. -/
def finiteProbability (N : ℕ) : ProbabilityMeasure EdgeField := ⟨finiteLaw N, inferInstance⟩

theorem finiteLaw_apply (N : ℕ) (A : Set EdgeField) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    finiteLaw N A = WiredTrees.law N {t | wiredField t ∈ A} :=
  Measure.map_apply (wiredField_measurable N) hA

theorem finiteLaw_cylinder (N : ℕ) (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    finiteLaw N (cylinder F p) = WiredTrees.law N {t | F.restrict (wiredField t) = p} :=
  finiteLaw_apply N _ (measurableSet_cylinder F p)

theorem finiteLaw_original_count (N : ℕ) (A : Set EdgeField) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    finiteLaw N A =
      (Nat.card ({t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree | wiredField t ∈ A} :
        Set (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) : ℝ≥0∞) / WiredTrees.treeCount N := by
  rw [finiteLaw_apply N A hA]
  change uniformMeasure (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree _ = _
  rw [uniformMeasure_apply]
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, WiredTrees.treeCount]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.JoiningCounts
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.SumMeasure

@[expose] public section

/-! Actual uniform finite measures on copied-edge tree subsets. -/
open scoped Classical ENNReal
open MeasureTheory
namespace FiniteAvalanches

noncomputable def uniformMeasure (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : Measure α :=
  (Nat.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

instance uniformMeasure_probability (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformMeasure α) := by
  constructor
  simp only [uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]
  simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem uniformMeasure_apply (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (A : Set α) :
    uniformMeasure α A = (Nat.card A : ℝ≥0∞) / Nat.card α := by
  rw [uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Measure.count_apply A.toFinite.measurableSet, Set.encard, ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

theorem uniformMeasure_real_apply (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (A : Set α) :
    (uniformMeasure α).real A = (Nat.card A : ℝ) / Nat.card α := by
  simp [Measure.real, uniformMeasure_apply, ENNReal.toReal_div]

theorem integral_uniformMeasure (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂uniformMeasure α) = (∑ x, f x) / Nat.card α := by
  simp only [uniformMeasure, integral_smul_measure, integral_count, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    ENNReal.toReal_natCast, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

namespace Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

instance componentTreeMeasurableSpace (C : Set V) : MeasurableSpace (G.ComponentTree C) := ⊤
instance componentTreeMeasurableSingletonClass (C : Set V) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (G.ComponentTree C) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Uniform probability on actual ordinary spanning-tree edge subsets. -/
noncomputable def treeLaw [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] : Measure G.SpanningTree :=
  uniformMeasure G.SpanningTree

instance treeLaw_probability [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] : IsProbabilityMeasure G.treeLaw :=
  uniformMeasure_probability _

theorem treeLaw_real_eq_counting [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] (A : Set G.SpanningTree) :
    G.treeLaw.real A = G.uniformTreeProbability A :=
  uniformMeasure_real_apply _ A

/-- The exact joining formula is an event probability of a real finite measure. -/
theorem treeLaw_real_ancestorPastTree [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] {C S : Set V}
    (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    G.treeLaw.real {u | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
      G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G.SpanningTree *
        (∑ v ∈ (G.componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card) := by
  rw [G.treeLaw_real_eq_counting]
  exact G.probability_ancestorPastTree_eq_sum r hr hS t hSC

end Trees.Multigraph
end FiniteAvalanches

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Measure

@[expose] public section

/-! The actual support/inside-tree partition of trees with nonroot marked common ancestor. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Supports with the same positive two-component count as the source shape sum. -/
abbrev PositiveSupport (r : V) (S : Set V) :=
  {C : Set V // S ⊆ C ∧ r ∉ C ∧
    0 < Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C) ∧ 0 < Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ)}

/-- Ordinary unmarked trees whose common ancestor is active. -/
abbrev ActiveAncestorTree (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :=
  {u : G.SpanningTree // G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r}

theorem internalEdges_erase_of_crosses {C : Set V} (s : Finset E) {e : E}
    (he : G.crosses C e) : G.internalEdges C (s.erase e) = G.internalEdges C s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hl, hr⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, hf⟩, hl, hr⟩
    rintro rfl
    rcases he with he | he
    · exact he.2 hr
    · exact he.1 hl

/-- The outgoing copy and its actual deletion components, extracted from an active ancestor. -/
noncomputable def ancestorCut (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS) :
    G.CutTree (G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS)) := by
  let a := G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS
  let e := G.parentEdge u.val r a u.property
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec u.val r a u.property
  have hc := G.cut_components_componentAfter u.val e he.1 a
    (path (G.toSimple_isTree u.val.property) a r).snd he.2
  rw [show G.componentAfter u.val.val e a = G.descendants u.val r a from
    G.past_eq_descendants u.val r a u.property] at hc
  exact ⟨(u.val.val, e), u.val.property, hc⟩

theorem ancestorCut_edges (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS) : (G.ancestorCut r S hS u).val.1 = u.val.val := rfl

noncomputable def insideTree (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS) :
    G.ComponentTree (G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS)) := by
  let p := G.ancestorCut r S hS u
  have ht := (G.split _ p).property.1
  change G.is_tree _ (G.internalEdges _ (p.val.1.erase p.val.2)) at ht
  rw [G.internalEdges_erase_of_crosses p.val.1 p.property.2.2.1] at ht
  exact ⟨G.internalEdges _ u.val.val, ht⟩

noncomputable def outsideTree (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS) :
    G.ComponentTree (G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS))ᶜ :=
  ⟨(G.split _ (G.ancestorCut r S hS u)).val.2.1,
    (G.split _ (G.ancestorCut r S hS u)).property.2.1⟩

noncomputable def supportOf (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS) : G.PositiveSupport r S := by
  let C := G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS)
  have hSC : S ⊆ C := (commonAncestor_spec (G.toSimple_isTree u.val.property) r S hS).1
  have hr : r ∉ C := by
    intro h
    exact u.property (ancestor_antisymm (G.toSimple_isTree u.val.property) h
      (ancestor_root _ r _))
  have hC : 0 < Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨G.insideTree r S hS u⟩
  have hD : 0 < Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨G.outsideTree r S hS u⟩
  exact ⟨C, hSC, hr, hC, hD⟩

abbrev TreeFiber (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :=
  (C : G.PositiveSupport r S) × (t : G.ComponentTree C.val) ×
    G.AncestorPastTree C.val S r hS t

def forgetFiber (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (p : G.TreeFiber r S hS) : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS :=
  ⟨p.2.2.val, G.ancestor_ne_root_of_event p.1.property.2.1 hS p.2.2⟩

theorem forgetFiber_bijective (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Function.Bijective (G.forgetFiber r S hS) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, t, u⟩ ⟨D, d, v⟩ he
    have huv : u.val = v.val := congrArg Subtype.val he
    have hCD : C = D := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact u.property.1.symm.trans (huv ▸ v.property.1)
    subst D
    have htd : t = d := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact u.property.2.symm.trans (huv ▸ v.property.2)
    subst d
    have huv' : u = v := Subtype.ext huv
    subst v
    rfl
  · intro u
    let C := G.supportOf r S hS u
    let t := G.insideTree r S hS u
    refine ⟨⟨C, t, ⟨u.val, rfl, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

/-- Every active-ancestor tree has one actual support and one actual inside restriction. -/
noncomputable def treeFiberEquiv (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    G.TreeFiber r S hS ≃ G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS :=
  Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.forgetFiber_bijective r S hS)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Ancestors

@[expose] public section

/-! Every rooted descendant set is the actual component cut off by its outgoing edge copy. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- The literal connected component of a after deleting an individual edge copy. -/
def componentAfter (t : Finset E) (e : E) (a : V) : Set V :=
  {x | G.reaches (t.erase e) a x}

theorem cut_components_componentAfter (t : G.SpanningTree) (e : E) (he : e ∈ t.val)
    (a b : V) (hab : (G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = b) ∨
      (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = b)) :
    G.cut_components (G.componentAfter t.val e a) t.val e := by
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val e a
  have hsep : ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a b := by
    intro h
    apply t.property.2.2.2 e he
    rcases hab with hab | hab
    · simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using h
    · exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using h)
  have ha : a ∈ C := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hb : b ∉ C := hsep
  have hclass (x : V) : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a x ∨ G.reaches (t.val.erase e) b x := by
    have h := t.property.2.2.1 a (Set.mem_univ _) x (Set.mem_univ _)
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Or.inl .refl
    | @tail x y _ h ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hxy⟩ := h
      by_cases hfe : f = e
      · subst f
        rcases hxy with hxy | hxy <;> rcases hab with hab | hab
        · right; rw [← hxy.2, hab.2]; exact .refl
        · left; rw [← hxy.2, hab.1]; exact .refl
        · left; rw [← hxy.2, hab.1]; exact .refl
        · right; rw [← hxy.2, hab.2]; exact .refl
      · have hstep : G.adjacent (t.val.erase e) x y :=
          ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfe, hf⟩, hxy⟩
        exact ih.imp (fun h => h.tail hstep) (fun h => h.tail hstep)
  have hd (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C) : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) b x :=
    (hclass x).resolve_left hx
  refine ⟨he, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change G.crosses C e
    rcases hab with hab | hab
    · exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [hab.1]; exact ha, by rw [hab.2]; exact hb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [hab.2]; exact hb, by rw [hab.1]; exact ha⟩
  · intro f hf
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact h.tail ⟨f, hf, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · intro h
      exact h.tail ⟨f, hf, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (G.reaches_symm hx).trans hy
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (G.reaches_symm (hd x hx)).trans (hd y hy)

/-- A parent edge is an original tree copy from a to the next vertex on its root path. -/
def is_parent_edge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ t.val ∧
    ((G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) a r).snd) ∨
      (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) a r).snd))

theorem existsUnique_parent_edge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    ∃! e, G.is_parent_edge t r a e := by
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree t.property
  have hp : ¬(path hT a r).Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
  obtain ⟨e, he, hadj⟩ := (path hT a r).adj_snd hp
  have hep : G.is_parent_edge t r a e := ⟨he, hadj⟩
  refine ⟨e, hep, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  apply G.edge_injOn_of_is_forest t.property.2.2.2 hf.1 he
  have hedge {g : E} (hg : G.is_parent_edge t r a g) :
      G.edge g = s(a, (path hT a r).snd) := by
    rcases hg.2 with hg | hg
    · simp only [edge, hg.1, hg.2]
    · simp only [edge, hg.1, hg.2, Sym2.eq_swap]
  exact (hedge hf).trans (hedge hep).symm

/-- The unique outgoing original edge copy; chosen only after full uniqueness. -/
noncomputable def parentEdge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) : E :=
  (G.existsUnique_parent_edge t r a hne).choose

theorem parentEdge_spec (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    G.is_parent_edge t r a (G.parentEdge t r a hne) :=
  (G.existsUnique_parent_edge t r a hne).choose_spec.1

/-- The source past on its exact nonroot carrier: the component after the outgoing copy. -/
noncomputable def past (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) : Set V :=
  G.componentAfter t.val (G.parentEdge t r a hne) a

theorem past_eq_descendants (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    G.past t r a hne = G.descendants t r a := by
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree t.property
  let e := G.parentEdge t r a hne
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec t r a hne
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val e a
  have hcut := G.cut_components_componentAfter t e he.1 a (path hT a r).snd he.2
  have hr : r ∉ C := by
    obtain ⟨b, hab, q, hp⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hne (path hT a r)
    have hq : q.IsPath ∧ a ∉ q.support := by
      have h := path_isPath hT a r
      rw [hp, SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at h
      exact h
    have hsnd : (path hT a r).snd = b := by simp [hp]
    have heab : (G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = b) ∨ (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = b) := by
      simpa [hsnd] using he.2
    have hreach := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem
      (heab.imp (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1)) q hq.2
    intro h
    have hab' : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a b := h.trans (G.reaches_symm hreach)
    apply t.property.2.2.2 e he.1
    rcases heab with h | h
    · simpa [h.1, h.2] using hab'
    · exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa [h.1, h.2] using hab')
  exact (G.descendants_eq_cut ⟨(t.val, e), t.property, hcut⟩ r a hr
    Relation.ReflTransGen.refl (he.2.imp (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1))).symm

/-- Every nonroot vertex has exactly its paper-defined outgoing-edge past. -/
theorem past_ancestor_eq_cut_iff {C S : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C) (r v : V)
    (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    ∃ hne : G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS ≠ r,
      (G.past ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r
        (G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS) hne = C ↔
          v ∈ G.span ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ S) := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  have hd := G.descendants_eq_cut p r v hr hv hve
  have hca := commonAncestor_spec (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r S hS
  have hcav : G.ancestorOf t r S hS ∈ C := by
    rw [← hd]
    exact hca.2 v (fun x hx => by change x ∈ G.descendants t r v; rw [hd]; exact hSC hx)
  have hne : G.ancestorOf t r S hS ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hcav)
  refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
  rw [G.past_eq_descendants]
  exact G.ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff p r v hr hv hSC hS hve

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Measure

@[expose] public section

/-! Positive-support indexing is exactly positivity of the normalized tree product count. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem tree_product_mass_pos_iff [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] (C : Set V) :
    0 < (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C) : ℝ) * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) /
      Fintype.card G.SpanningTree ↔
      0 < Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C) ∧ 0 < Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) := by
  have ht : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card G.SpanningTree := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  rw [div_pos_iff_of_pos_right ht, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pos]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      have hz : Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C) = 0 := by omega
      simp [hz] at h
    · by_contra hn
      have hz : Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) = 0 := by omega
      simp [hz] at h
  · rintro ⟨hC, hD⟩
    exact Nat.mul_pos hC hD

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Partition

@[expose] public section

/-! Global reciprocal occupation on the actual ordinary-tree measure, with a zero root branch. -/
open scoped Classical
open MeasureTheory
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Literal reciprocal, with the source's zero branch when the ancestor is the root. -/
noncomputable def reciprocalWeight (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (c : ℝ) (u : G.SpanningTree) : ℝ :=
  if G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r then
    c / (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS)) (G.span u S)).card
  else 0

/-- Boundary contact event on the actual inside-tree carrier. -/
noncomputable def insideContact {r : V} {S : Set V} (C : G.PositiveSupport r S) :
    Set (G.ComponentTree C.val) :=
  {t | (G.admissibleEdges C.val (G.componentSpan t S C.property.1)).Nonempty}

noncomputable def componentLaw {r : V} {S : Set V} (C : G.PositiveSupport r S) :
    Measure (G.ComponentTree C.val) := by
  letI : Nonempty (G.ComponentTree C.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp C.property.2.2.1
  exact FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure (G.ComponentTree C.val)

instance componentLaw_probability {r : V} {S : Set V} (C : G.PositiveSupport r S) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (G.componentLaw C) := by
  letI : Nonempty (G.ComponentTree C.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp C.property.2.2.1
  exact FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure_probability _

theorem componentLaw_real_contact {r : V} {S : Set V} (C : G.PositiveSupport r S) :
    (G.componentLaw C).real (G.insideContact C) =
      (Nat.card (G.insideContact C) : ℝ) / Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.val) := by
  letI : Nonempty (G.ComponentTree C.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp C.property.2.2.1
  rw [show G.componentLaw C = FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure (G.ComponentTree C.val)
    from rfl, FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure_real_apply]
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

/-- Sum of all completions, partitioned by their derived support and inside restriction. -/
theorem sum_reciprocalWeight (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ u : G.SpanningTree, G.reciprocalWeight r S hS c u) =
      ∑ C : G.PositiveSupport r S, ∑ t : G.ComponentTree C.val,
        if (G.admissibleEdges C.val (G.componentSpan t S C.property.1)).Nonempty then
          c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ) else 0 := by
  have ha : (∑ u : G.SpanningTree, G.reciprocalWeight r S hS c u) =
      ∑ u : G.ActiveAncestorTree r S hS,
        c / (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS))
          (G.span u.val S)).card := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr_set {u : G.SpanningTree | G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r}
    · intro u hu
      change G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r at hu
      rw [reciprocalWeight, if_pos hu]
    · intro u hu
      change ¬G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r at hu
      rw [reciprocalWeight, if_neg hu]
  rw [ha, ← Equiv.sum_comp (G.treeFiberEquiv r S hS)]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro C _
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  change (∑ u : G.AncestorPastTree C.val S r hS t,
    c / (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS))
      (G.span u.val S)).card) = _
  have he : (∑ u : G.AncestorPastTree C.val S r hS t,
      c / (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u.val r (G.ancestorOf u.val r S hS))
        (G.span u.val S)).card) =
      ∑ u : G.AncestorPastTree C.val S r hS t,
        c / (G.admissibleEdges C.val (G.span u.val S)).card := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro u _
    rw [u.property.1]
  rw [he]
  exact G.reciprocal_ancestorPastTree r C.property.2.1 hS t C.property.1 c

/-- The common mass is explicit, and component contact uses its actual probability measure. -/
theorem sum_reciprocalWeight_eq_componentLaw (r : V) (S : Set V)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ u : G.SpanningTree, G.reciprocalWeight r S hS c u) =
      ∑ C : G.PositiveSupport r S,
        c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.val) * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ) *
          (G.componentLaw C).real (G.insideContact C) := by
  rw [G.sum_reciprocalWeight r S hS c]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro C _
  have hs : (∑ t : G.ComponentTree C.val,
      if (G.admissibleEdges C.val (G.componentSpan t S C.property.1)).Nonempty then
        c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ) else 0) =
      ∑ _t : G.insideContact C, c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr_set (G.insideContact C)
    · intro t ht
      simp only [insideContact, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ht
      rw [if_pos ht]
    · intro t ht
      simp only [insideContact, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ht
      rw [if_neg ht]
  rw [hs, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, G.componentLaw_real_contact C]
  have hc : (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.val) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt C.property.2.2.1)
  field_simp

/-- Expectation under the real uniform tree law, preserving mass tau^-1 and the root zero case. -/
theorem integral_reciprocalWeight [Nonempty G.SpanningTree]
    (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (∫ u, G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u ∂G.treeLaw) =
      ∑ C : G.PositiveSupport r S,
        ((Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.val) : ℝ) *
          Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ) / Fintype.card G.SpanningTree) *
            (G.componentLaw C).real (G.insideContact C) := by
  have hm : (∑ u : G.SpanningTree,
      G.reciprocalWeight r S hS (1 / (Fintype.card G.SpanningTree : ℝ)) u) =
      (∑ u : G.SpanningTree, G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u) /
        Fintype.card G.SpanningTree := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro u _
    unfold reciprocalWeight
    split <;> ring
  change (∫ u, G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u
    ∂FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure G.SpanningTree) = _
  rw [FiniteAvalanches.integral_uniformMeasure, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← hm,
    G.sum_reciprocalWeight_eq_componentLaw r S hS]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro C _
  ring

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Reciprocal

@[expose] public section

/-! Nonroot ancestors have a real counted outgoing copy, so the reciprocal lies in [0,1]. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem admissibleEdges_nonempty_of_ancestor_ne_root (r : V) (S : Set V)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (u : G.SpanningTree) (hne : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r) :
    (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS)) (G.span u S)).Nonempty := by
  let a := G.ancestorOf u r S hS
  let p := G.ancestorCut r S hS ⟨u, hne⟩
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec u r a hne
  have hC : a ∈ G.descendants u r a := ancestor_refl _ r a
  have hK : a ∈ G.span u S := commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree _ r S hS
  have hc := p.property.2.2.1
  have hadm : G.admissible (G.descendants u r a) (G.span u S) p.val.2 := by
    rcases he.2 with hl | hr
    · have hl' : G.left p.val.2 = a := hl.1
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hl' ▸ hC, hl' ▸ hK⟩, hc.2⟩
      · exact (hc.1 (hl' ▸ hC)).elim
    · have hr' : G.right p.val.2 = a := hr.1
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · exact (hc.2 (hr' ▸ hC)).elim
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hr' ▸ hC, hr' ▸ hK⟩, hc.1⟩
  exact ⟨p.val.2, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hadm⟩⟩

theorem reciprocalWeight_eq_inv_past (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.SpanningTree) (hne : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r) :
    G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u =
      ((G.admissibleEdges (G.past u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) hne) (G.span u S)).card : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  rw [G.past_eq_descendants]
  simp [reciprocalWeight, hne, one_div]

theorem reciprocalWeight_eq_zero_of_ancestor_eq_root (r : V) (S : Set V)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (u : G.SpanningTree) (h : G.ancestorOf u r S hS = r) :
    G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u = 0 := by simp [reciprocalWeight, h]

theorem reciprocalWeight_one_nonneg_le_one (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.SpanningTree) :
    0 ≤ G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u ∧ G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases h : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r
  · rw [reciprocalWeight, if_pos h]
    have hc : (1 : ℝ) ≤
        (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS)) (G.span u S)).card := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.one_le_card.mpr (G.admissibleEdges_nonempty_of_ancestor_ne_root r S hS u h)
    constructor
    · positivity
    · apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hc)).mpr
      simpa using hc
  · simp [reciprocalWeight, h]

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-! Unique paths, actual connecting subtrees, and lowest common ancestors in finite trees. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V : Type*} {T : SimpleGraph V} (hT : T.IsTree)

/-- The unique simple path; its existence and uniqueness precede this choice. -/
noncomputable def path (x y : V) : T.Walk x y := (hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose

theorem path_isPath (x y : V) : (path hT x y).IsPath :=
  (hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose_spec.1

theorem path_eq {x y : V} (p : T.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) : path hT x y = p :=
  ((hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose_spec.2 p hp).symm

theorem path_reverse (x y : V) : path hT x y = (path hT y x).reverse :=
  path_eq hT _ (path_isPath hT y x).reverse

theorem path_takeUntil {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT r a = (path hT r x).takeUntil a ha :=
  path_eq hT _ ((path_isPath hT r x).takeUntil ha)

theorem path_dropUntil {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT a x = (path hT r x).dropUntil a ha :=
  path_eq hT _ ((path_isPath hT r x).dropUntil ha)

theorem path_split {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT r x = (path hT r a).append (path hT a x) := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha, path_dropUntil hT ha]
  exact ((path hT r x).take_spec ha).symm

/-- a is on the unique path from the root r to x. -/
def ancestor (r a x : V) : Prop := a ∈ (path hT r x).support

theorem ancestor_refl (r x : V) : ancestor hT r x x := (path hT r x).end_mem_support

theorem ancestor_root (r x : V) : ancestor hT r r x := (path hT r x).start_mem_support

theorem ancestor_trans {r a b x : V} (hab : ancestor hT r a b)
    (hbx : ancestor hT r b x) : ancestor hT r a x := by
  have h := (path hT r x).support_takeUntil_subset_support hbx
  rw [← path_takeUntil hT hbx] at h
  exact h hab

theorem ancestor_length_le {r a x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x) :
    (path hT r a).length ≤ (path hT r x).length := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
  exact (path hT r x).length_takeUntil_le_length ha

theorem ancestor_length_lt {r a x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x) (hne : a ≠ x) :
    (path hT r a).length < (path hT r x).length := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
  exact (path hT r x).length_takeUntil_lt_length ha hne

theorem ancestor_antisymm {r a b : V} (hab : ancestor hT r a b)
    (hba : ancestor hT r b a) : a = b := by
  by_contra hne
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (ancestor_length_le hT hba)) (ancestor_length_lt hT hab hne)

theorem ancestor_of_length_le {r a b x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hb : ancestor hT r b x) (hle : (path hT r a).length ≤ (path hT r b).length) :
    ancestor hT r a b := by
  have hget := (path hT r x).getVert_takeUntil hb
    (show (path hT r a).length ≤ ((path hT r x).takeUntil b hb).length by
      rwa [← path_takeUntil hT hb])
  have haeq : (path hT r x).getVert (path hT r a).length = a := by
    rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
    exact (path hT r x).getVert_length_takeUntil ha
  unfold ancestor
  rw [path_takeUntil hT hb]
  rw [← haeq, ← hget]
  exact ((path hT r x).takeUntil b hb).getVert_mem_support _

theorem ancestor_comparable {r a b x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hb : ancestor hT r b x) : ancestor hT r a b ∨ ancestor hT r b a := by
  rcases le_total (path hT r a).length (path hT r b).length with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (ancestor_of_length_le hT ha hb h)
  · exact Or.inr (ancestor_of_length_le hT hb ha h)

/-- The lowest common ancestor, characterized entirely by actual rooted paths. -/
def is_common_ancestor (r : V) (S : Set V) (a : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) ∧
    ∀ b, (∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r b x) → ancestor hT r b a

theorem existsUnique_common_ancestor [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃! a, is_common_ancestor hT r S a := by
  let A : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter fun a => ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x
  have hA : A.Nonempty := ⟨r, by simp [A, ancestor_root]⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmax⟩ := A.exists_max_image (fun a => (path hT r a).length) hA
  have hac : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  have hca : is_common_ancestor hT r S a := by
    refine ⟨hac, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    exact ancestor_of_length_le hT (hb x hx) (hac x hx) (hmax b (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb⟩))
  refine ⟨a, hca, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  exact ancestor_antisymm hT (hca.2 b hb.1) (hb.2 a hac)

/-- The unique lowest common ancestor; no root or ancestor witness is supplied as input. -/
noncomputable def commonAncestor [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) : V :=
  (existsUnique_common_ancestor hT r S hS).choose

theorem commonAncestor_spec [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    is_common_ancestor hT r S (commonAncestor hT r S hS) :=
  (existsUnique_common_ancestor hT r S hS).choose_spec.1

/-- The actual connecting subtree: the union of unique paths between marked vertices. -/
def connectingSubtree (S : Set V) : Set V :=
  {a | ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, a ∈ (path hT x y).support}

theorem subset_connectingSubtree (S : Set V) : S ⊆ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨x, hx, x, hx, (path hT x x).start_mem_support⟩

theorem path_subset_union (x y a : V) :
    ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ (path hT x y).support →
      z ∈ (path hT x a).support ∨ z ∈ (path hT a y).support := by
  let w := (path hT x a).append (path hT a y)
  have he := path_eq hT w.toPath.val w.toPath.property
  rw [he]
  intro z hz
  have hz' := w.support_toPath_subset_support hz
  simpa only [w, SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff] using hz'

theorem ancestor_on_suffix {r a x z : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hz : z ∈ (path hT a x).support) : ancestor hT r a z := by
  have hsplit := path_split hT ha
  have hzx : ancestor hT r z x := by
    unfold ancestor
    rw [hsplit]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hz
  rcases ancestor_comparable hT ha hzx with h | h
  · exact h
  · by_cases hza : z = a
    · subst z; exact ancestor_refl hT r a
    · have hp : ((path hT r a).append (path hT a x)).IsPath :=
        hsplit ▸ path_isPath hT r x
      exact (hp.ne_of_mem_support_of_append hza h hz rfl).elim

theorem connectingSubtree_subset_descendants (r : V) (S : Set V) {a : V}
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) :
    connectingSubtree hT S ⊆ {z | ancestor hT r a z} := by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
  rcases path_subset_union hT x y a hz with hz | hz
  · have hz' : z ∈ (path hT a x).support := by
      rw [path_reverse hT x a, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at hz
      exact List.mem_reverse.mp hz
    exact ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha x hx) hz'
  · exact ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha y hy) hz

/-- Path convexity is the connected-subtree condition in a tree. -/
def is_path_convex (C : Set V) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ (path hT x y).support, z ∈ C

theorem connectingSubtree_minimal (S C : Set V) (hC : is_path_convex hT C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    connectingSubtree hT S ⊆ C := by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
  exact hC x (hSC hx) y (hSC hy) z hz

theorem path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree {S : Set V} {b x : V} (hb : b ∈ S)
    (hx : x ∈ connectingSubtree hT S) :
    ∀ z ∈ (path hT b x).support, z ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hxuv⟩ := hx
  have hcase := path_subset_union hT u v b hxuv
  have hx' : (∃ y ∈ S, x ∈ (path hT b y).support) := by
    rcases hcase with h | h
    · refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      rw [path_reverse hT u b, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at h
      exact List.mem_reverse.mp h
    · exact ⟨v, hv, h⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx'
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z ∈ (path hT b y).support := by
    rw [path_takeUntil hT hxy] at hz
    exact (path hT b y).support_takeUntil_subset_support hxy hz
  exact ⟨b, hb, y, hy, hz'⟩

theorem connectingSubtree_convex (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    is_path_convex hT (connectingSubtree hT S) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hS
  intro x hx y hy z hz
  rcases path_subset_union hT x y b hz with h | h
  · rw [path_reverse hT x b, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at h
    exact path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree hT hb hx z (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  · exact path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree hT hb hy z h

theorem connectingSubtree_connected (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (T.induce (connectingSubtree hT S)).Connected := by
  have hconv := connectingSubtree_convex hT S hS
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  letI : Nonempty (connectingSubtree hT S) := ⟨⟨x, subset_connectingSubtree hT S hx⟩⟩
  refine SimpleGraph.Connected.mk ?_
  intro x y
  exact ⟨((path hT x.val y.val).induce (connectingSubtree hT S)
    (fun z hz => hconv
      x.val x.property y.val y.property z hz)).copy (Subtype.ext rfl) (Subtype.ext rfl)⟩

theorem common_ancestor_mem_connectingSubtree {r : V} {S : Set V} (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {a : V} (ha : is_common_ancestor hT r S a) : a ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  have hax : a ≠ x := fun h => hnot (h ▸ subset_connectingSubtree hT S hx)
  obtain ⟨b, hab, q, hp⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hax (path hT a x)
  have hq : q.IsPath ∧ a ∉ q.support := by
    have h := path_isPath hT a x
    rw [hp, SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at h
    exact h
  have hba : b ∈ (path hT a x).support := by
    rw [hp]
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ q.start_mem_support
  have hab' := ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha.1 x hx) hba
  have hbcommon : ∀ y ∈ S, ancestor hT r b y := by
    intro y hy
    let w := q.append (path hT x y)
    have haw : a ∉ w.support := by
      intro h
      rcases (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff _ _).mp h with h | h
      · exact hq.2 h
      · exact hnot ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h⟩
    have han : a ∉ w.toPath.val.support :=
      fun h => haw (w.support_toPath_subset_support h)
    have hpy : path hT a y = SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab w.toPath.val :=
      path_eq hT _ (w.toPath.property.cons han)
    have hby : b ∈ (path hT a y).support := by
      rw [hpy]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ w.toPath.val.start_mem_support
    unfold ancestor
    rw [path_split hT (ha.1 y hy)]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hby
  exact hab.ne (ancestor_antisymm hT hab' (ha.2 b hbcommon))

theorem commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    commonAncestor hT r S hS ∈ connectingSubtree hT S :=
  common_ancestor_mem_connectingSubtree hT hS (commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS)

/-- A common ancestor equals the lowest common ancestor exactly when it lies in the
actual minimal connecting subtree; no arbitrary joining set is supplied. -/
theorem commonAncestor_eq_iff_mem_connectingSubtree [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {a : V} (ha : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) :
    commonAncestor hT r S hS = a ↔ a ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h ▸ commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree hT r S hS
  · intro h
    have hc := commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS
    exact ancestor_antisymm hT
      (connectingSubtree_subset_descendants hT r S hc.1 h) (hc.2 a ha)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Topology
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw

/-! Literal two-color rooted lattice forests. All vertices and all unordered
nearest-neighbor edges are retained. No probability law is selected. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The source's two disjoint nonempty sets, retaining every root separately. -/
structure RootPair where
  zero : Set (Site 2)
  one : Set (Site 2)
  disjoint : Disjoint zero one
  zero_nonempty : zero.Nonempty
  one_nonempty : one.Nonempty

abbrev ColorField := Site 2 → Bool
abbrev ForestField := EdgeField × ColorField

/-- Acyclic on all sites, with exactly one original root in each component. -/
def is_rooted_forest (R : RootPair) (f : EdgeField) : Prop :=
  (toGraph f).IsAcyclic ∧ ∀ x, ∃ r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one,
    (toGraph f).Reachable x r ∧
      ∀ r' ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one, (toGraph f).Reachable x r' → r' = r

abbrev RootedForest (R : RootPair) := {f : EdgeField // is_rooted_forest R f}

def oneVertices (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : Set (Site 2) :=
  {x | ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r}

theorem reachable_roots_eq (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R)
    {x r s : Site 2} (hr : r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one) (hs : s ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one)
    (hxr : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r) (hxs : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x s) : r = s := by
  obtain ⟨u, _, _, hu⟩ := f.property.2 x
  exact (hu r hr hxr).trans (hu s hs hxs).symm

/-- Component root colors, defined by literal reachability, without choosing a root. -/
def colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : ColorField :=
  fun x => decide (x ∈ oneVertices R f)

theorem colors_eq_true_iff (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (x : Site 2) :
    colors R f x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r := by
  simp only [colors, decide_eq_true_eq, oneVertices, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

theorem colors_of_one_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.one) : colors R f x = true :=
  (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mpr ⟨x, hx, .refl x⟩

theorem colors_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.zero) : colors R f x = false := by
  have hn : ¬colors R f x = true := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mp h
    have he := reachable_roots_eq R f (Or.inl hx) (Or.inr hr) (.refl x) hxr
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint hx (he.symm ▸ hr)
  cases h : colors R f x <;> simp_all

/-- Raw full product carrier; valid fields have precisely the original component colors. -/
def is_colored_forest (R : RootPair) (ω : ForestField) : Prop :=
  is_rooted_forest R ω.1 ∧ ∀ x,
    ω.2 x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph ω.1).Reachable x r

theorem colored_iff_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (σ : ColorField) :
    is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) ↔ σ = colors R f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext x
    have he := (h.2 x).trans (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).symm
    cases hσ : σ x <;> cases hf : colors R f x <;> simp_all
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨f.property, colors_eq_true_iff R f⟩

theorem existsUnique_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) :
    ∃! σ : ColorField, is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) :=
  ⟨colors R f, (colored_iff_colors R f _).mpr rfl,
    fun σ hσ => (colored_iff_colors R f σ).mp hσ⟩

def colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) : Set ColorField :=
  {σ | F.restrict σ = p}

theorem isClopen_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    IsClopen (colorCylinder F p) :=
  (isClopen_discrete {p}).preimage (continuous_pi (fun x => continuous_apply x.val))

theorem measurableSet_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (colorCylinder F p) := (isClopen_colorCylinder F p).isClosed.measurableSet

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space

/-! Literal finite walks (including zero edges) and genuinely infinite walks/rays.
No finite list represents an infinite path or a failed stopping time. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb

structure FiniteWalk where
  length : ℕ
  vertex : Fin (length + 1) → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ i : Fin length, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex i.castSucc) (vertex i.succ)

structure InfiniteWalk where
  vertex : ℕ → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ n, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex n) (vertex (n + 1))

structure SimpleRay extends InfiniteWalk where
  injective : Function.Injective vertex

def FiniteWalk.start (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex 0
def FiniteWalk.finish (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex ⟨p.length, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
def FiniteWalk.vertices (p : FiniteWalk) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range p.vertex

def zeroWalk (x : Site 2) : FiniteWalk :=
  ⟨0, fun _ => x, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩

theorem zeroWalk_length (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).length = 0 := rfl
theorem zeroWalk_vertices (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).vertices = {x} := by
  ext y
  simp [FiniteWalk.vertices, zeroWalk]

/-- A stopped trace retains its complete finite word, or its genuinely infinite word. -/
inductive StoppedTrace (B : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) where
  | hit (walk : FiniteWalk) (start : walk.start = x) (finish : walk.finish ∈ B)
      (first : ∀ i : Fin walk.length, walk.vertex i.castSucc ∉ B)
  | escape (walk : InfiniteWalk) (start : walk.vertex 0 = x)
      (avoids : ∀ n, walk.vertex n ∉ B)

def SimpleRay.vertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range γ.vertex
def SimpleRay.tailVertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) :=
  Set.range (fun n => γ.vertex (n + 1))

theorem SimpleRay.vertices_infinite (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertices.Infinite :=
  Set.infinite_range_of_injective γ.injective

theorem SimpleRay.tail_nonempty (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.tailVertices.Nonempty :=
  ⟨γ.vertex 1, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩

theorem SimpleRay.start_not_mem_tail (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertex 0 ∉ γ.tailVertices := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have he := γ.injective hn
  omega

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.ColoredForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.Paths
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw
import Mathlib.Probability.ProductMeasure

/-! Literal simple random walk drivers and ordered hitting events. Independent
uniform choices of the four actual lattice directions, including hitting at time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

abbrev WalkDriver := ℕ → FiniteWired.Direction

def directionLaw : Measure FiniteWired.Direction :=
  FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction

instance directionLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure directionLaw :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction))

def walkLaw : Measure WalkDriver := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => directionLaw)
instance walkLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure walkLaw := by
  unfold walkLaw
  infer_instance

def position (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : ℕ → Site 2
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n)

@[simp] theorem position_zero (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : position x d 0 = x := rfl
@[simp] theorem position_succ (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n) := rfl

theorem position_adjacent (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    (lattice 2).Adj (position x d n) (position x d (n + 1)) := by
  change ∃ i, position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + unit i ∨
    position x d n = position x d (n + 1) + unit i
  refine ⟨(d n).1, ?_⟩
  cases h : (d n).2
  · right
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp
  · left
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp

def driverWalk (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : InfiniteWalk :=
  ⟨position x d, position_adjacent x d⟩

/-- tau_C < tau_A: some C visit precedes every A visit, including time zero. -/
def hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) : Set WalkDriver :=
  {d | ∃ n, position x d n ∈ C ∧ ∀ m ≤ n, position x d m ∉ A}

theorem measurable_position (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun d => position x d n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ih.add ((measurable_of_countable FiniteWired.step).comp (measurable_pi_apply n))

theorem measurableSet_hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    MeasurableSet (hitBefore A C x) := by
  have hC (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∈ C} :=
    (measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable C).measurableSet
  have hA (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∉ A} :=
    ((measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable A).measurableSet).compl
  simp only [hitBefore, Set.setOf_exists, Set.setOf_and, Set.setOf_forall]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n => (hC n).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter (fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ => hA m))))

theorem hitBefore_of_one_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.one) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = Set.univ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  refine ⟨0, hx, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  have he : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm
  subst m
  exact fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint h hx

theorem hitBefore_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.zero) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = ∅ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  rintro ⟨n, _, hn⟩
  exact hn 0 (Nat.zero_le n) hx

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
