import LatticeProb.Walk.ExteriorDirichlet
import LatticeProb.Walk.SRWGreenLower
import LatticeProb.Walk.PotentialKernel

/-!
# Hitting every site in two dimensions

The finite first-passage decomposition bounds a truncated Green function by
the eventual hitting probability times the return Green function. In two
dimensions the return Green function diverges, whereas its difference from
the Green function at a fixed site converges to the potential kernel. Hence
the eventual hitting probability is one.
-/

namespace LatticeProb

open Finset Filter MeasureTheory Topology

variable {d : ℕ}

/-- A uniform direction has the actual increment law after applying its
coordinate vector. -/
theorem stepLaw_map_dirVec (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    (stepLaw d).map dirVec = incLaw d := by
  classical
  have huniform : stepLaw d = (((2 * d : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹) •
      ∑ a : Dir d, Measure.dirac a := by
    calc
      stepLaw d = ∑ a : Dir d, stepLaw d {a} • Measure.dirac a := by
        rw [← Measure.sum_fintype, Measure.sum_smul_dirac]
      _ = _ := by simp only [stepLaw_singleton, Finset.smul_sum]
  have hmeas : Measurable (dirVec : Dir d → Site d) := measurable_of_countable _
  rw [huniform, Measure.map_smul, Measure.map_finset_sum' hmeas.aemeasurable]
  simp only [Measure.map_dirac' hmeas, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool,
    dirVec_eq_unit, dirVec_eq_neg_unit]
  rw [incLaw, instructionLaw]
  simp only [zero_add, zero_sub, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]

/-- Independent uniform directions give independent increments with the
specified increment law. -/
theorem pathLaw_map_dirVec (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    (pathLaw d).map (fun ξ n => dirVec (ξ n)) = incPathLaw d := by
  unfold pathLaw incPathLaw
  rw [Measure.infinitePi_map_pi (μ := fun _ : ℕ => stepLaw d)
    (fun _ => measurable_of_countable dirVec)]
  simp only [stepLaw_map_dirVec]

/-- Accumulating the uniform directions gives the actual position-path law. -/
theorem pathLaw_map_sitePath (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (x : Site d) :
    (pathLaw d).map (fun ξ n => x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, dirVec (ξ j)) =
      siteWalkLaw d x := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Dir d => fun n => dirVec (ξ n)) :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun n => (measurable_of_countable dirVec).comp
      (measurable_pi_apply n)
  change (pathLaw d).map (sitePath x ∘ (fun ξ n => dirVec (ξ n))) = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_sitePath x) hmeas, pathLaw_map_dirVec]
  rfl

/-- The first-passage decomposition summed over a finite time horizon. -/
theorem srwGreen_eq_sum_srwFirstHit (n : ℕ) (x : Site d) :
    srwGreen d n x =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [srwGreen_zero, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [srwGreen_succ, ih, srwHeat_eq_sum_srwFirstHit]
      have hpad : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, srwGreen_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
      rw [hpad, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [← mul_add, ← srwGreen_succ]
      congr 2
      have hjn := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      omega

/-- Truncated Green functions increase with the time horizon. -/
theorem srwGreen_mono {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (x : Site d) :
    srwGreen d m x ≤ srwGreen d n x := by
  unfold srwGreen
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hmn)
    (fun j _ _ => srwHeat_nonneg j x)

/-- A finite Green function is bounded by eventual first passage times the
return Green function, without assuming transience. -/
theorem srwGreen_le_srwHitProb_mul (hd : 0 < d) (n : ℕ) (x : Site d) :
    srwGreen d n x ≤ srwHitProb d x * srwGreen d n 0 := by
  rw [srwGreen_eq_sum_srwFirstHit]
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d n 0 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (srwGreen_mono (Nat.sub_le n j) 0)
          (srwFirstHit_nonneg j x)
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x) * srwGreen d n 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ srwHitProb d x * srwGreen d n 0 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        ((summable_srwFirstHit hd x).sum_le_tsum (Finset.range n)
          (fun j _ => srwFirstHit_nonneg j x)) (srwGreen_nonneg n 0)

/-- The two-dimensional return Green function tends to infinity. -/
theorem tendsto_srwGreen_two_dim_origin :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => srwGreen 2 n 0) atTop atTop := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hbound⟩ := exists_le_srwGreen_two_dim
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => c * Real.log (n : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc
      (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  exact tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop
    (eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨2, fun n hn => hbound n hn⟩) hlog

/-- Simple random walk in two dimensions hits the origin with probability one
from every starting site. -/
theorem srwHitProb_two_dim_eq_one (x : Site 2) : srwHitProb 2 x = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm (srwHitProb_le_one (by norm_num) x)
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - srwHitProb 2 x := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 - srwHitProb 2 x) * srwGreen 2 n 0)
      atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hpos tendsto_srwGreen_two_dim_origin
  have hbound (n : ℕ) :
      (1 - srwHitProb 2 x) * srwGreen 2 n 0 ≤ srwGreen 2 n 0 - srwGreen 2 n x := by
    have hgreen := srwGreen_le_srwHitProb_mul (by norm_num : 0 < 2) n x
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul]
    exact sub_le_sub_left hgreen _
  exact not_tendsto_atTop_of_tendsto_nhds (tendsto_potentialKernel x)
    (tendsto_atTop_mono hbound hdiv)

/-- The law on position paths hits the origin almost surely in dimension two. -/
theorem siteWalkLaw_two_dim_hitOrigin (x : Site 2) :
    siteWalkLaw 2 x (hitOrigin 2) = 1 := by
  rw [siteWalkLaw_hitOrigin (by norm_num), srwHitProb_two_dim_eq_one,
    ENNReal.ofReal_one]

/-- Hitting any fixed site is a measurable path event. Time zero is included. -/
theorem measurableSet_hit_site (a : Site d) :
    MeasurableSet {X : ℕ → Site d | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} := by
  simp only [Set.setOf_exists]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_pi_apply n)
    measurable_const

/-- Translate a target site to the origin in the actual position-path law. -/
theorem siteWalkLaw_hit_site [NeZero d] (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x a : Site d) :
    siteWalkLaw d x {X | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (srwHitProb d (x - a)) := by
  have hpre : sitePath x ⁻¹' {X | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} =
      sitePath (x - a) ⁻¹' hitOrigin d := by
    ext ξ
    have hshift (n : ℕ) : sitePath (x - a) ξ n = sitePath x ξ n - a := by
      unfold sitePath
      abel
    change (∃ n : ℕ, sitePath x ξ n = a) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, sitePath (x - a) ξ n = 0
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      exact ⟨n, by rw [hshift, hn, sub_self]⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      exact ⟨n, sub_eq_zero.mp ((hshift n).symm.trans hn)⟩
  rw [siteWalkLaw, Measure.map_apply (measurable_sitePath x) (measurableSet_hit_site a),
    hpre, ← Measure.map_apply (measurable_sitePath (x - a)) measurableSet_hitOrigin]
  exact siteWalkLaw_hitOrigin hd (x - a)

/-- Two-dimensional simple random walk hits every fixed site almost surely,
from every starting site, including a hit at time zero. -/
theorem siteWalkLaw_two_dim_hit_site (x a : Site 2) :
    siteWalkLaw 2 x {X | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} = 1 := by
  rw [siteWalkLaw_hit_site (by norm_num), srwHitProb_two_dim_eq_one,
    ENNReal.ofReal_one]

/-- The iid direction drivers hit every fixed site almost surely in two
dimensions. The sum is empty at time zero. -/
theorem pathLaw_two_dim_hit_site (x a : Site 2) :
    pathLaw 2 {ξ | ∃ n : ℕ, x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, dirVec (ξ j) = a} = 1 := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Dir 2 => fun n =>
      x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, dirVec (ξ j)) :=
    (measurable_sitePath x).comp (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun n =>
      (measurable_of_countable dirVec).comp (measurable_pi_apply n))
  have h := siteWalkLaw_two_dim_hit_site x a
  rw [← pathLaw_map_sitePath 2 x,
    Measure.map_apply hmeas (measurableSet_hit_site a)] at h
  exact h

end LatticeProb

import LatticeProb.Prob.InfinitePiSplit

/-! First-step decomposition for a walk driven by independent instructions.
The ordered hitting event observes time zero and excludes a simultaneous visit
of the forbidden set and the target set. -/

namespace LatticeProb.DrivenWalk

open MeasureTheory

variable {α δ : Type*}

/-- Position after a finite number of instructions, starting at `x`. -/
def position (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (ω : ℕ → δ) : ℕ → α
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => step (position step x ω n) (ω n)

/-- A walk starts at its prescribed initial point. -/
@[simp] theorem position_zero (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (ω : ℕ → δ) :
    position step x ω 0 = x := rfl

/-- The next position applies the next instruction to the current position. -/
@[simp] theorem position_succ (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (ω : ℕ → δ) (n : ℕ) :
    position step x ω (n + 1) = step (position step x ω n) (ω n) := rfl

/-- Removing the first instruction starts the remaining walk one step later. -/
theorem position_consNat_succ (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (u : δ)
    (ω : ℕ → δ) (n : ℕ) :
    position step x (consNat u ω) (n + 1) = position step (step x u) ω n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [position_succ, consNat_succ, ih, position_succ]

/-- A target visit before any forbidden visit, with both times allowed to be zero. -/
def hitBefore (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α) : Set (ℕ → δ) :=
  {ω | ∃ n, position step x ω n ∈ C ∧ ∀ m ≤ n, position step x ω m ∉ A}

/-- A walk starting in the forbidden set cannot hit the target first. -/
theorem hitBefore_eq_empty (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ A) :
    hitBefore step A C x = ∅ := by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, _, hn⟩
    exact hn 0 (Nat.zero_le n) hx
  · exact False.elim

/-- A start in the target but outside the forbidden set is already a valid hit. -/
theorem hitBefore_eq_univ (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∈ C) : hitBefore step A C x = Set.univ := by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · intro _; trivial
  · intro _
    refine ⟨0, hxC, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    obtain rfl := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm
    exact hxA

/-- Away from both boundary sets, an ordered hit depends on the walk after its first step. -/
theorem consNat_mem_hitBefore_iff (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) (u : δ) (ω : ℕ → δ) :
    consNat u ω ∈ hitBefore step A C x ↔ ω ∈ hitBefore step A C (step x u) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    cases n with
    | zero => exact (hxC hnC).elim
    | succ n =>
      refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (position_consNat_succ step x u ω n) ▸ hnC
      · intro m hm
        have h := hnA (m + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hm)
        exact (position_consNat_succ step x u ω m) ▸ h
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    refine ⟨n + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [position_consNat_succ]; exact hnC
    · intro m hm
      cases m with
      | zero => exact hxA
      | succ m =>
        rw [position_consNat_succ]
        exact hnA m (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hm)

section Measurable

variable [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace δ]

/-- Every fixed-time position is a measurable function of the instructions. -/
theorem measurable_position (step : α → δ → α)
    (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step)) (x : α) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => position step x ω n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih => exact hstep.comp (ih.prodMk (measurable_pi_apply n))

/-- Ordered hitting is measurable for measurable step maps and boundary sets. -/
theorem measurableSet_hitBefore (step : α → δ → α)
    (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step)) (A C : Set α)
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hC : MeasurableSet C) (x : α) :
    MeasurableSet (hitBefore step A C x) := by
  have hmA (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {ω | position step x ω n ∉ A} :=
    ((measurable_position step hstep x n) hA).compl
  have hmC (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {ω | position step x ω n ∈ C} :=
    (measurable_position step hstep x n) hC
  simp only [hitBefore, Set.setOf_exists, Set.setOf_and, Set.setOf_forall]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => (hmC n).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter fun _ => hmA m)

/-- **First-step decomposition.** The probability of an ordered hit is the average of the probabilities after
one instruction, when the initial point belongs to neither boundary set. -/
theorem measure_hitBefore_eq_lintegral (μ : Measure δ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (step : α → δ → α) (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step))
    (A C : Set α) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hC : MeasurableSet C) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) :
    (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C x) =
      ∫⁻ u, (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C (step x u)) ∂μ := by
  have hE := measurableSet_hitBefore step hstep A C hA hC x
  have hI : Measurable ((hitBefore step A C x).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal))) :=
    measurable_const.indicator hE
  have h := lintegral_infinitePi_nat_head_tail μ _ hI
  have he (u : δ) :
      (fun ω => (hitBefore step A C x).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (consNat u ω)) =
        (hitBefore step A C (step x u)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases hm : consNat u ω ∈ hitBefore step A C x
    · have ht := (consNat_mem_hitBefore_iff step A C x hxA hxC u ω).mp hm
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm, Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    · have ht : ω ∉ hitBefore step A C (step x u) := fun ht =>
        hm ((consNat_mem_hitBefore_iff step A C x hxA hxC u ω).mpr ht)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hm, Set.indicator_of_notMem ht]
  simp only [he] at h
  rw [lintegral_indicator_fun_one hE] at h
  simp_rw [lintegral_indicator_fun_one (measurableSet_hitBefore step hstep A C hA hC _)] at h
  exact h

/-- The first-step equation for finitely many instructions with arbitrary weights. -/
theorem measure_hitBefore_eq_sum [Fintype δ] [MeasurableSingletonClass δ]
    (μ : Measure δ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (step : α → δ → α) (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step))
    (A C : Set α) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hC : MeasurableSet C) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) :
    (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C x) =
      ∑ u, (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C (step x u)) * μ {u} := by
  rw [measure_hitBefore_eq_lintegral μ step hstep A C hA hC x hxA hxC,
    lintegral_fintype]

end Measurable
end LatticeProb.DrivenWalk

/-- Finite unit-conductance wired SRW: the first-exit-before-zero hitting
probability equals the uniquely characterized zero/one Dirichlet voltage.
The iid direction word chooses each original incident copy with probability 1/4;
only its prefix through the first zero hit or exterior exit is observed. -/
theorem wired_srw_firstHit_voltage (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Site 2) :
    walkLaw (hitBefore (↑(S.image site) : Set (Site 2)) (box 2 N)ᶜ x) =

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

theorem driven_position (x : Site 2) (ω : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    DrivenWalk.position (fun y d => y + step d) x ω n = position x ω n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [DrivenWalk.position_succ, position_succ, ih]

theorem driven_hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    DrivenWalk.hitBefore (fun y d => y + step d) A C x = hitBefore A C x := by
  ext ω
  simp only [DrivenWalk.hitBefore, hitBefore, Set.mem_setOf_eq, driven_position]

theorem hitBefore_first_step (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) :
    walkLaw (hitBefore A C x) =
      ∑ d : Direction, walkLaw (hitBefore A C (x + step d)) / 4 := by
  have h := DrivenWalk.measure_hitBefore_eq_lintegral directionLaw
    (fun (y : Site 2) d => y + step d) (measurable_of_countable _)
    A C (Set.to_countable A).measurableSet (Set.to_countable C).measurableSet
    x hxA hxC
  simp only [driven_hitBefore, lintegral_fintype] at h
  unfold walkLaw
  rw [h]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  have hc : Nat.card Direction = 4 := by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]; decide
  simp only [directionLaw, uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Measure.count_singleton, mul_one, hc, Nat.cast_ofNat, div_eq_mul_inv]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

namespace FiniteAvalanches.WiredHitting
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired MeasureTheory
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-- The literal contraction of the exterior to the wired terminal. -/
def wiredVertex (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) : Vertex N :=
  if hx : inBox N x then some (activeOfSite N x hx) else none

private def other (N : ℕ) (x : Active N) (e : Edge N) : Vertex N :=
  if (endpoints e).1 = some x then (endpoints e).2 else (endpoints e).1

private theorem other_direction (N : ℕ) (x : Active N) (d : Direction) :
    other N x (directionEdge x d) = wiredVertex N (site x + step d) := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b
  · simp only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    by_cases hb : inBox N (site x - unit i)
    · have hn := endpoints_ne (directionEdge x (i,false))
      simp only [directionEdge, dif_pos hb, endpoints] at hn
      simp only [other, directionEdge, endpoints, wiredVertex, dif_pos hb, if_neg hn]
    · simp only [other, directionEdge, endpoints, wiredVertex, dif_neg hb, if_true]
  · simp only [step, if_true]
    by_cases hb : inBox N (site x + unit i)
    · simp only [other, directionEdge, endpoints, wiredVertex, dif_pos hb, if_true]
    · simp only [other, directionEdge, endpoints, wiredVertex, dif_neg hb, if_true]

/-- Positive copied-edge Laplacian, reindexed by every original direction once. -/
theorem laplacian_directions (N : ℕ) (f : Vertex N → ℝ) (x : Active N) :
    laplacian (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2) f (some x) =
      ∑ d : Direction, (f (some x) - f (wiredVertex N (site x + step d))) := by
  let I : Finset (Edge N) := Finset.univ.filter (Sandpile.Components.incident x)
  let g : Edge N → ℝ := fun e =>
    (if (endpoints e).1 = some x then f (some x)-f (endpoints e).2 else 0) +
    (if (endpoints e).2 = some x then f (some x)-f (endpoints e).1 else 0)
  have him : I = Finset.univ.image (directionEdge x) := by
    ext e
    simp only [I, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · exact Sandpile.Components.exists_direction_of_incident x e
    · rintro ⟨d,rfl⟩
      exact Sandpile.Components.direction_edge_incident x d
  have hz (e : Edge N) (he : e ∉ I) : g e = 0 := by
    have h : ¬Sandpile.Components.incident x e := by simpa [I] using he
    simp only [Sandpile.Components.incident, not_or] at h
    simp only [g, if_neg h.1, if_neg h.2, add_zero]
  have hp (e : Edge N) (he : e ∈ I) : g e = f (some x)-f (other N x e) := by
    have h : Sandpile.Components.incident x e := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
    rcases h with h | h
    · have hn : (endpoints e).2 ≠ some x := fun hh => endpoints_ne e (h.trans hh.symm)
      simp only [g, other, h, if_true, if_neg hn, add_zero]
    · have hn : (endpoints e).1 ≠ some x := fun hh => endpoints_ne e (hh.trans h.symm)
      simp only [g, other, h, if_true, if_neg hn, zero_add]
  have heq : laplacian (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1)
      (fun e => (endpoints e).2) f (some x) = ∑ e : Edge N, g e := by
    unfold laplacian
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    dsimp only [g]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ = ∑ e ∈ I, g e :=
      (Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := I) (s₂ := Finset.univ) (f := g)
        (Finset.subset_univ I) (fun e _ he => hz e he)).symm
    _ = ∑ e ∈ I, (f (some x)-f (other N x e)) := Finset.sum_congr rfl hp
    _ = ∑ d : Direction, (f (some x)-f (other N x (directionEdge x d))) := by
      rw [him, Finset.sum_image]
      exact fun d _ e _ h => Sandpile.Components.direction_edge_injective x h
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => by rw [other_direction])


/-- The real probability, with the exterior wired to the distinguished sink. -/
def hittingVoltage (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) : Vertex N → ℝ
  | none => 1
  | some x => (walkLaw (hitBefore (↑(S.image site)) (box 2 N)ᶜ (site x))).toReal

private theorem hitBefore_exterior (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Site 2)
    (hx : x ∉ box 2 N) : hitBefore (↑(S.image site)) (box 2 N)ᶜ x = Set.univ := by
  have hxA : x ∉ (↑(S.image site) : Set (Site 2)) := by
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    exact hx ((inBox_iff N (site y)).mp (fun i => (y i).property))
  rw [← driven_hitBefore]
  exact DrivenWalk.hitBefore_eq_univ _ _ _ _ hxA hx

private theorem hittingVoltage_wiredVertex (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Site 2) :
    hittingVoltage N S (wiredVertex N x) =
      (walkLaw (hitBefore (↑(S.image site)) (box 2 N)ᶜ x)).toReal := by
  by_cases hx : inBox N x
  · rw [wiredVertex, dif_pos hx]
    rfl
  · rw [wiredVertex, dif_neg hx, hittingVoltage,
      hitBefore_exterior N S x (fun h => hx ((inBox_iff N x).mpr h)), measure_univ]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_one.symm

private theorem hittingVoltage_zero (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N)
    (hx : x ∈ S) : hittingVoltage N S (some x) = 0 := by
  have he : hitBefore (↑(S.image site)) (box 2 N)ᶜ (site x) = ∅ := by
    rw [← driven_hitBefore]
    exact DrivenWalk.hitBefore_eq_empty _ _ _ _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem site hx)
  simp only [hittingVoltage, he, measure_empty, ENNReal.toReal_zero]

private theorem hittingVoltage_harmonic (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N)
    (hx : x ∉ S) : laplacian (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1)
      (fun e => (endpoints e).2) (hittingVoltage N S) (some x) = 0 := by
  have hxA : site x ∉ (↑(S.image site) : Set (Site 2)) := by
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    exact hx ((site_injective N he) ▸ hy)
  have hxC : site x ∉ (box 2 N)ᶜ := by
    exact fun h => h ((inBox_iff N (site x)).mp (fun i => (x i).property))
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal (hitBefore_first_step
    (↑(S.image site)) (box 2 N)ᶜ (site x) hxA hxC)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum] at h
  · simp only [ENNReal.toReal_div, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat] at h
    rw [laplacian_directions, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [hittingVoltage_wiredVertex]
    have hc : Fintype.card Direction = 4 := by decide
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hc, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat,
      hittingVoltage]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div] at h
    linarith only [h]
  · intro d _
    exact ENNReal.div_ne_top (measure_ne_top walkLaw _) (by norm_num)

theorem hittingVoltage_eq_voltage (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) :
    hittingVoltage N S = Needle.voltage N S := by
  apply Needle.voltage_unique N S
  · rfl
  · exact hittingVoltage_zero N S
  · intro v hv
    cases v with
    | none => exact (hv (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).elim
    | some x =>
      apply hittingVoltage_harmonic
      intro hx
      exact hv (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem some hx))

/-- The literal full-carrier hitting probability equals the copied-network voltage. -/
theorem wired_srw_firstHit_voltage (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Site 2) :
    walkLaw (hitBefore (↑(S.image site) : Set (Site 2)) (box 2 N)ᶜ x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Needle.voltage N S
        (if hx : inBox N x then some (activeOfSite N x hx) else none)) := by
  rw [← wiredVertex, ← hittingVoltage_eq_voltage, hittingVoltage_wiredVertex,
    ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top walkLaw _)]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.WiredHitting

/-
The lattice `ℤ^d`: sites, unit vectors, the nearest-neighbour graph, and the
simple random walk operator.  Shared by every formalization in this library.

How the objects are modelled:

- A site is `Fin d → ℤ`.  Two sites are neighbours when they differ by a unit
  vector; the graph is `lattice d`.
- `nbrSum u x` is the sum of `u` over the `2d` neighbours of `x`, counted with
  multiplicity in the direction `i`, so that `d = 0` is not special-cased.
- `walkOp` is the transition operator of simple random walk,
  `(P u)(x) = (1/2d) ∑_{y ∼ x} u(y)`.
-/
import Mathlib

namespace LatticeProb

/-- A site of the lattice `ℤ^d`. -/
abbrev Site (d : ℕ) : Type := Fin d → ℤ

/-- The unit vector in direction `i`. -/
def unit {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) : Site d := Pi.single i 1

theorem unit_ne_zero {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) : unit i ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h i
  simp [unit, Pi.single_eq_same] at this

/-- The nearest-neighbour lattice on `ℤ^d`. -/
def lattice (d : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (Site d) where
  Adj x y := ∃ i : Fin d, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ h => h.imp fun _ hi => hi.symm⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun x h => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := h
    · exact unit_ne_zero i (by have := congrArg (· - x) hi; simpa using this.symm)
    · exact unit_ne_zero i (by have := congrArg (· - x) hi; simpa using this.symm)⟩

/-- The `2d` neighbours of `x`, as a finset. -/
def nbrFinset {d : ℕ} (x : Site d) : Finset (Site d) :=
  Finset.univ.biUnion fun i : Fin d => {x + unit i, x - unit i}

/-- The sum of `u` over the neighbours of `x`, direction by direction. -/
def nbrSum {d : ℕ} (u : Site d → ℝ) (x : Site d) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin d, (u (x + unit i) + u (x - unit i))

/-- The simple random walk operator `(P u)(x) = (1/2d) ∑_{y ∼ x} u(y)`. -/
noncomputable def walkOp {d : ℕ} (u : Site d → ℝ) (x : Site d) : ℝ :=
  nbrSum u x / (2 * d)

/-- The sup-norm box `[-r, r]^d`. -/
def box (d : ℕ) (r : ℕ) : Set (Site d) := {x | ∀ i, |x i| ≤ r}

/-- The vertices joined to `x` inside `S`, along edges of the lattice. -/
def componentIn {d : ℕ} (S : Set (Site d)) (x : Site d) : Set (Site d) :=
  {y | ∃ (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S), ((lattice d).induce S).Reachable ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩}

/-- `S` contains an infinite nearest-neighbour component. -/
def HasInfiniteComponent {d : ℕ} (S : Set (Site d)) : Prop :=
  ∃ x ∈ S, (componentIn S x).Infinite

end LatticeProb

import LatticeProb.Site

/-!
Finite wired square boxes, with individual exit edge copies and forbidden-subset
recurrence. The counting law below is on the literal allowed-height subtype;
its identification with Markov recurrence is a separate literature result.
-/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

open LatticeProb MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

abbrev Active (N : ℕ) := Fin 2 → Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)

def site {N : ℕ} (x : Active N) : Site 2 := fun i => (x i).val

theorem site_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@site N) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun h i)

def inBox (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) : Prop := ∀ i, -(N : ℤ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ N

def activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) : Active N :=
  fun i => ⟨x i, h i⟩

theorem site_activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) :
    site (activeOfSite N x h) = x := rfl

theorem inBox_iff (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) :
    inBox N x ↔ x ∈ box 2 N := by
  simp only [inBox, box, Set.mem_setOf_eq, abs_le]

abbrev Direction := Fin 2 × Bool

def step (d : Direction) : Site 2 := if d.2 then unit d.1 else -unit d.1

theorem step_injective : Function.Injective step := by
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals norm_num [step, unit, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two] at h
  all_goals rfl

abbrev InteriorEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Active N // ∃ i : Fin 2, site p.2 = site p.1 + unit i}

abbrev ExitEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Direction // ¬inBox N (site p.1 + step p.2)}

/-- Each internal edge occurs in its positive-coordinate orientation once.
An exit copy remembers both its active endpoint and its outward direction. -/
abbrev Edge (N : ℕ) := InteriorEdge N ⊕ ExitEdge N

abbrev Vertex (N : ℕ) := Option (Active N)

def endpoints {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) : Vertex N × Vertex N :=
  match e with
  | .inl e => (some e.val.1, some e.val.2)
  | .inr e => (some e.val.1, none)

def conductance {N : ℕ} (_e : Edge N) : ℝ := 1

theorem endpoints_ne {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) :
    (endpoints e).1 ≠ (endpoints e).2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl e =>
    intro h
    have he : e.val.1 = e.val.2 := Option.some.inj h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    have hh := congrFun hi i
    rw [he] at hh
    simp [unit, site] at hh
  | inr e => simp [endpoints]

abbrev Heights (N : ℕ) := Active N → Fin 4

def internalDegree {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) : ℕ :=
  (nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site).card

theorem mem_neighbors_iff (x y : Site 2) :
    y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ (lattice 2).Adj x y := by
  change y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩

theorem internalDegree_eq_adj_card {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) :
    internalDegree s x = (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).card := by
  classical
  have he : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site =
      (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).image site := by
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, mem_neighbors_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [internalDegree, he, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (site_injective N)]

def forbidden {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) (s : Finset (Active N)) : Prop :=
  s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, (η x).val < internalDegree s x

def recurrent {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) : Prop := ∀ s, ¬forbidden η s

def allThree (N : ℕ) : Heights N := fun _ => 3

private theorem card_neighbors (x : Site 2) : (nbrFinset x).card = 4 := by
  classical
  rw [nbrFinset, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 2, ({x + unit i, x - unit i} : Finset (Site 2)).card = 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_singleton]
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
      intro h
      have hi := congrFun h i
      simp only [unit, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] at hi
      omega
    simp [hc]
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro a (rfl | rfl) (h | h) <;>
      have h1 := congrFun h i <;>
      have h2 := congrFun h j <;>
      simp [unit, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_of_ne, hij] at h1 h2

theorem exists_boundary_vertex {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, internalDegree s x ≤ 3 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun x => site x 0) hs
  have hout : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∉ s.image site := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hle := hmax y hy
    have he0 := congrFun he 0
    simp [unit] at he0
    omega
  have hsub : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site ⊂ nbrFinset (site x) := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨Finset.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
    intro he
    have hm : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∈ nbrFinset (site x) := by
      simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    rw [← he] at hm
    exact hout (Finset.mem_inter.mp hm).2
  have hc := Finset.card_lt_card hsub
  rw [card_neighbors] at hc
  exact ⟨x, hx, by dsimp [internalDegree]; omega⟩

theorem allThree_recurrent (N : ℕ) : recurrent (allThree N) := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdeg⟩ := exists_boundary_vertex s hs.1
  have hlt := hs.2 x hx
  change 3 < internalDegree s x at hlt
  omega

abbrev Recurrent (N : ℕ) := {η : Heights N // recurrent η}

instance recurrentNonempty (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (Recurrent N) :=
  ⟨⟨allThree N, allThree_recurrent N⟩⟩

instance recurrentFintype (N : ℕ) : Fintype (Recurrent N) := Fintype.ofFinite _

instance recurrentMeasurableSpace (N : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Recurrent N) := ⊤

instance recurrentMeasurableSingletonClass (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (Recurrent N) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Normalized counting measure on all stable fields with no forbidden subset. -/
def law (N : ℕ) : Measure (Recurrent N) :=
  (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

theorem law_singleton (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) :
    law N {η} = (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  simp [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

instance lawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (law N) := by
  constructor
  simp only [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]
  simp [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem law_apply (N : ℕ) (s : Set (Recurrent N)) :
    law N s = s.encard / Fintype.card (Recurrent N) := by
  rw [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_apply s.toFinite.measurableSet]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

/-- Auxiliary zero extension of a finite input field, not an infinite-volume law. -/
def zeroExtend (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) : Site 2 → Fin 4 :=
  fun x => if h : inBox N x then η.val (activeOfSite N x h) else 0

theorem zeroExtend_site (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Active N) :
    zeroExtend N η (site x) = η.val x := by
  have h : inBox N (site x) := fun i => (x i).property
  rw [zeroExtend, dif_pos h]
  congr 1

theorem zeroExtend_outside (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Site 2)
    (h : ¬inBox N x) : zeroExtend N η x = 0 := by
  simp only [zeroExtend, dif_neg h]

theorem zeroExtend_measurable (N : ℕ) : Measurable (zeroExtend N) :=
  measurable_of_countable _

/-- Push-forward of the finite recurrent counting law by the specified zero extension. -/
def finiteFieldLaw (N : ℕ) : Measure (Site 2 → Fin 4) :=
  Measure.map (zeroExtend N) (law N)

instance finiteFieldLawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteFieldLaw N) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (zeroExtend_measurable N).aemeasurable




end

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

import FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTermination

/-! The wired Laplacian retains all four direction copies, including sink exits. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

/-- The actual edge copy traversed in a direction from an active vertex. -/
def directionEdge {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) : Direction → Edge R
  | (i, true) =>
      if h : inBox R (site x + unit i) then
        .inl ⟨(x, activeOfSite R (site x + unit i) h), ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
      else .inr ⟨(x, (i, true)), by simpa only [step, if_true] using h⟩
  | (i, false) =>
      if h : inBox R (site x - unit i) then
        .inl ⟨(activeOfSite R (site x - unit i) h, x), ⟨i, by
          change site x = site x - unit i + unit i
          abel⟩⟩
      else .inr ⟨(x, (i, false)), by simpa only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
        ← sub_eq_add_neg] using h⟩

theorem direction_edge_exit {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) (d : Direction)
    (hd : ¬inBox R (site x + step d)) : directionEdge x d = .inr ⟨(x, d), hd⟩ := by
  rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b <;> simp only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg] at hd ⊢ <;> simp [directionEdge, hd] <;> rfl

theorem direction_edge_exit_injective {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) {d e : Direction}
    (hd : ¬inBox R (site x + step d)) (he : ¬inBox R (site x + step e))
    (h : directionEdge x d = directionEdge x e) : d = e := by
  rw [direction_edge_exit x d hd, direction_edge_exit x e he] at h
  exact congrArg (fun z : ExitEdge R => z.val.2) (Sum.inr.inj h)

theorem conductance_direction_edge {R : ℕ} (x : Active R) (d : Direction) :
    conductance (directionEdge x d) = 1 := rfl

/-- Auxiliary zero extension of active toppling counts to the sink exterior. -/
def wiredCountExtension (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  if hx : inBox R x then u (activeOfSite R x hx) else 0

theorem wired_count_extension_site (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Active R) :
    wiredCountExtension R u (site x) = u x := by
  have hx : inBox R (site x) := fun i => (x i).property
  simp only [wiredCountExtension, dif_pos hx]
  congr 1

/-- Each direction contributes once; exterior directions are separate sink edge copies. -/
def wiredLap (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Active R) : ℤ :=
  ∑ d : Direction, (wiredCountExtension R u (site x + step d) - u x)

theorem wired_lap_eq_lap (R : ℕ) (u : Active R → ℤ) (x : Active R) :
    wiredLap R u x = lap (wiredCountExtension R u) (site x) := by
  simp only [wiredLap, Direction, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool, step,
    Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, ← sub_eq_add_neg,
    lap, nbrSumZ, Fin.sum_univ_two, wired_count_extension_site]
  ring

theorem wired_count_extension_counts {R : ℕ} (u : Counts)
    (hu : u.support ⊆ boxSites R) :
    wiredCountExtension R (fun x => (u (site x) : ℤ)) = fun x => (u x : ℤ) := by
  funext x
  unfold wiredCountExtension
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i hx
    have hz : u x = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp
      (fun h => hx ((mem_box_sites R x).mp (hu h)))
    simp [hz]

theorem wired_lap_counts {R : ℕ} (u : Counts) (hu : u.support ⊆ boxSites R)
    (x : Active R) :
    wiredLap R (fun y => (u (site y) : ℤ)) x = lap (fun y => (u y : ℤ)) (site x) := by
  rw [wired_lap_eq_lap, wired_count_extension_counts u hu]


end
end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredTrees
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredLaplacian

/-! A literal spanning tree: every row follows its positive first-coordinate copies to the sink. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

noncomputable def rowEdge {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : FiniteWired.Edge N :=
  FiniteWired.directionEdge x (0, true)

noncomputable def rowEdges (N : ℕ) : Finset (FiniteWired.Edge N) :=
  Finset.univ.image rowEdge

theorem shifted_in_box_iff {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) ↔ (x 0).val < N := by
  obtain ⟨h0l, h0r⟩ := (x 0).property
  obtain ⟨h1l, h1r⟩ := (x 1).property
  simp only [FiniteWired.inBox, Fin.forall_fin_two, Pi.add_apply, FiniteWired.site,
    LatticeProb.unit, Pi.single_apply, ite_true]
  norm_num
  omega

theorem row_edge_endpoints {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x) =
      if h : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) then
        (some x, some (FiniteWired.activeOfSite N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) h))
      else (some x, none) := by
  by_cases h : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0)
  · simp [rowEdge, FiniteWired.directionEdge, h, FiniteWired.endpoints]
  · simp [rowEdge, FiniteWired.directionEdge, h, FiniteWired.endpoints]

theorem row_edge_left {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (graph N).left (rowEdge x) = some x := by
  change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).1 = some x
  rw [row_edge_endpoints]
  split <;> rfl

theorem row_edge_mem {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : rowEdge x ∈ rowEdges N :=
  Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

private theorem active_eq_of_coordinates {N : ℕ} {x y : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (h0 : (y 0).val = (x 0).val) (h1 : (y 1).val = (x 1).val) : y = x := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact Subtype.ext h0
  · exact Subtype.ext h1

/-- The vertices separated from the sink by deletion of the outgoing copy at x. -/
def prefixRow {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N) :=
  {v | match v with
    | none => False
    | some y => (y 1).val = (x 1).val ∧ (y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val}

theorem row_edge_right_not_mem {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (graph N).right (rowEdge x) ∉ prefixRow x := by
  change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).2 ∉ prefixRow x
  rw [row_edge_endpoints]
  split
  · simp only [prefixRow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, FiniteWired.activeOfSite, FiniteWired.site,
      Pi.add_apply, LatticeProb.unit, Pi.single_apply]
    norm_num
  · simp [prefixRow]

theorem other_row_edge_same_side {N : ℕ} (x y : FiniteWired.Active N) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    (graph N).left (rowEdge y) ∈ prefixRow x ↔
      (graph N).right (rowEdge y) ∈ prefixRow x := by
  have hn : ¬ ((y 1).val = (x 1).val ∧ (y 0).val = (x 0).val) :=
    fun h => hne (active_eq_of_coordinates h.2 h.1)
  change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge y)).1 ∈ prefixRow x ↔
    (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge y)).2 ∈ prefixRow x
  rw [row_edge_endpoints]
  split
  · simp only [prefixRow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, FiniteWired.activeOfSite, FiniteWired.site,
      Pi.add_apply, LatticeProb.unit, Pi.single_apply]
    norm_num
    intro hrow
    change (y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val ↔ (y 0).val < (x 0).val
    have hneq := fun h => hn ⟨hrow, h⟩
    omega
  · rename_i hy
    have hb : (y 0).val = N := by
      have h := (shifted_in_box_iff y).not.mp hy
      have hle := (y 0).property.2
      omega
    have hx := (x 0).property.2
    simp only [prefixRow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨hrow, hle⟩
    exact hn ⟨hrow, by omega⟩

theorem row_edges_is_forest (N : ℕ) : (graph N).is_forest (rowEdges N) := by
  intro e he hreach
  obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
  have hside : ∀ f ∈ (rowEdges N).erase (rowEdge x),
      (graph N).left f ∈ prefixRow x ↔ (graph N).right f ∈ prefixRow x := by
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hf)
    apply other_row_edge_same_side x y
    intro h
    apply (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1
    rw [h]
  have hsame := (graph N).reaches_mem_iff hside hreach
  have hl : (graph N).left (rowEdge x) ∈ prefixRow x := by
    rw [row_edge_left]
    exact ⟨rfl, le_rfl⟩
  exact row_edge_right_not_mem x (hsame.mp hl)

theorem row_reaches_sink {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (graph N).reaches (rowEdges N) (some x) none := by
  have hall (d : ℕ) : ∀ x : FiniteWired.Active N,
      ((N : ℤ) - (x 0).val).toNat = d →
        (graph N).reaches (rowEdges N) (some x) none := by
    induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h d ih =>
      intro x hd
      by_cases hx : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0)
      · let y := FiniteWired.activeOfSite N (FiniteWired.site x + LatticeProb.unit 0) hx
        have hy : (y 0).val = (x 0).val + 1 := by simp [y, FiniteWired.activeOfSite, FiniteWired.site, LatticeProb.unit]
        have hlt : ((N : ℤ) - (y 0).val).toNat < d := by
          have h := (shifted_in_box_iff x).mp hx
          rw [hy]
          omega
        have hstep : (graph N).adjacent (rowEdges N) (some x) (some y) := by
          refine ⟨rowEdge x, row_edge_mem x, Or.inl ⟨row_edge_left x, ?_⟩⟩
          change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).2 = some y
          rw [row_edge_endpoints, dif_pos hx]
        exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hstep).trans (ih _ hlt y rfl)
      · apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        refine ⟨rowEdge x, row_edge_mem x, Or.inl ⟨row_edge_left x, ?_⟩⟩
        change (FiniteWired.endpoints (rowEdge x)).2 = none
        rw [row_edge_endpoints, dif_neg hx]
  exact hall _ x rfl

theorem row_edges_is_tree (N : ℕ) : (graph N).is_tree Set.univ (rowEdges N) := by
  have hr (v : FiniteWired.Vertex N) : (graph N).reaches (rowEdges N) v none := by
    cases v with
    | none => exact .refl
    | some x => exact row_reaches_sink x
  exact ⟨⟨none, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (fun _ _ => ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_univ _⟩),
    (fun x _ y _ => (hr x).trans ((graph N).reaches_symm (hr y))), row_edges_is_forest N⟩

/-- A genuine ordinary copied-edge spanning tree, also in the radius-zero box. -/
noncomputable def rowTree (N : ℕ) : (graph N).SpanningTree := ⟨rowEdges N, row_edges_is_tree N⟩

instance spanningTreeNonempty (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (graph N).SpanningTree := ⟨rowTree N⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees

import FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components.Degrees
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredTrees

/-! Every original wired incident copy is exactly one direction copy. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components
open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Waves
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- Incidence remembers the original copy, including individual sink exits. -/
def incident {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) (e : FiniteWired.Edge N) : Prop :=
  (FiniteWired.endpoints e).1 = some x ∨ (FiniteWired.endpoints e).2 = some x

theorem direction_edge_incident {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N)
    (d : FiniteWired.Direction) : incident x (FiniteWired.directionEdge x d) := by
  rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b
  all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge]
  all_goals split_ifs
  all_goals simp [incident, FiniteWired.endpoints]

/-- An incident interior or exit copy comes from an actual direction at x. -/
theorem exists_direction_of_incident {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N)
    (e : FiniteWired.Edge N) (he : incident x e) :
    ∃ d : FiniteWired.Direction, FiniteWired.directionEdge x d = e := by
  cases e with
  | inl e =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    rcases he with he | he
    · have hx : e.val.1 = x := Option.some.inj he
      have hb : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + unit i) := by
        rw [← hx, ← hi]
        exact fun j => (e.val.2 j).property
      refine ⟨(i, true), ?_⟩
      simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge, dif_pos hb]
      apply congrArg Sum.inl
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact hx.symm
      · apply FiniteWired.site_injective N
        exact (hx ▸ hi).symm
    · have hx : e.val.2 = x := Option.some.inj he
      have hs : FiniteWired.site x - unit i = FiniteWired.site e.val.1 := by
        rw [← hx, hi]
        abel
      have hb : FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x - unit i) := by
        rw [hs]
        exact fun j => (e.val.1 j).property
      refine ⟨(i, false), ?_⟩
      simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge, dif_pos hb]
      apply congrArg Sum.inl
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact FiniteWired.site_injective N hs
      · exact hx.symm
  | inr e =>
    have hx : e.val.1 = x := by
      rcases he with he | he
      · exact Option.some.inj he
      · have hn : (none : FiniteWired.Vertex N) = some x := he
        cases hn
    have hb : ¬FiniteWired.inBox N (FiniteWired.site x + FiniteWired.step e.val.2) := by
      simpa only [hx] using e.property
    refine ⟨e.val.2, ?_⟩
    rw [FiniteWired.direction_edge_exit x e.val.2 hb]
    apply congrArg Sum.inr
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext hx.symm rfl

/-- Uniqueness precedes any conversion from original copies to directions. -/
theorem existsUnique_direction_of_incident {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N)
    (e : FiniteWired.Edge N) (he : incident x e) :
    ∃! d : FiniteWired.Direction, FiniteWired.directionEdge x d = e := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_direction_of_incident x e he
  exact ⟨d, hd, fun d' hd' => direction_edge_injective x (hd'.trans hd.symm)⟩

/-- Retention in the inside component is exactly the neighbor-in-C test. -/
theorem inner_direction_endpoints_iff {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (C : ComponentShape o) (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∈ C.val})
    (d : FiniteWired.Direction) :
    (insideVertex C.val (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x.val d)).1 ∧
      insideVertex C.val (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x.val d)).2) ↔
        FiniteWired.site x.val + FiniteWired.step d ∈ C.val := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
    cases b
    all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge] at he
    all_goals split_ifs at he
    all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.endpoints, insideVertex, FiniteWired.site_activeOfSite] at he
    all_goals first
      | simpa only [FiniteWired.step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using he.1
      | simpa only [FiniteWired.step, if_true] using he.2
  · exact inner_direction_edge_endpoints C.property.1 x.property d

/-- Retention in the sink component is exactly the neighbor-outside-C test. -/
theorem outer_direction_endpoints_iff {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (C : ComponentShape o) (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∉ C.val})
    (d : FiniteWired.Direction) :
    (outsideVertex C.val (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x.val d)).1 ∧
      outsideVertex C.val (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x.val d)).2) ↔
        FiniteWired.site x.val + FiniteWired.step d ∉ C.val := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
    cases b
    all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge] at he
    all_goals split_ifs at he
    all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.endpoints, outsideVertex, FiniteWired.site_activeOfSite] at he
    all_goals first
      | simpa only [FiniteWired.step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using he.1
      | simpa only [FiniteWired.step, if_true] using he.2
      | rename_i hb
        intro hm
        apply hb
        simpa only [FiniteWired.step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true,
          ← sub_eq_add_neg] using (mem_box_sites N _).mp (C.property.1 hm)
  · exact outer_direction_edge_endpoints x.property d

/-- Literal induced-graph incident copies: incidence and both endpoints in the support. -/
def inducedIncidentCopies {N : ℕ} (V : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N))
    (x : FiniteWired.Active N) : Finset (FiniteWired.Edge N) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun e => incident x e ∧
    (FiniteWired.endpoints e).1 ∈ V ∧ (FiniteWired.endpoints e).2 ∈ V)

theorem inner_incident_copies_eq {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (C : ComponentShape o) (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∈ C.val}) :
    innerIncidentCopies C x = inducedIncidentCopies {v | insideVertex C.val v} x.val := by
  ext e
  simp only [innerIncidentCopies, inducedIncidentCopies, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨direction_edge_incident x.val d,
      (inner_direction_endpoints_iff C x d).mpr ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi, he⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_direction_of_incident x.val e hi
    refine ⟨d, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩, hd⟩
    apply (inner_direction_endpoints_iff C x d).mp
    simpa only [hd] using he

theorem outer_incident_copies_eq {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (C : ComponentShape o) (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∉ C.val}) :
    outerIncidentCopies C x = inducedIncidentCopies {v | outsideVertex C.val v} x.val := by
  ext e
  simp only [outerIncidentCopies, inducedIncidentCopies, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨direction_edge_incident x.val d,
      (outer_direction_endpoints_iff C x d).mpr ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi, he⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_direction_of_incident x.val e hi
    refine ⟨d, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩, hd⟩
    apply (outer_direction_endpoints_iff C x d).mp
    simpa only [hd] using he

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components

import FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components.Fields
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.WiredLaplacian

/-! Induced complementary degrees retain individual wired direction copies.
Each outside direction is retained, including every distinct sink exit. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components
open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Waves
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def innerDirections (C : Finset Site2) (x : Site2) : Finset FiniteWired.Direction :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun d => x + FiniteWired.step d ∈ C)
def outerDirections (C : Finset Site2) (x : Site2) : Finset FiniteWired.Direction :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun d => x + FiniteWired.step d ∉ C)

theorem degree_eq_card_inner_directions (C : Finset Site2) (x : Site2) :
    degree C x = (innerDirections C x).card := by
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun d : FiniteWired.Direction => x + FiniteWired.step d) := by
    intro d e h
    exact FiniteWired.step_injective (add_left_cancel h)
  have he : (innerDirections C x).image (fun d => x + FiniteWired.step d) = nbrFinset x ∩ C := by
    ext y
    simp only [innerDirections, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and, Finset.mem_inter, nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_insert,
      Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨i, b⟩, hC, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hC⟩
      cases b
      · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by simp [FiniteWired.step, sub_eq_add_neg])⟩
      · exact ⟨i, Or.inl (by simp [FiniteWired.step])⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨i, h | h⟩, hC⟩
      · refine ⟨(i, true), ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [FiniteWired.step, ← h] using hC
        · simpa [FiniteWired.step] using h.symm
      · refine ⟨(i, false), ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [FiniteWired.step, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← h] using hC
        · simpa [FiniteWired.step, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using h.symm
  rw [degree, ← he, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hi]

theorem card_outer_directions (C : Finset Site2) (x : Site2) :
    (outerDirections C x).card = 4 - degree C x := by
  have h := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset FiniteWired.Direction)) (p := fun d => x + FiniteWired.step d ∈ C)
  change (innerDirections C x).card + (outerDirections C x).card = _ at h
  rw [← degree_eq_card_inner_directions C x] at h
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset FiniteWired.Direction).card = 4 := by decide
  change degree C x + (outerDirections C x).card = _ at h
  omega

/-- Distinct directions give distinct original incident edge copies. -/
theorem direction_edge_injective {N : ℕ} (x : FiniteWired.Active N) :
    Function.Injective (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.directionEdge x) := by
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals first | rfl | skip
  all_goals simp only [FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.directionEdge] at h
  all_goals split_ifs at h
  all_goals first
    | exact Sum.noConfusion h
    | exact congrArg (fun e : FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.ExitEdge N => e.val.2)
        (Sum.inr.inj h)
    | have hp := congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inl.inj h)
      have ha0 := congrArg (fun p : FiniteWired.Active N × FiniteWired.Active N =>
        FiniteWired.site p.1 0) hp
      have ha1 := congrArg (fun p : FiniteWired.Active N × FiniteWired.Active N =>
        FiniteWired.site p.1 1) hp
      have hb0 := congrArg (fun p : FiniteWired.Active N × FiniteWired.Active N =>
        FiniteWired.site p.2 0) hp
      have hb1 := congrArg (fun p : FiniteWired.Active N × FiniteWired.Active N =>
        FiniteWired.site p.2 1) hp
      simp [FiniteWired.site,
        FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.activeOfSite, unit] at ha0 ha1 hb0 hb1

/-- Original edge copies incident to an outer active vertex and retained in D.
The set carrier restricts C to the original wired volume. -/
def outerIncidentCopies {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N} (C : ComponentShape o)
    (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∉ C.val}) : Finset (FiniteWired.Edge N) :=
  (outerDirections C.val (FiniteWired.site x.val)).image
    (FiniteWired.directionEdge x.val)

theorem card_outer_incident_copies {N : ℕ}
    {o : FiniteWired.Active N} (C : ComponentShape o)
    (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∉ C.val}) :
    (outerIncidentCopies C x).card = 4 - degree C.val (FiniteWired.site x.val) := by
  rw [outerIncidentCopies, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (direction_edge_injective x.val)]
  exact card_outer_directions C.val (FiniteWired.site x.val)

/-- Internal original copies incident to a C-vertex; source edges remain present. -/
def innerIncidentCopies {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N} (C : ComponentShape o)
    (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∈ C.val}) : Finset (FiniteWired.Edge N) :=
  (innerDirections C.val (FiniteWired.site x.val)).image
    (FiniteWired.directionEdge x.val)

theorem card_inner_incident_copies {N : ℕ}
    {o : FiniteWired.Active N} (C : ComponentShape o)
    (x : {x : FiniteWired.Active N // FiniteWired.site x ∈ C.val}) :
    (innerIncidentCopies C x).card = degree C.val (FiniteWired.site x.val) := by
  rw [innerIncidentCopies, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (direction_edge_injective x.val)]
  exact (degree_eq_card_inner_directions C.val (FiniteWired.site x.val)).symm

def outsideVertex {N : ℕ} (C : Finset Site2) : FiniteWired.Vertex N → Prop
  | none => True
  | some x => FiniteWired.site x ∉ C

def insideVertex {N : ℕ} (C : Finset Site2) : FiniteWired.Vertex N → Prop
  | none => False
  | some x => FiniteWired.site x ∈ C

theorem outer_direction_edge_endpoints {N : ℕ} {o : FiniteWired.Active N}
    {C : ComponentShape o} {x : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (hx : FiniteWired.site x ∉ C.val) (d : FiniteWired.Direction)
    (hd : FiniteWired.site x + FiniteWired.step d ∉ C.val) :
    outsideVertex C.val (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x d)).1 ∧
      outsideVertex C.val (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x d)).2 := by
  rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b
  all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg] at hd
  all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge]
  all_goals split_ifs
  all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.endpoints, outsideVertex]
  all_goals first | exact ⟨hd, hx⟩ | exact ⟨hx, hd⟩ | exact ⟨hx, True.intro⟩

theorem inner_direction_edge_endpoints {N : ℕ} {C : Finset Site2}
    (hC : C ⊆ boxSites N) {x : FiniteWired.Active N}
    (hx : FiniteWired.site x ∈ C) (d : FiniteWired.Direction)
    (hd : FiniteWired.site x + FiniteWired.step d ∈ C) :
    insideVertex C (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x d)).1 ∧
      insideVertex C (FiniteWired.endpoints (FiniteWired.directionEdge x d)).2 := by
  have hb : FiniteWired.inBox N
      (FiniteWired.site x + FiniteWired.step d) := (mem_box_sites N _).mp (hC hd)
  rcases d with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b
  all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg] at hd hb
  all_goals simp only [FiniteWired.directionEdge, dif_pos hb, FiniteWired.endpoints, insideVertex]
  all_goals first | exact ⟨hd, hx⟩ | exact ⟨hx, hd⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components
