import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import LatticeProb.Graph.Zd
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Harmonic.Bounds

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Needle
open LatticeProb
open scoped BigOperators Classical

abbrev Point := Site 2

def radius (x : Point) : ℤ := max |x 0| |x 1|

def linf (x y : Point) : ℤ := radius (x - y)

theorem radius_nonneg (x : Point) : 0 ≤ radius x :=
  (abs_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _)

theorem radius_le_iff (x : Point) (r : ℤ) :
    radius x ≤ r ↔ ∀ i, |x i| ≤ r := by
  simp [radius, Fin.forall_fin_two]

theorem mem_box_iff (x : Point) (r : ℕ) :
    x ∈ box 2 r ↔ radius x ≤ r := (radius_le_iff x r).symm

theorem radius_sub_le (x y : Point) : radius (x - y) ≤ radius x + radius y := by
  apply (radius_le_iff _ _).mpr
  intro i
  have hx := (radius_le_iff x (radius x)).mp le_rfl i
  have hy := (radius_le_iff y (radius y)).mp le_rfl i
  exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add hx hy)

theorem radius_le_radius_add (x y : Point) : radius x ≤ radius (x - y) + radius y := by
  have h := radius_sub_le (x - y) (-y)
  simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add, sub_add_cancel, radius, Pi.neg_apply, abs_neg] using h

/-- The reversed left/down staircase, followed by the horizontal segment. -/
def staircase (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (_hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (_hb : b ≤ 2*h) (t : Fin (h + (b - h).toNat + 1)) : Point :=
  ![(2 * h : ℤ) - ((t.val : ℤ) - min (t.val / 2) (b - h).toNat),
    b - min (t.val / 2) (b - h).toNat]

theorem staircase_coordinates (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ)
    (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * h) (t : Fin (h + (b - h).toNat + 1)) :
    (h : ℤ) ≤ staircase h b hb0 hb t 0 ∧ staircase h b hb0 hb t 0 ≤ 2 * h ∧
    0 ≤ staircase h b hb0 hb t 1 ∧ staircase h b hb0 hb t 1 ≤ 2 * h ∧
    staircase h b hb0 hb t 1 ≤ staircase h b hb0 hb t 0 + 1 := by
  have ht := t.isLt
  dsimp [staircase]
  omega

theorem staircase_radial (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ)
    (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * h) (t : Fin (h + (b - h).toNat + 1)) :
    radius (staircase h b hb0 hb t) ≤ 2 * h ∧
    linf ![2 * h, b] (staircase h b hb0 hb t) ≤ 2 * h - radius (staircase h b hb0 hb t) + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨hx0, hx1, hy0, hy1, _⟩ := staircase_coordinates h b hb0 hb t
  have ht := t.isLt
  simp only [radius, linf, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ staircase h b hb0 hb t 0 by omega),
    abs_of_nonneg hy0]
  dsimp [staircase] at *
  simp only [abs_eq_max_neg]
  omega

theorem staircase_start (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 2*h) :
    staircase h b hb0 hb ⟨0, by omega⟩ = ![(2 * h : ℤ), b] := by
  simp [staircase]

theorem staircase_end_mem_box (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ)
    (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 2 * h) :
    staircase h b hb0 hb ⟨h + (b - h).toNat, by omega⟩ ∈ box 2 h := by
  rw [mem_box_iff, radius_le_iff]
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp [staircase] <;> rw [abs_le] <;> omega

theorem staircase_adj (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 2*h) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : t < h + (b - h).toNat) :
    (lattice 2).Adj (staircase h b hb0 hb ⟨t, by omega⟩)
      (staircase h b hb0 hb ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩) := by
  have hstep : min ((t+1)/2) (b-h).toNat = min (t/2) (b-h).toNat ∨
      min ((t+1)/2) (b-h).toNat = min (t/2) (b-h).toNat + 1 := by omega
  rcases hstep with hs | hs
  · refine ⟨0, Or.inr ?_⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [staircase, unit] <;> omega
  · refine ⟨1, Or.inr ?_⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [staircase, unit] <;> omega

theorem staircase_injective (h : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 2*h) : Function.Injective (staircase h b hb0 hb) := by
  intro t s he
  have h0 := congrFun he 0
  have h1 := congrFun he 1
  apply Fin.ext
  dsimp [staircase] at h0 h1
  omega


/-- Signed permutations are precisely square-lattice coordinate symmetries. -/
def symmetry (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ε : Fin 2 → ℤ)
    (_hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) (x : Point) : Point :=
  fun i => ε i * x (σ i)

theorem symmetry_radius (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ε : Fin 2 → ℤ)
    (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) (x : Point) :
    radius (symmetry σ ε hε x) = radius x := by
  have hcoord (i : Fin 2) : |symmetry σ ε hε x i| = |x (σ i)| := by
    rcases hε i with hi | hi <;> simp [symmetry, hi]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (radius_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro i
    rw [hcoord]
    exact (radius_le_iff x _).mp le_rfl (σ i)
  · apply (radius_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro i
    have ht := (radius_le_iff (symmetry σ ε hε x) _).mp le_rfl (σ.symm i)
    simpa only [hcoord, σ.apply_symm_apply] using ht

theorem symmetry_linf (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ε : Fin 2 → ℤ)
    (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) (x y : Point) :
    linf (symmetry σ ε hε x) (symmetry σ ε hε y) = linf x y := by
  have he : symmetry σ ε hε x - symmetry σ ε hε y = symmetry σ ε hε (x - y) := by
    funext i; simp [symmetry, mul_sub]
  rw [linf, he, symmetry_radius σ ε hε]
  rfl

theorem symmetry_injective (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ε : Fin 2 → ℤ)
    (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) : Function.Injective (symmetry σ ε hε) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun h (σ.symm i)
  rcases hε (σ.symm i) with hs | hs <;> simpa [symmetry, hs] using hi

theorem symmetry_adj (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ε : Fin 2 → ℤ)
    (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) {x y : Point}
    (h : (lattice 2).Adj x y) : (lattice 2).Adj (symmetry σ ε hε x) (symmetry σ ε hε y) := by
  have pos {x y : Point} (i : Fin 2) (hy : y = x + unit i) :
      (lattice 2).Adj (symmetry σ ε hε x) (symmetry σ ε hε y) := by
    rcases hε (σ.symm i) with hs | hs
    · refine ⟨σ.symm i, Or.inl ?_⟩
      subst y
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = σ.symm i
      · subst j; simp [symmetry, unit, hs]
      · have hji : σ j ≠ i := fun hh => hj (σ.injective (by simpa using hh))
        simp [symmetry, unit, hj, hji]
    · refine ⟨σ.symm i, Or.inr ?_⟩
      subst y
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = σ.symm i
      · subst j; simp [symmetry, unit, hs]
      · have hji : σ j ≠ i := fun hh => hj (σ.injective (by simpa using hh))
        simp [symmetry, unit, hj, hji]
  rcases h with ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
  · exact pos i hi
  · exact (pos i hi).symm

theorem boundary_normalization (h : ℕ) (z : Point) (hz : radius z = 2 * h) :
    ∃ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ε : Fin 2 → ℤ) (b : ℤ),
      ∃ hε : (∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1), 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 2 * h ∧
        symmetry σ ε hε ![(2 * h : ℤ), b] = z := by
  let ε : Fin 2 → ℤ := fun i => if z i < 0 then -1 else 1
  have hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1 := by
    intro i; dsimp [ε]; split <;> simp
  have hsign (i : Fin 2) : ε i * |z i| = z i := by
    dsimp [ε]
    split
    · rename_i hi; rw [abs_of_neg hi]; ring
    · rename_i hi; rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hi), one_mul]
  have hb := (radius_le_iff z (2 * h)).mp hz.le
  rcases max_eq_iff.mp hz with ⟨hz0, _⟩ | ⟨hz1, _⟩
  · refine ⟨Equiv.refl _, ε, |z 1|, hε, abs_nonneg _, hb 1, ?_⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [symmetry, ← hz0] using hsign 0
    · simpa [symmetry] using hsign 1
  · refine ⟨Equiv.swap 0 1, ε, |z 0|, hε, abs_nonneg _, hb 0, ?_⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [symmetry] using hsign 0
    · simpa [symmetry, ← hz1] using hsign 1

/-- Every boundary point has a simple nearest-neighbor needle, with radial depth control. -/
theorem exists_radial_path (h : ℕ) (z : Point) (hz : radius z = 2 * h) :
    ∃ (L : ℕ) (p : Fin (L+1) → Point),
      Function.Injective p ∧ p ⟨0, by omega⟩ ∈ box 2 h ∧
      p ⟨L, by omega⟩ = z ∧
      (∀ t : Fin L, (lattice 2).Adj (p ⟨t.val, by omega⟩) (p ⟨t.val+1, by omega⟩)) ∧
      (∀ t, p t ∈ box 2 (2*h) ∧ linf z (p t) ≤ 2*h - radius (p t) + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨σ, ε, b, hε, hb0, hb, he⟩ := boundary_normalization h z hz
  let L := h + (b-h).toNat
  let rev (t : Fin (L+1)) : Fin (L+1) := ⟨L-t.val, by omega⟩
  let p (t : Fin (L+1)) : Point := symmetry σ ε hε (staircase h b hb0 hb (rev t))
  have hr : Function.Injective rev := by intro t s hs; apply Fin.ext; have := congrArg Fin.val hs; dsimp [rev] at this; omega
  refine ⟨L, p, (symmetry_injective σ ε hε).comp ((staircase_injective h b hb0 hb).comp hr), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_box_iff]
    change radius (symmetry σ ε hε (staircase h b hb0 hb ⟨L, by omega⟩)) ≤ h
    rw [symmetry_radius σ ε hε]
    exact (mem_box_iff _ _).mp (staircase_end_mem_box h b hb0 hb)
  · change symmetry σ ε hε (staircase h b hb0 hb ⟨L-L, by omega⟩) = z
    simpa only [Nat.sub_self, staircase_start] using he
  · intro t
    apply symmetry_adj σ ε hε
    have ht := staircase_adj h b hb0 hb (L-(t.val+1)) (by have := t.isLt; dsimp [L]; omega)
    convert ht.symm using 1
    · congr 1; apply Fin.ext; dsimp [rev]; omega
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨hc, hd⟩ := staircase_radial h b hb0 hb (rev t)
    constructor
    · rw [mem_box_iff]
      simpa only [p, symmetry_radius σ ε hε, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hc
    · rw [← he]
      simpa only [p, symmetry_radius σ ε hε, symmetry_linf σ ε hε] using hd


/-- Four sides of a square, restricted to a coordinate window. -/
noncomputable def sideWindow (R : ℤ) (z : Point) (r : ℕ) : Finset Point :=
  ((Finset.Icc (-(r : ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![R, z 1 + v])) ∪
  ((Finset.Icc (-(r : ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![-R, z 1 + v])) ∪
  ((Finset.Icc (-(r : ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![z 0 + v, R])) ∪
  ((Finset.Icc (-(r : ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![z 0 + v, -R]))

theorem mem_sideWindow {R : ℤ} {z x : Point} {r : ℕ}
    (hx : radius x = R) (hz : linf x z ≤ r) : x ∈ sideWindow R z r := by
  have h0 := (radius_le_iff (x-z) (r:ℤ)).mp hz 0
  have h1 := (radius_le_iff (x-z) (r:ℤ)).mp hz 1
  have hp0 : x 0-z 0 ∈ Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp h0)
  have hp1 : x 1-z 1 ∈ Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp h1)
  have ext0 : ![x 0, x 1] = x := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hside : x 0 = R ∨ x 0 = -R ∨ x 1 = R ∨ x 1 = -R := by
    dsimp [radius] at hx
    simp only [abs_eq_max_neg] at hx
    omega
  simp only [sideWindow, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
  rcases hside with hx0 | hx0 | hx1 | hx1
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨x 1-z 1, hp1, by simpa [hx0] using ext0⟩))
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨x 1-z 1, hp1, by simpa [hx0] using ext0⟩))
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨x 0-z 0, hp0, by simpa [hx1] using ext0⟩)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨x 0-z 0, hp0, by simpa [hx1] using ext0⟩

theorem card_sideWindow (R : ℤ) (z : Point) (r : ℕ) :
    (sideWindow R z r).card ≤ 4 * (2*r+1) := by
  have hc : (Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r).card = 2*r+1 := by
    rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  unfold sideWindow
  calc
    _ ≤ (((Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![R, z 1+v])).card +
      ((Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![-R, z 1+v])).card) +
      ((Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![z 0+v, R])).card +
      ((Finset.Icc (-(r:ℤ)) r).image (fun v => ![z 0+v, -R])).card :=
        (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right
          ((Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _)) _)
    _ ≤ (2*r+1) + (2*r+1) + (2*r+1) + (2*r+1) := by
      exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add
        ((Finset.card_image_le).trans hc.le) ((Finset.card_image_le).trans hc.le))
        ((Finset.card_image_le).trans hc.le)) ((Finset.card_image_le).trans hc.le)
    _ = _ := by omega

theorem card_circuit_window (S : Finset Point) (R : ℤ) (z : Point) (r : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, radius x = R ∧ linf x z ≤ r) :
    S.card ≤ 4*(2*r+1) :=
  (Finset.card_le_card (fun x hx => mem_sideWindow (hS x hx).1 (hS x hx).2)).trans
    (card_sideWindow R z r)


/-- A finite nonempty target has the literal lattice graph distance. -/
noncomputable def targetDistance (S : Finset Point) (hS : S.Nonempty) (x : Point) : ℕ :=
  S.inf' hS (fun p => (lattice 2).dist x p)

theorem targetDistance_le (S : Finset Point) (hS : S.Nonempty) (x p : Point)
    (hp : p ∈ S) : targetDistance S hS x ≤ (lattice 2).dist x p :=
  Finset.inf'_le _ hp

theorem targetDistance_attained (S : Finset Point) (hS : S.Nonempty) (x : Point) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, targetDistance S hS x = (lattice 2).dist x p :=
  Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' hS _

theorem targetDistance_zero_iff (S : Finset Point) (hS : S.Nonempty) (x : Point) :
    targetDistance S hS x = 0 ↔ x ∈ S := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := targetDistance_attained S hS x
    have hx : x = p := (LatticeProb.Graph.Zd.latticeConnected 2).dist_eq_zero_iff.mp (he.symm.trans hz)
    simpa only [hx] using hp
  · intro hx
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (by simpa using targetDistance_le S hS x x hx)

theorem targetDistance_neighbor (S : Finset Point) (hS : S.Nonempty) {x y : Point}
    (hxy : (lattice 2).Adj x y) :
    targetDistance S hS x ≤ targetDistance S hS y + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := targetDistance_attained S hS y
  have ht := (LatticeProb.Graph.Zd.latticeConnected 2).dist_triangle (u:=x) (v:=y) (w:=p)
  rw [SimpleGraph.dist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr hxy, ← he] at ht
  exact (targetDistance_le S hS x p hp).trans (by omega)

theorem radius_sub_neighbor {x y : Point} (hxy : (lattice 2).Adj x y) :
    radius (x-y) = 1 := by
  rcases hxy with ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ <;> rw [hi]
  · have he : x - (x+unit i) = -unit i := by abel
    rw [he]
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [radius, unit, Pi.single_apply]
  · have he : y + unit i - y = unit i := by abel
    rw [he]
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [radius, unit, Pi.single_apply]

theorem linf_le_walk_length {x y : Point} (p : (lattice 2).Walk x y) :
    linf x y ≤ p.length := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [linf, radius]
  | @cons x y z hxy q ih =>
    have ht : radius (x-z) ≤ radius (x-y) + radius (y-z) := by
      have := radius_sub_le (x-y) (z-y)
      simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, radius, Pi.sub_apply, abs_sub_comm] using this
    rw [radius_sub_neighbor hxy] at ht
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    dsimp [linf] at ih ⊢
    omega

theorem linf_le_dist (x y : Point) : linf x y ≤ (lattice 2).dist x y := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (LatticeProb.Graph.Zd.latticeConnected 2).exists_walk_length_eq_dist x y
  simpa only [hp] using linf_le_walk_length p

theorem radius_le_dist_add (x y : Point) : radius x ≤ (lattice 2).dist x y + radius y :=
  (radius_le_radius_add x y).trans (by have hh := linf_le_dist x y; dsimp [linf] at hh; omega)

/-- Positive distance to the exterior at an active vertex. -/
def depth (N : ℕ) (x : FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.Active N) : ℕ :=
  N+1 - (radius (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x)).toNat

theorem depth_cast (N : ℕ) (x : FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.Active N) :
    (depth N x : ℤ) = N+1-radius (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x) := by
  have hr : radius (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x) ≤ N := by
    apply (radius_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro i; exact abs_le.mpr (x i).property
  have hn := radius_nonneg (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x)
  unfold depth
  omega

theorem depth_pos (N : ℕ) (x : FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.Active N) :
    0 < depth N x := by
  have hc := depth_cast N x
  have hr : radius (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x) ≤ N := by
    apply (radius_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro i; exact abs_le.mpr (x i).property
  omega

theorem depth_le (N : ℕ) (x : FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.Active N) :
    depth N x ≤ N+1 := by
  have hc := depth_cast N x
  have hn := radius_nonneg (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x)
  omega

theorem depth_neighbor (N : ℕ) (x y : FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.Active N)
    (hxy : (lattice 2).Adj (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x)
      (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site y)) : depth N x ≤ depth N y + 1 := by
  have hx := depth_cast N x
  have hy := depth_cast N y
  have hr := radius_le_radius_add (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site y)
    (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.site x)
  rw [radius_sub_neighbor hxy.symm] at hr
  omega


open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

noncomputable def boxPoints (h : ℕ) : Finset Point := Finset.univ.image (@site h)

theorem mem_boxPoints (h : ℕ) (x : Point) : x ∈ boxPoints h ↔ x ∈ box 2 h := by
  simp only [boxPoints, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (inBox_iff h _).mp (fun i => (y i).property)
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨activeOfSite h x ((inBox_iff h x).mpr hx), rfl⟩

/-- The literal union of the central square and all vertices of the path. -/
noncomputable def target (h L : ℕ) (p : Fin (L+1) → Point) : Finset Point :=
  boxPoints h ∪ Finset.univ.image p

theorem target_nonempty (h L : ℕ) (p : Fin (L+1) → Point) : (target h L p).Nonempty := by
  refine ⟨p ⟨0, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_⟩
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)

theorem linf_comm (x y : Point) : linf x y = linf y x := by
  simp only [linf, radius, Pi.sub_apply, abs_sub_comm]

theorem linf_triangle (x y z : Point) : linf x z ≤ linf x y + linf y z := by
  have h := radius_sub_le (x-y) (z-y)
  simpa only [linf, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, radius, Pi.sub_apply, abs_sub_comm] using h

/-- Small-depth points close to the needle are in a small boundary window. -/
theorem near_target_window (h L s : ℕ) (p : Fin (L+1) → Point) (z x : Point)
    (hs : 2*s+1 < h) (hx : radius x = 2*h+1-s)
    (hn : targetDistance (target h L p) (target_nonempty h L p) x ≤ s+2)
    (hp : ∀ t, linf z (p t) ≤ 2*h-radius (p t)+1) :
    linf x z ≤ 3*s+4 := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hd⟩ := targetDistance_attained (target h L p) (target_nonempty h L p) x
  have hdist : (lattice 2).dist x q ≤ s+2 := by omega
  have hr := radius_le_dist_add x q
  have hclose := linf_le_dist x q
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hq with hb | hpath
  · have hqbox : radius q ≤ h := (mem_box_iff q h).mp ((mem_boxPoints h q).mp hb)
    omega
  · obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpath
    have hrad := hp t
    have htri := linf_triangle x (p t) z
    rw [linf_comm (p t) z] at htri
    omega

/-- Active vertices of one depth whose graph distance to the target is at most `s+2`. -/
noncomputable def nearLayer (h L s : ℕ) (p : Fin (L+1) → Point) : Finset (Active (2*h)) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => depth (2*h) x = s ∧
    targetDistance (target h L p) (target_nonempty h L p) (site x) ≤ s+2)

theorem card_nearLayer (h L s : ℕ) (p : Fin (L+1) → Point) (z : Point)
    (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hsh : s ≤ 2*h+1)
    (hp : ∀ t, linf z (p t) ≤ 2*h-radius (p t)+1) :
    (nearLayer h L s p).card ≤ 60*s := by
  let S := (nearLayer h L s p).image site
  have hc : S.card = (nearLayer h L s p).card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (site_injective _)
  have hrad (x : Point) (hx : x ∈ S) : radius x = 2*h+1-s := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    have hd := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2.1
    have he := depth_cast (2*h) y
    push_cast at he
    omega
  by_cases hsmall : h ≤ 2*s+1
  · have hrnonneg : 0 ≤ (2*h+1-s : ℤ) := by omega
    have hrnat : ((2*h+1-s : ℤ).toNat : ℤ) = 2*h+1-s := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hrnonneg
    have hwindow : ∀ x ∈ S, radius x = (2*h+1-s : ℤ) ∧
        linf x 0 ≤ (2*h+1-s : ℤ).toNat := by
      intro x hx
      refine ⟨hrad x hx, ?_⟩
      simpa only [linf, sub_zero, hrad x hx, hrnat] using (le_refl (2*h+1-s : ℤ))
    have hb := card_circuit_window S (2*h+1-s : ℤ) 0 (2*h+1-s : ℤ).toNat hwindow
    rw [hc] at hb
    omega
  · have hwindow : ∀ x ∈ S, radius x = (2*h+1-s : ℤ) ∧ linf x z ≤ 3*s+4 := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      have hyn := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2.2
      have hyr := hrad (site y) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hy)
      exact ⟨hyr, near_target_window h L s p z (site y) (by omega) hyr hyn hp⟩
    have hb := card_circuit_window S (2*h+1-s : ℤ) z (3*s+4) (by
      intro x hx; obtain ⟨hr, hw⟩ := hwindow x hx
      exact ⟨hr, by exact_mod_cast hw⟩)
    rw [hc] at hb
    omega


end FiniteAvalanches.Needle

import FiniteAvalanches.Needle.Geometry

open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Needle
open LatticeProb
open scoped BigOperators Classical

/-- The full original-copy wired lattice has a path from every vertex to its sink. -/
theorem wired_support_reaches_sink (N : ℕ) (v : Vertex N) :
    (FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.supportGraph (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1)
      (fun e => (endpoints e).2)).Reachable v none := by
  have he : FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.supportGraph (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1)
      (fun e => (endpoints e).2) = (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees.graph N).toSimple Finset.univ := by
    apply SimpleGraph.ext
    funext x y
    apply propext
    change (x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e : Edge N,
      ((endpoints e).1 = x ∧ (endpoints e).2 = y) ∨
      ((endpoints e).2 = x ∧ (endpoints e).1 = y)) ↔
      (∃ e : Edge N, e ∈ Finset.univ ∧
      (((endpoints e).1 = x ∧ (endpoints e).2 = y) ∨
      ((endpoints e).2 = x ∧ (endpoints e).1 = y)))
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, e, he⟩; exact ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ _, he⟩
    · rintro ⟨e, _, he⟩
      refine ⟨?_, e, he⟩
      intro hxy
      apply endpoints_ne e
      rcases he with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨hb, ha⟩
      · exact ha.trans (hxy.trans hb.symm)
      · exact ha.trans (hxy.symm.trans hb.symm)
  rw [he, FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph.toSimple_reachable]
  cases v with
  | none => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | some x =>
    apply FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph.reaches_mono _ (Finset.subset_univ _)
    exact FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.WiredTrees.row_reaches_sink x

/-- The prescribed zero terminal and the original wired exterior terminal. -/
noncomputable def terminals (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) : Finset (Vertex N) :=
  insert none (S.image some)

theorem terminals_reachable (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) :
    ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminals N S,
      (FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.supportGraph (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1)
        (fun e => (endpoints e).2)).Reachable x y := by
  intro x
  exact ⟨none, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, wired_support_reaches_sink N x⟩

/-- Unit voltage, characterized by proved existence and uniqueness of the Dirichlet problem. -/
noncomputable def voltage (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) : Vertex N → ℝ :=
  FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.harmonicExtension
    (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2)
    (terminals N S) (terminals_reachable N S) (fun v => if v = none then 1 else 0)

theorem voltage_spec (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) :
    voltage N S none = 1 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ S, voltage N S (some x) = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ terminals N S → FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.laplacian
        (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2) (voltage N S) x = 0) := by
  have hs := FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.harmonicExtension_spec
    (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2)
    (terminals N S) (terminals_reachable N S) (fun v => if v = none then 1 else 0)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hs.2⟩
  · simpa [voltage] using hs.1 none (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  · intro x hx
    simpa [voltage] using hs.1 (some x) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx))

theorem voltage_unique (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (f : Vertex N → ℝ)
    (hf0 : f none = 1) (hfS : ∀ x ∈ S, f (some x) = 0)
    (hfH : ∀ v, v ∉ terminals N S → FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.laplacian
      (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2) f v = 0) :
    f = voltage N S := by
  apply FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.harmonicExtension_eq
  refine ⟨?_, hfH⟩
  intro v hv
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hv
  · simpa using hf0
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    simpa using hfS x hx

/-- Effective conductance between `S` and the complement, with every original copy once. -/
noncomputable def wiredConductance (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) : ℝ :=
  FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.energy (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1)
    (fun e => (endpoints e).2) (voltage N S)

theorem wiredConductance_le_trial (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (f : Vertex N → ℝ)
    (hf0 : f none = 1) (hfS : ∀ x ∈ S, f (some x) = 0) :
    wiredConductance N S ≤ FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.energy
      (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2) f := by
  apply FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.energy_harmonicExtension_le
  intro v hv
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hv
  · simpa using hf0
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    simpa using hfS x hx

/-- The same quantity is the original-copy unit-voltage current from the exterior terminal. -/
theorem wiredConductance_eq_flux (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) :
    wiredConductance N S = FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.laplacian
      (fun e : Edge N => (endpoints e).1) (fun e => (endpoints e).2) (voltage N S) none := by
  obtain ⟨h0, hS, hH⟩ := voltage_spec N S
  rw [wiredConductance, FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.energy_eq_incidence_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single none]
  · rw [h0, one_mul]
  · intro v _ hv
    cases v with
    | none => exact (hv rfl).elim
    | some x =>
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S
      · rw [hS x hx, zero_mul]
      · have hvB : some x ∉ terminals N S := by simp [terminals, hx]
        rw [hH (some x) hvB, mul_zero]
  · simp

/-- A finite ordered family of vertices in the source outer box. -/
abbrev InBoxVertices (h L : ℕ) :=
  {p : Fin (L+1) → Point // ∀ t, p t ∈ box 2 (2*h)}

/-- The complete box/path union on the canonical active carrier. -/
noncomputable def zeroVertices (h L : ℕ) (p : InBoxVertices h L) : Finset (Active (2*h)) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => site x ∈ target h L p.val)

theorem zeroVertices_image (h L : ℕ) (p : InBoxVertices h L) :
    (zeroVertices h L p).image site = target h L p.val := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  · intro hx
    have hxB : x ∈ box 2 (2*h) := by
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hb | hpath
      · have hb := (mem_boxPoints h x).mp hb
        intro i; have hi := hb i; omega
      · obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpath
        exact p.property t
    let y := activeOfSite (2*h) x ((inBox_iff _ _).mpr hxB)
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hx⟩, rfl⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Needle

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Network
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Basic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Connectivity.Connected
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Finite Dirichlet problems with individually indexed unit-conductance edges. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_nonneg (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ energy a b f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_eq_zero_iff (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b f = 0 ↔ ∀ e, f (a e) = f (b e) := by
  rw [energy, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_const, sq_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_add (a b : E → V) (f g : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (f + g) x = laplacian a b f x + laplacian a b g x := by
  simp only [laplacian, Pi.add_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_smul (a b : E → V) (r : ℝ) (f : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (r • f) x = r * laplacian a b f x := by
  simp only [laplacian, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_sub (a b : E → V) (f g : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (f - g) x = laplacian a b f x - laplacian a b g x := by
  simp only [laplacian, Pi.sub_apply, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem eq_of_reachable (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ e, f (a e) = f (b e)) {x y : V}
    (hxy : (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) : f x = f y := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h p ih =>
    obtain ⟨_, e, he⟩ := h
    rcases he with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact (hf e).trans ih
    · exact (hf e).symm.trans ih

/-- A zero-boundary harmonic function vanishes when each component meets the boundary. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_harmonic (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (f : V → ℝ) (hfB : ∀ x ∈ B, f x = 0)
    (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0) : f = 0 := by
  have he : energy a b f = 0 := by
    rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · rw [hfB x hx, zero_mul]
    · rw [hf x hx, mul_zero]
  have hedge := (energy_eq_zero_iff a b f).mp he
  funext x
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hB x
  exact (eq_of_reachable a b f hedge hxy).trans (hfB y hy)

/-- Extend free-vertex data by zero at boundary vertices. -/
noncomputable def zeroExtend (B : Finset V) (u : {x // x ∉ B} → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ :=
  if hx : x ∈ B then 0 else u ⟨x, hx⟩

/-- The positive Dirichlet Laplacian on free vertices. -/
noncomputable def dirichletMap (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V) :
    ({x // x ∉ B} → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({x // x ∉ B} → ℝ) where
  toFun u x := laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x
  map_add' u w := by
    have h : zeroExtend B (u + w) = zeroExtend B u + zeroExtend B w := by
      funext x; simp only [zeroExtend, Pi.add_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
    funext x; rw [h, laplacian_add]; rfl
  map_smul' r u := by
    have h : zeroExtend B (r • u) = r • zeroExtend B u := by
      funext x; simp only [zeroExtend, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    funext x; rw [h, laplacian_smul]; rfl

theorem dirichletMap_injective (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) :
    Function.Injective (dirichletMap a b B) := by
  intro u w huw
  have hf : zeroExtend B u - zeroExtend B w = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, zeroExtend, dif_pos hx, sub_self]
    · intro x hx
      rw [laplacian_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (congrFun huw ⟨x, hx⟩)
  funext x
  have hx := congrFun hf x.val
  simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, zeroExtend, dif_neg x.property, Pi.zero_apply,
    sub_eq_zero] using hx

/-- Existence and uniqueness are proved before any harmonic extension is selected. -/
theorem existsUnique_harmonic_extension (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : V → ℝ) :
    ∃! f : V → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ B, f x = t x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0) := by
  let v : V → ℝ := fun x => if x ∈ B then t x else 0
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective
    (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB) (fun x => -laplacian a b v x)
  refine ⟨v + zeroExtend B u, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, v, if_pos hx, zeroExtend, dif_pos hx, add_zero]
  · intro x hx
    rw [laplacian_add]
    have hux := congrFun hu ⟨x, hx⟩
    change laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = -laplacian a b v x at hux
    rw [hux, add_neg_cancel]
  · intro f hf
    have hz : f - (v + zeroExtend B u) = 0 := by
      apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, hf.1 x hx, Pi.add_apply, v, if_pos hx,
          zeroExtend, dif_pos hx, add_zero, sub_self]
      · intro x hx
        rw [laplacian_sub, hf.2 x hx, laplacian_add]
        have hux := congrFun hu ⟨x, hx⟩
        change laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = -laplacian a b v x at hux
        rw [hux, add_neg_cancel, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- The harmonic extension of specified boundary values. -/
noncomputable def harmonicExtension (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (existsUnique_harmonic_extension a b B hB t).choose

theorem harmonicExtension_spec (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : V → ℝ) :
    (∀ x ∈ B, harmonicExtension a b B hB t x = t x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b (harmonicExtension a b B hB t) x = 0) :=
  (existsUnique_harmonic_extension a b B hB t).choose_spec.1

theorem harmonicExtension_eq (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : (∀ x ∈ B, f x = t x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0)) :
    f = harmonicExtension a b B hB t :=
  (existsUnique_harmonic_extension a b B hB t).choose_spec.2 f hf

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_const (a b : E → V) (r : ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (fun _ => r) x = 0 := by
  simp only [laplacian, sub_self, ite_self, add_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Exact quadratic expansion; its cross term is a finite incidence sum. -/
theorem energy_sub_expansion (a b : E → V) (f h : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b f = energy a b h + energy a b (f - h) +
      2 * ∑ x, (f x - h x) * laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [incidence_sum a b h (fun x => f x - h x)]
  unfold energy
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; ring

/-- Dirichlet minimization with the complete nonnegative error retained. -/
theorem energy_eq_add_energy_sub_of_harmonic (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (f h : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ B, f x = h x)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b f = energy a b h + energy a b (f - h) := by
  rw [energy_sub_expansion]
  have hz : (∑ x, (f x - h x) * laplacian a b h x) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · rw [hf x hx, sub_self, zero_mul]
    · rw [hh x hx, mul_zero]
  rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero]

theorem energy_harmonicExtension_le (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (t f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ B, f x = t x) :
    energy a b (harmonicExtension a b B hB t) ≤ energy a b f := by
  have hs := harmonicExtension_spec a b B hB t
  rw [energy_eq_add_energy_sub_of_harmonic a b B f _
    (fun x hx => (hf x hx).trans (hs.1 x hx).symm) hs.2]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (energy_nonneg a b _)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Sigma
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Piecewise
public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
public import Mathlib.Tactic.SplitIfs

@[expose] public section

/-! Finite energy and incidence identities for individually indexed edge copies. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Once-counted unit-conductance energy, retaining every edge copy. -/
noncomputable def energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, (f (a e) - f (b e)) ^ 2

/-- The edge energy weighted by the product of the endpoint values of `h`. -/
noncomputable def weightedEnergy (a b : E → V) (h g : V → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, h (a e) * h (b e) * (g (a e) - g (b e)) ^ 2

/-- Positive Laplacian as a literal incidence sum; both incidences of a loop vanish. -/
noncomputable def laplacian (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ e, ((if a e = x then h x - h (b e) else 0) +
    (if b e = x then h x - h (a e) else 0))

theorem edge_ground_identity (hx hy gx gy : ℝ) :
    (hx * gx - hy * gy) ^ 2 = hx * hy * (gx - gy) ^ 2 +
      (hx - hy) * (hx * gx ^ 2 - hy * gy ^ 2) := by
  ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_ground_edge_sum (a b : E → V) (h g : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => h x * g x) = weightedEnergy a b h g +
      ∑ e, (h (a e) - h (b e)) *
        (h (a e) * g (a e) ^ 2 - h (b e) * g (b e) ^ 2) := by
  unfold energy weightedEnergy
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ =>
    edge_ground_identity (h (a e)) (h (b e)) (g (a e)) (g (b e))

theorem incidence_sum (a b : E → V) (h w : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, w x * laplacian a b h x) =
      ∑ e, (h (a e) - h (b e)) * (w (a e) - w (b e)) := by
  classical
  simp only [laplacian, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  ring

theorem ground_identity (a b : E → V) (h g : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => h x * g x) = weightedEnergy a b h g +
      ∑ x, h x * g x ^ 2 * laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [incidence_sum a b h (fun x => h x * g x ^ 2)]
  exact energy_ground_edge_sum a b h g

theorem energy_eq_incidence_sum (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b h = ∑ x, h x * laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [incidence_sum a b h h]
  unfold energy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

/-- Unit boundary values turn energy into the sum of the two boundary fluxes. -/
theorem energy_eq_two_terminal_flux (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hh0 : h a0 = 1) (hh1 : h a1 = 1) (hhb : h beta = 0)
    (hharm : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b h = laplacian a b h a0 + laplacian a b h a1 := by
  classical
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
  have hpoint (x : V) : h x * laplacian a b h x =
      (if x = a0 then laplacian a b h a0 else 0) +
      (if x = a1 then laplacian a b h a1 else 0) := by
    by_cases hx0 : x = a0
    · subst x
      simp only [hh0, one_mul, ite_true, if_neg ha, add_zero]
    by_cases hx1 : x = a1
    · subst x
      simp only [hh1, one_mul, if_neg hx0, ite_true, zero_add]
    by_cases hxb : x = beta
    · subst x
      simp only [hhb, zero_mul, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
    · simp only [hharm x hx0 hx1 hxb, mul_zero, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hpoint x), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_add_const (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => c + f x) = energy a b f := by
  unfold energy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_one_sub (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => 1 - f x) = energy a b f := by
  unfold energy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

omit [Fintype V] in
/-- Transport vertices while retaining the same edge-copy index. -/
theorem energy_pullback {W : Type*} (q : W → V) (a b : E → W) (f : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => f (q x)) = energy (fun e => q (a e)) (fun e => q (b e)) f := by
  rfl

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem weightedEnergy_sub_const (a b : E → V) (h f : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    weightedEnergy a b h (fun x => f x - c) = weightedEnergy a b h f := by
  unfold weightedEnergy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

open scoped Classical in
/-- Counting the two endpoint incidences gives exactly twice the once-counted energy. -/
theorem ordered_incidence_energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x then (f x - f (b e)) ^ 2 else 0) +
       (if b e = x then (f x - f (a e)) ^ 2 else 0))) = 2 * energy a b f := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ e, 2 * (f (a e) - f (b e)) ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      ring
    _ = 2 * energy a b f := by rw [energy, Finset.mul_sum]

/-- Energy of the ground-state trial function for explicit three-terminal Dirichlet data. -/
theorem ground_trial_energy (a b : E → V) (h f : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hh0 : h a0 = 1) (hh1 : h a1 = 1) (hhb : h beta = 0)
    (hf0 : f a0 = 0) (hf1 : f a1 = 1)
    (hharm : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) + h x * (f x - 1 / 2)) =
      (laplacian a b h a0 + laplacian a b h a1) / 4 +
        weightedEnergy a b h f := by
  classical
  rw [energy_add_const, ground_identity, weightedEnergy_sub_const]
  have hpoint (x : V) : h x * (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 * laplacian a b h x =
      (if x = a0 then laplacian a b h a0 / 4 else 0) +
      (if x = a1 then laplacian a b h a1 / 4 else 0) := by
    by_cases hx0 : x = a0
    · subst x
      simp only [hh0, hf0, ite_true, if_neg ha]
      ring
    by_cases hx1 : x = a1
    · subst x
      simp only [hh1, hf1, if_neg hx0, ite_true]
      ring
    by_cases hxb : x = beta
    · subst x
      simp only [hhb, zero_mul, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
    · simp only [hharm x hx0 hx1 hxb, mul_zero, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hpoint x), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  ring

/-- Background-energy form of the trial identity, without any response coefficients. -/
theorem ground_trial_energy_eq_background (a b : E → V) (h f : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hh0 : h a0 = 1) (hh1 : h a1 = 1) (hhb : h beta = 0)
    (hf0 : f a0 = 0) (hf1 : f a1 = 1)
    (hharm : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) + h x * (f x - 1 / 2)) =
      energy a b h / 4 + weightedEnergy a b h f := by
  rw [ground_trial_energy a b h f a0 a1 beta ha hh0 hh1 hhb hf0 hf1 hharm,
    energy_eq_two_terminal_flux a b h a0 a1 beta ha hh0 hh1 hhb hharm]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_one_sub (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (fun y => 1 - phi y) x = -laplacian a b phi x := by
  classical
  unfold laplacian
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- Trial-energy identity in voltage coordinates for explicit Dirichlet data. -/
theorem ground_trial_energy_of_voltage (a b : E → V) (phi f : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hp0 : phi a0 = 0) (hp1 : phi a1 = 0) (hpb : phi beta = 1)
    (hf0 : f a0 = 0) (hf1 : f a1 = 1)
    (hph : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b phi x = 0) :
    energy a b (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (1 - phi x) * (f x - 1 / 2)) =
      energy a b phi / 4 + weightedEnergy a b (fun x => 1 - phi x) f := by
  have hh0 : 1 - phi a0 = 1 := by rw [hp0, sub_zero]
  have hh1 : 1 - phi a1 = 1 := by rw [hp1, sub_zero]
  have hhb : 1 - phi beta = 0 := by rw [hpb, sub_self]
  have hharm (x : V) (hx0 : x ≠ a0) (hx1 : x ≠ a1) (hxb : x ≠ beta) :
      laplacian a b (fun y => 1 - phi y) x = 0 := by
    rw [laplacian_one_sub, hph x hx0 hx1 hxb, neg_zero]
  rw [ground_trial_energy_eq_background a b (fun x => 1 - phi x) f
    a0 a1 beta ha hh0 hh1 hhb hf0 hf1 hharm, energy_one_sub]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.JoiningCounts
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.SumMeasure

@[expose] public section

/-! Actual uniform finite measures on copied-edge tree subsets. -/
open scoped Classical ENNReal
open MeasureTheory
namespace FiniteAvalanches

noncomputable def uniformMeasure (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : Measure α :=
  (Nat.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

instance uniformMeasure_probability (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformMeasure α) := by
  constructor
  simp only [uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]
  simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem uniformMeasure_apply (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (A : Set α) :
    uniformMeasure α A = (Nat.card A : ℝ≥0∞) / Nat.card α := by
  rw [uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Measure.count_apply A.toFinite.measurableSet, Set.encard, ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

theorem uniformMeasure_real_apply (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (A : Set α) :
    (uniformMeasure α).real A = (Nat.card A : ℝ) / Nat.card α := by
  simp [Measure.real, uniformMeasure_apply, ENNReal.toReal_div]

theorem integral_uniformMeasure (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂uniformMeasure α) = (∑ x, f x) / Nat.card α := by
  simp only [uniformMeasure, integral_smul_measure, integral_count, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    ENNReal.toReal_natCast, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

namespace Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

instance componentTreeMeasurableSpace (C : Set V) : MeasurableSpace (G.ComponentTree C) := ⊤
instance componentTreeMeasurableSingletonClass (C : Set V) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (G.ComponentTree C) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Uniform probability on actual ordinary spanning-tree edge subsets. -/
noncomputable def treeLaw [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] : Measure G.SpanningTree :=
  uniformMeasure G.SpanningTree

instance treeLaw_probability [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] : IsProbabilityMeasure G.treeLaw :=
  uniformMeasure_probability _

theorem treeLaw_real_eq_counting [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] (A : Set G.SpanningTree) :
    G.treeLaw.real A = G.uniformTreeProbability A :=
  uniformMeasure_real_apply _ A

/-- The exact joining formula is an event probability of a real finite measure. -/
theorem treeLaw_real_ancestorPastTree [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] {C S : Set V}
    (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    G.treeLaw.real {u | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
      G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G.SpanningTree *
        (∑ v ∈ (G.componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card) := by
  rw [G.treeLaw_real_eq_counting]
  exact G.probability_ancestorPastTree_eq_sum r hr hS t hSC

end Trees.Multigraph
end FiniteAvalanches

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.ColoredForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.Paths
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw
import Mathlib.Probability.ProductMeasure

/-! Literal simple random walk drivers and ordered hitting events. Independent
uniform choices of the four actual lattice directions, including hitting at time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

abbrev WalkDriver := ℕ → FiniteWired.Direction

def directionLaw : Measure FiniteWired.Direction :=
  FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction

instance directionLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure directionLaw :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction))

def walkLaw : Measure WalkDriver := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => directionLaw)
instance walkLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure walkLaw := by
  unfold walkLaw
  infer_instance

def position (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : ℕ → Site 2
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n)

@[simp] theorem position_zero (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : position x d 0 = x := rfl
@[simp] theorem position_succ (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n) := rfl

theorem position_adjacent (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    (lattice 2).Adj (position x d n) (position x d (n + 1)) := by
  change ∃ i, position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + unit i ∨
    position x d n = position x d (n + 1) + unit i
  refine ⟨(d n).1, ?_⟩
  cases h : (d n).2
  · right
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp
  · left
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp

def driverWalk (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : InfiniteWalk :=
  ⟨position x d, position_adjacent x d⟩

/-- tau_C < tau_A: some C visit precedes every A visit, including time zero. -/
def hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) : Set WalkDriver :=
  {d | ∃ n, position x d n ∈ C ∧ ∀ m ≤ n, position x d m ∉ A}

theorem measurable_position (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun d => position x d n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ih.add ((measurable_of_countable FiniteWired.step).comp (measurable_pi_apply n))

theorem measurableSet_hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    MeasurableSet (hitBefore A C x) := by
  have hC (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∈ C} :=
    (measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable C).measurableSet
  have hA (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∉ A} :=
    ((measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable A).measurableSet).compl
  simp only [hitBefore, Set.setOf_exists, Set.setOf_and, Set.setOf_forall]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n => (hC n).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter (fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ => hA m))))

theorem hitBefore_of_one_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.one) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = Set.univ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  refine ⟨0, hx, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  have he : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm
  subst m
  exact fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint h hx

theorem hitBefore_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.zero) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = ∅ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  rintro ⟨n, _, hn⟩
  exact hn 0 (Nat.zero_le n) hx

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.SimpleWalk

/-! Literal first hitting times with top for a genuinely infinite avoiding path.
Their comparison agrees with the ordered source event, including time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def firstHit (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) : WithTop ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U then (Nat.find h : WithTop ℕ) else ⊤

theorem firstHit_eq_top_iff (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) :
    firstHit U p = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n, p n ∉ U := by
  by_cases h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U
  · simp [firstHit, h]
  · have hn : ∀ n, p n ∉ U := fun n hm => h ⟨n, hm⟩
    simp only [firstHit, dif_neg h, eq_self, true_iff]
    exact hn

theorem firstHit_eq_zero_iff (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) :
    firstHit U p = 0 ↔ p 0 ∈ U := by
  by_cases h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U
  · rw [firstHit, dif_pos h]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.find_eq_zero h)
  · simp only [firstHit, dif_neg h, WithTop.top_ne_zero, false_iff]
    exact fun hp => h ⟨0, hp⟩

theorem hitBefore_iff_firstHit_lt (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) :
    d ∈ hitBefore A C x ↔ firstHit C (position x d) < firstHit A (position x d) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    have hC : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ C := ⟨n, hnC⟩
    by_cases hA : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ A
    · have hna : n < Nat.find hA := by
        by_contra h
        exact hnA (Nat.find hA) (Nat.le_of_not_gt h) (Nat.find_spec hA)
      have hl := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.find_min' hC hnC) hna
      simp only [firstHit, dif_pos hC, dif_pos hA]
      exact_mod_cast hl
    · simp [firstHit, hC, hA]
  · intro h
    have hC : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ C := by
      by_contra hC
      simp only [firstHit, dif_neg hC, not_top_lt] at h
    refine ⟨Nat.find hC, Nat.find_spec hC, ?_⟩
    intro m hm hmA
    have hA : ∃ n, position x d n ∈ A := ⟨m, hmA⟩
    have hl : Nat.find hC < Nat.find hA := by
      simp only [firstHit, dif_pos hC, dif_pos hA] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    have ha := Nat.find_min' hA hmA
    omega

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Topology
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw

/-! Literal two-color rooted lattice forests. All vertices and all unordered
nearest-neighbor edges are retained. No probability law is selected. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The source's two disjoint nonempty sets, retaining every root separately. -/
structure RootPair where
  zero : Set (Site 2)
  one : Set (Site 2)
  disjoint : Disjoint zero one
  zero_nonempty : zero.Nonempty
  one_nonempty : one.Nonempty

abbrev ColorField := Site 2 → Bool
abbrev ForestField := EdgeField × ColorField

/-- Acyclic on all sites, with exactly one original root in each component. -/
def is_rooted_forest (R : RootPair) (f : EdgeField) : Prop :=
  (toGraph f).IsAcyclic ∧ ∀ x, ∃ r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one,
    (toGraph f).Reachable x r ∧
      ∀ r' ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one, (toGraph f).Reachable x r' → r' = r

abbrev RootedForest (R : RootPair) := {f : EdgeField // is_rooted_forest R f}

def oneVertices (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : Set (Site 2) :=
  {x | ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r}

theorem reachable_roots_eq (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R)
    {x r s : Site 2} (hr : r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one) (hs : s ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one)
    (hxr : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r) (hxs : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x s) : r = s := by
  obtain ⟨u, _, _, hu⟩ := f.property.2 x
  exact (hu r hr hxr).trans (hu s hs hxs).symm

/-- Component root colors, defined by literal reachability, without choosing a root. -/
def colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : ColorField :=
  fun x => decide (x ∈ oneVertices R f)

theorem colors_eq_true_iff (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (x : Site 2) :
    colors R f x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r := by
  simp only [colors, decide_eq_true_eq, oneVertices, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

theorem colors_of_one_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.one) : colors R f x = true :=
  (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mpr ⟨x, hx, .refl x⟩

theorem colors_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.zero) : colors R f x = false := by
  have hn : ¬colors R f x = true := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mp h
    have he := reachable_roots_eq R f (Or.inl hx) (Or.inr hr) (.refl x) hxr
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint hx (he.symm ▸ hr)
  cases h : colors R f x <;> simp_all

/-- Raw full product carrier; valid fields have precisely the original component colors. -/
def is_colored_forest (R : RootPair) (ω : ForestField) : Prop :=
  is_rooted_forest R ω.1 ∧ ∀ x,
    ω.2 x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph ω.1).Reachable x r

theorem colored_iff_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (σ : ColorField) :
    is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) ↔ σ = colors R f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext x
    have he := (h.2 x).trans (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).symm
    cases hσ : σ x <;> cases hf : colors R f x <;> simp_all
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨f.property, colors_eq_true_iff R f⟩

theorem existsUnique_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) :
    ∃! σ : ColorField, is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) :=
  ⟨colors R f, (colored_iff_colors R f _).mpr rfl,
    fun σ hσ => (colored_iff_colors R f σ).mp hσ⟩

def colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) : Set ColorField :=
  {σ | F.restrict σ = p}

theorem isClopen_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    IsClopen (colorCylinder F p) :=
  (isClopen_discrete {p}).preimage (continuous_pi (fun x => continuous_apply x.val))

theorem measurableSet_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (colorCylinder F p) := (isClopen_colorCylinder F p).isClosed.measurableSet

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space

/-! Literal finite walks (including zero edges) and genuinely infinite walks/rays.
No finite list represents an infinite path or a failed stopping time. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb

structure FiniteWalk where
  length : ℕ
  vertex : Fin (length + 1) → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ i : Fin length, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex i.castSucc) (vertex i.succ)

structure InfiniteWalk where
  vertex : ℕ → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ n, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex n) (vertex (n + 1))

structure SimpleRay extends InfiniteWalk where
  injective : Function.Injective vertex

def FiniteWalk.start (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex 0
def FiniteWalk.finish (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex ⟨p.length, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
def FiniteWalk.vertices (p : FiniteWalk) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range p.vertex

def zeroWalk (x : Site 2) : FiniteWalk :=
  ⟨0, fun _ => x, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩

theorem zeroWalk_length (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).length = 0 := rfl
theorem zeroWalk_vertices (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).vertices = {x} := by
  ext y
  simp [FiniteWalk.vertices, zeroWalk]

/-- A stopped trace retains its complete finite word, or its genuinely infinite word. -/
inductive StoppedTrace (B : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) where
  | hit (walk : FiniteWalk) (start : walk.start = x) (finish : walk.finish ∈ B)
      (first : ∀ i : Fin walk.length, walk.vertex i.castSucc ∉ B)
  | escape (walk : InfiniteWalk) (start : walk.vertex 0 = x)
      (avoids : ∀ n, walk.vertex n ∉ B)

def SimpleRay.vertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range γ.vertex
def SimpleRay.tailVertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) :=
  Set.range (fun n => γ.vertex (n + 1))

theorem SimpleRay.vertices_infinite (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertices.Infinite :=
  Set.infinite_range_of_injective γ.injective

theorem SimpleRay.tail_nonempty (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.tailVertices.Nonempty :=
  ⟨γ.vertex 1, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩

theorem SimpleRay.start_not_mem_tail (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertex 0 ∉ γ.tailVertices := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have he := γ.injective hn
  omega

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import LatticeProb.Walk.SRWGreenLower
import LatticeProb.Walk.PotentialKernel

/-!
# Hitting every site in two dimensions

The finite first-passage decomposition bounds a truncated Green function by
the eventual hitting probability times the return Green function. In two
dimensions the return Green function diverges, whereas its difference from
the Green function at a fixed site converges to the potential kernel. Hence
the eventual hitting probability is one.
-/

namespace LatticeProb

open Finset Filter MeasureTheory Topology

variable {d : ℕ}

/-- A uniform direction has the actual increment law after applying its
coordinate vector. -/
theorem stepLaw_map_dirVec (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    (stepLaw d).map dirVec = incLaw d := by
  classical
  have huniform : stepLaw d = (((2 * d : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹) •
      ∑ a : Dir d, Measure.dirac a := by
    calc
      stepLaw d = ∑ a : Dir d, stepLaw d {a} • Measure.dirac a := by
        rw [← Measure.sum_fintype, Measure.sum_smul_dirac]
      _ = _ := by simp only [stepLaw_singleton, Finset.smul_sum]
  have hmeas : Measurable (dirVec : Dir d → Site d) := measurable_of_countable _
  rw [huniform, Measure.map_smul, Measure.map_finset_sum' hmeas.aemeasurable]
  simp only [Measure.map_dirac' hmeas, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool,
    dirVec_eq_unit, dirVec_eq_neg_unit]
  rw [incLaw, instructionLaw]
  simp only [zero_add, zero_sub, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]

/-- Independent uniform directions give independent increments with the
specified increment law. -/
theorem pathLaw_map_dirVec (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    (pathLaw d).map (fun ξ n => dirVec (ξ n)) = incPathLaw d := by
  unfold pathLaw incPathLaw
  rw [Measure.infinitePi_map_pi (μ := fun _ : ℕ => stepLaw d)
    (fun _ => measurable_of_countable dirVec)]
  simp only [stepLaw_map_dirVec]

/-- Accumulating the uniform directions gives the actual position-path law. -/
theorem pathLaw_map_sitePath (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (x : Site d) :
    (pathLaw d).map (fun ξ n => x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, dirVec (ξ j)) =
      siteWalkLaw d x := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Dir d => fun n => dirVec (ξ n)) :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ fun n => (measurable_of_countable dirVec).comp
      (measurable_pi_apply n)
  change (pathLaw d).map (sitePath x ∘ (fun ξ n => dirVec (ξ n))) = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_sitePath x) hmeas, pathLaw_map_dirVec]
  rfl

/-- The first-passage decomposition summed over a finite time horizon. -/
theorem srwGreen_eq_sum_srwFirstHit (n : ℕ) (x : Site d) :
    srwGreen d n x =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [srwGreen_zero, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [srwGreen_succ, ih, srwHeat_eq_sum_srwFirstHit]
      have hpad : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, srwGreen_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
      rw [hpad, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [← mul_add, ← srwGreen_succ]
      congr 2
      have hjn := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      omega

/-- Truncated Green functions increase with the time horizon. -/
theorem srwGreen_mono {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (x : Site d) :
    srwGreen d m x ≤ srwGreen d n x := by
  unfold srwGreen
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hmn)
    (fun j _ _ => srwHeat_nonneg j x)

/-- A finite Green function is bounded by eventual first passage times the
return Green function, without assuming transience. -/
theorem srwGreen_le_srwHitProb_mul (hd : 0 < d) (n : ℕ) (x : Site d) :
    srwGreen d n x ≤ srwHitProb d x * srwGreen d n 0 := by
  rw [srwGreen_eq_sum_srwFirstHit]
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d (n - j) 0) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x * srwGreen d n 0 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (srwGreen_mono (Nat.sub_le n j) 0)
          (srwFirstHit_nonneg j x)
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, srwFirstHit d j x) * srwGreen d n 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ srwHitProb d x * srwGreen d n 0 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        ((summable_srwFirstHit hd x).sum_le_tsum (Finset.range n)
          (fun j _ => srwFirstHit_nonneg j x)) (srwGreen_nonneg n 0)

/-- The two-dimensional return Green function tends to infinity. -/
theorem tendsto_srwGreen_two_dim_origin :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => srwGreen 2 n 0) atTop atTop := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hbound⟩ := exists_le_srwGreen_two_dim
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => c * Real.log (n : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc
      (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  exact tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop
    (eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨2, fun n hn => hbound n hn⟩) hlog

/-- Simple random walk in two dimensions hits the origin with probability one
from every starting site. -/
theorem srwHitProb_two_dim_eq_one (x : Site 2) : srwHitProb 2 x = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm (srwHitProb_le_one (by norm_num) x)
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - srwHitProb 2 x := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 - srwHitProb 2 x) * srwGreen 2 n 0)
      atTop atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hpos tendsto_srwGreen_two_dim_origin
  have hbound (n : ℕ) :
      (1 - srwHitProb 2 x) * srwGreen 2 n 0 ≤ srwGreen 2 n 0 - srwGreen 2 n x := by
    have hgreen := srwGreen_le_srwHitProb_mul (by norm_num : 0 < 2) n x
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul]
    exact sub_le_sub_left hgreen _
  exact not_tendsto_atTop_of_tendsto_nhds (tendsto_potentialKernel x)
    (tendsto_atTop_mono hbound hdiv)

/-- The law on position paths hits the origin almost surely in dimension two. -/
theorem siteWalkLaw_two_dim_hitOrigin (x : Site 2) :
    siteWalkLaw 2 x (hitOrigin 2) = 1 := by
  rw [siteWalkLaw_hitOrigin (by norm_num), srwHitProb_two_dim_eq_one,
    ENNReal.ofReal_one]

/-- Hitting any fixed site is a measurable path event. Time zero is included. -/
theorem measurableSet_hit_site (a : Site d) :
    MeasurableSet {X : ℕ → Site d | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} := by
  simp only [Set.setOf_exists]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_pi_apply n)
    measurable_const

/-- Translate a target site to the origin in the actual position-path law. -/
theorem siteWalkLaw_hit_site [NeZero d] (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x a : Site d) :
    siteWalkLaw d x {X | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (srwHitProb d (x - a)) := by
  have hpre : sitePath x ⁻¹' {X | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} =
      sitePath (x - a) ⁻¹' hitOrigin d := by
    ext ξ
    have hshift (n : ℕ) : sitePath (x - a) ξ n = sitePath x ξ n - a := by
      unfold sitePath
      abel
    change (∃ n : ℕ, sitePath x ξ n = a) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, sitePath (x - a) ξ n = 0
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      exact ⟨n, by rw [hshift, hn, sub_self]⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      exact ⟨n, sub_eq_zero.mp ((hshift n).symm.trans hn)⟩
  rw [siteWalkLaw, Measure.map_apply (measurable_sitePath x) (measurableSet_hit_site a),
    hpre, ← Measure.map_apply (measurable_sitePath (x - a)) measurableSet_hitOrigin]
  exact siteWalkLaw_hitOrigin hd (x - a)

/-- Two-dimensional simple random walk hits every fixed site almost surely,
from every starting site, including a hit at time zero. -/
theorem siteWalkLaw_two_dim_hit_site (x a : Site 2) :
    siteWalkLaw 2 x {X | ∃ n : ℕ, X n = a} = 1 := by
  rw [siteWalkLaw_hit_site (by norm_num), srwHitProb_two_dim_eq_one,
    ENNReal.ofReal_one]

/-- The iid direction drivers hit every fixed site almost surely in two
dimensions. The sum is empty at time zero. -/
theorem pathLaw_two_dim_hit_site (x a : Site 2) :
    pathLaw 2 {ξ | ∃ n : ℕ, x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, dirVec (ξ j) = a} = 1 := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun ξ : ℕ → Dir 2 => fun n =>
      x + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, dirVec (ξ j)) :=
    (measurable_sitePath x).comp (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun n =>
      (measurable_of_countable dirVec).comp (measurable_pi_apply n))
  have h := siteWalkLaw_two_dim_hit_site x a
  rw [← pathLaw_map_sitePath 2 x,
    Measure.map_apply hmeas (measurableSet_hit_site a)] at h
  exact h

end LatticeProb

import LatticeProb.Prob.InfinitePiSplit

/-! First-step decomposition for a walk driven by independent instructions.
The ordered hitting event observes time zero and excludes a simultaneous visit
of the forbidden set and the target set. -/

namespace LatticeProb.DrivenWalk

open MeasureTheory

variable {α δ : Type*}

/-- Position after a finite number of instructions, starting at `x`. -/
def position (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (ω : ℕ → δ) : ℕ → α
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => step (position step x ω n) (ω n)

/-- A walk starts at its prescribed initial point. -/
@[simp] theorem position_zero (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (ω : ℕ → δ) :
    position step x ω 0 = x := rfl

/-- The next position applies the next instruction to the current position. -/
@[simp] theorem position_succ (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (ω : ℕ → δ) (n : ℕ) :
    position step x ω (n + 1) = step (position step x ω n) (ω n) := rfl

/-- Removing the first instruction starts the remaining walk one step later. -/
theorem position_consNat_succ (step : α → δ → α) (x : α) (u : δ)
    (ω : ℕ → δ) (n : ℕ) :
    position step x (consNat u ω) (n + 1) = position step (step x u) ω n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [position_succ, consNat_succ, ih, position_succ]

/-- A target visit before any forbidden visit, with both times allowed to be zero. -/
def hitBefore (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α) : Set (ℕ → δ) :=
  {ω | ∃ n, position step x ω n ∈ C ∧ ∀ m ≤ n, position step x ω m ∉ A}

/-- A walk starting in the forbidden set cannot hit the target first. -/
theorem hitBefore_eq_empty (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ A) :
    hitBefore step A C x = ∅ := by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, _, hn⟩
    exact hn 0 (Nat.zero_le n) hx
  · exact False.elim

/-- A start in the target but outside the forbidden set is already a valid hit. -/
theorem hitBefore_eq_univ (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∈ C) : hitBefore step A C x = Set.univ := by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · intro _; trivial
  · intro _
    refine ⟨0, hxC, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    obtain rfl := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm
    exact hxA

/-- Away from both boundary sets, an ordered hit depends on the walk after its first step. -/
theorem consNat_mem_hitBefore_iff (step : α → δ → α) (A C : Set α) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) (u : δ) (ω : ℕ → δ) :
    consNat u ω ∈ hitBefore step A C x ↔ ω ∈ hitBefore step A C (step x u) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    cases n with
    | zero => exact (hxC hnC).elim
    | succ n =>
      refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (position_consNat_succ step x u ω n) ▸ hnC
      · intro m hm
        have h := hnA (m + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hm)
        exact (position_consNat_succ step x u ω m) ▸ h
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    refine ⟨n + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [position_consNat_succ]; exact hnC
    · intro m hm
      cases m with
      | zero => exact hxA
      | succ m =>
        rw [position_consNat_succ]
        exact hnA m (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hm)

section Measurable

variable [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace δ]

/-- Every fixed-time position is a measurable function of the instructions. -/
theorem measurable_position (step : α → δ → α)
    (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step)) (x : α) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => position step x ω n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih => exact hstep.comp (ih.prodMk (measurable_pi_apply n))

/-- Ordered hitting is measurable for measurable step maps and boundary sets. -/
theorem measurableSet_hitBefore (step : α → δ → α)
    (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step)) (A C : Set α)
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hC : MeasurableSet C) (x : α) :
    MeasurableSet (hitBefore step A C x) := by
  have hmA (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {ω | position step x ω n ∉ A} :=
    ((measurable_position step hstep x n) hA).compl
  have hmC (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {ω | position step x ω n ∈ C} :=
    (measurable_position step hstep x n) hC
  simp only [hitBefore, Set.setOf_exists, Set.setOf_and, Set.setOf_forall]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => (hmC n).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter fun _ => hmA m)

/-- **First-step decomposition.** The probability of an ordered hit is the average of the probabilities after
one instruction, when the initial point belongs to neither boundary set. -/
theorem measure_hitBefore_eq_lintegral (μ : Measure δ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (step : α → δ → α) (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step))
    (A C : Set α) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hC : MeasurableSet C) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) :
    (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C x) =
      ∫⁻ u, (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C (step x u)) ∂μ := by
  have hE := measurableSet_hitBefore step hstep A C hA hC x
  have hI : Measurable ((hitBefore step A C x).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal))) :=
    measurable_const.indicator hE
  have h := lintegral_infinitePi_nat_head_tail μ _ hI
  have he (u : δ) :
      (fun ω => (hitBefore step A C x).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) (consNat u ω)) =
        (hitBefore step A C (step x u)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases hm : consNat u ω ∈ hitBefore step A C x
    · have ht := (consNat_mem_hitBefore_iff step A C x hxA hxC u ω).mp hm
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm, Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    · have ht : ω ∉ hitBefore step A C (step x u) := fun ht =>
        hm ((consNat_mem_hitBefore_iff step A C x hxA hxC u ω).mpr ht)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hm, Set.indicator_of_notMem ht]
  simp only [he] at h
  rw [lintegral_indicator_fun_one hE] at h
  simp_rw [lintegral_indicator_fun_one (measurableSet_hitBefore step hstep A C hA hC _)] at h
  exact h

/-- The first-step equation for finitely many instructions with arbitrary weights. -/
theorem measure_hitBefore_eq_sum [Fintype δ] [MeasurableSingletonClass δ]
    (μ : Measure δ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (step : α → δ → α) (hstep : Measurable (Function.uncurry step))
    (A C : Set α) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hC : MeasurableSet C) (x : α)
    (hxA : x ∉ A) (hxC : x ∉ C) :
    (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C x) =
      ∑ u, (Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => μ) (hitBefore step A C (step x u)) * μ {u} := by
  rw [measure_hitBefore_eq_lintegral μ step hstep A C hA hC x hxA hxC,
    lintegral_fintype]

end Measurable
end LatticeProb.DrivenWalk

/-- Finite unit-conductance wired SRW: the first-exit-before-zero hitting
probability equals the uniquely characterized zero/one Dirichlet voltage.
The iid direction word chooses each original incident copy with probability 1/4;
only its prefix through the first zero hit or exterior exit is observed. -/
theorem wired_srw_firstHit_voltage (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Active N)) (x : Site 2) :
    walkLaw (hitBefore (↑(S.image site) : Set (Site 2)) (box 2 N)ᶜ x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (FiniteAvalanches.Needle.voltage N S
        (if hx : inBox N x then some (activeOfSite N x hx) else none)) :=
  FiniteAvalanches.WiredHitting.wired_srw_firstHit_voltage N S x
